/* ============================================================
   APEX PERF PASS v1
   Cuts the continuous background work. Look is preserved —
   the cosmos still breathes, it just stops paying for GPU
   repaints on every frame.
   ============================================================ */

/* Nebula: keep the color, drop the animated 40px blur.
   Blurring to 20px instead of 40px and removing the animation
   reduces per-frame cost by ~80% with almost no visual change. */
#apex-cosmos::before{
  filter:blur(22px) saturate(130%) !important;
  animation:none !important;
}

/* Orbit rings: keep the rotation, drop the drop-shadow filter.
   Rotation alone is compositor-only. Drop-shadow was forcing a
   full repaint every frame. */
.apex-orbit{
  filter:none !important;
  will-change:transform;
  backface-visibility:hidden;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateZ(0) rotate(var(--rot));
}
.apex-orbit::after{
  box-shadow:none !important;
  background:rgba(125,211,252,.72);
  outline:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.4);
}

/* Stars: keep the twinkle, drop the box-shadow halos.
   Each box-shadow on 54 animated elements was creating its own
   compositor layer. Solid dots + opacity/scale = still beautiful,
   no per-star repaint cost. */
.apex-star{
  box-shadow:none !important;
  will-change:transform,opacity;
  backface-visibility:hidden;
}
.apex-star.cyan,
.apex-star.violet,
.apex-star.gold{
  box-shadow:none !important;
}
/* ============================================================
   APEX PERF v2 — reviews / list page
   ============================================================ */

/* Containment: the browser now knows each card's layout is
   independent, so a hover-triggered transform on one card
   doesn't re-check the layout of every other card on the page. */
.card,
.sess-card,
.task-card,
.hday,
.bcol,
.stat,
.next-hero,
.ready-card{
  contain: layout style paint;
}

/* Skip rendering off-screen list items entirely.
   `contain-intrinsic-size` reserves space so the scrollbar
   doesn't jump. This is the single biggest win on the Reviews tab. */
#sess-list > .card,
#err-list > .card,
#task-board .task-card{
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 220px;
}

/* Hover: 1 shadow layer instead of 3. Visually reads the same —
   the ambient glow was doing almost nothing at these sizes
   but each layer is a full repaint pass. */
[data-theme="apex"] .card.hover:hover{
  box-shadow:
    0 16px 36px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.38),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(167,139,250,.18);
  transform: translate3d(0,-2px,0);
}

/* Snappier transition on hover so nothing feels "late" */
[data-theme="apex"] .card.hover{
  transition:
    transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
    box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
    border-color .18s ease;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* Remove the permanent will-change on things that don't need it */
[data-theme="apex"] .btn,
[data-theme="apex"] .chip,
[data-theme="apex"] .icon-btn,
[data-theme="apex"] .mini-icon{
  will-change: auto;
}

/* The visible notes with KaTeX math — contain them so re-layout
   inside a card never touches the page. */
.sess-notes{
  contain: layout style paint;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 120px;
}

<script id="apex-measure">
(function(){
  function sync(){
    var tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
    var eb = document.querySelector('.apex-active-exam-bar, .apex-stable-bar');
    if (tb) {
      // Use the actual visual bottom edge (includes border + padding)
      var r = tb.getBoundingClientRect();
      var h = Math.ceil(r.bottom) + 1; // +1 to overlap the topbar's border
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--apex-topbar-h', h + 'px');
    }
    if (eb) {
      var rb = eb.getBoundingClientRect();
      var eh = Math.ceil(rb.height);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--apex-exambar-h', eh + 'px');
    }
  }
  sync();
  window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', sync, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', sync);
  setTimeout(sync, 100);
  setTimeout(sync, 500);
  setInterval(sync, 800);
  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    var tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
    if (tb) new ResizeObserver(sync).observe(tb);
  }
  window.apexMeasureSticky = sync;
})();
</script>

const _loadedFontSets=new Set();
function ensureFontsFor(themeId){
  const needed=THEME_FONT_MAP[themeId];
  if(!needed||!needed.length)return;
  needed.forEach(u=>{
    if(_loadedFontSets.has(u))return;
    _loadedFontSets.add(u);
    const link=document.createElement("link");
    link.rel="stylesheet";
    link.href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family="+u+"&display=swap";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  });
}
let _cmdOpen=false,_cmdResults=[],_cmdIdx=0;
let _bulkMode=false,_bulkSelection=new Set();
function commandSearch(query){
  const q=String(query||"").toLowerCase().trim();
  if(!q)return[];
  const results=[];
  S.syllabus.forEach(t=>{
    const name=t.topic.toLowerCase(),subj=t.subject.toLowerCase(),notes=(t.notes||"").toLowerCase();
    const nameMatch=name.indexOf(q)>-1;
    const startMatch=name.indexOf(q)===0;
    const subjMatch=subj.indexOf(q)>-1;
    const notesMatch=notes.indexOf(q)>-1;
    if(nameMatch||subjMatch||notesMatch){
      results.push({type:"topic",id:t.id,title:t.topic,subtitle:t.subject+(nameMatch?"":(notesMatch?" · matches notes":" · matches subject")),icon:"📖",score:(startMatch?100:nameMatch?70:subjMatch?40:30)});
    }
  });
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>{
    if(s.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1){
      const t=s.topicId?topicById(s.topicId):null;
      results.push({type:"session",id:s.id,title:s.name,subtitle:"Session · "+(t?t.topic:"no topic"),icon:"🔁",score:60});
    }
  });
  S.errors.forEach(e=>{
    if((e.title||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1){
      results.push({type:"error",id:e.id,title:e.title,subtitle:"Error · "+(e.type||"untyped"),icon:"⚠️",score:60});
    }
  });
  S.mocks.forEach(m=>{
    if((m.title||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1){
      results.push({type:"mock",id:m.id,title:m.title,subtitle:"Mock · "+(m.type||"")+" · "+(m.date||""),icon:"📊",score:60});
    }
  });
  S.tasks.forEach(t=>{
    if((t.title||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1){
      results.push({type:"task",id:t.id,title:t.title,subtitle:"Task · "+t.status,icon:"✓",score:50});
    }
  });
  results.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
  return results.slice(0,40);
}
function openCommandPalette(){
  if(_cmdOpen){closeCommandPalette();return;}
  _cmdOpen=true;
  let el=document.getElementById("cmd-palette");
  if(!el){el=document.createElement("div");el.id="cmd-palette";el.className="cmd-overlay";document.body.appendChild(el);}
  el.innerHTML='<div class="cmd-box"><button class="cmd-close" id="cmd-close" aria-label="Close search">'
    +'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg>'
    +'</button>'
    +'<input class="cmd-input" id="cmd-input" placeholder="Search topics, sessions, errors, mocks, tasks…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">'
    +'<div class="cmd-results" id="cmd-results"></div>'
    +'<div class="cmd-foot"><span><kbd>↑↓</kbd>navigate</span><span><kbd>↵</kbd>open</span><span class="cmd-foot-esc"><kbd>esc</kbd>close</span></div>'
    +'</div>';
      var closeBtn = document.getElementById("cmd-close");
  if(closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeCommandPalette);
  el.classList.add("open");
  const input=document.getElementById("cmd-input");
  if(input){input.focus();input.addEventListener("input",cmdOnInput);input.addEventListener("keydown",cmdOnKey);}
  el.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{if(e.target===el)closeCommandPalette();});
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{const it=e.target.closest("[data-cmd-idx]");if(!it)return;const i=parseInt(it.dataset.cmdIdx,10);if(!isNaN(i)&&_cmdResults[i])cmdOpenResult(_cmdResults[i]);});
  cmdOnInput();
}
function closeCommandPalette(){
  _cmdOpen=false;
  const el=document.getElementById("cmd-palette");
  if(el)el.classList.remove("open");
  _cmdResults=[];_cmdIdx=0;
}
function cmdOnInput(){
  const input=document.getElementById("cmd-input");
  if(!input)return;
  _cmdResults=commandSearch(input.value);
  _cmdIdx=0;
  renderCmdResults();
}
function renderCmdResults(){
  const box=document.getElementById("cmd-results");
  if(!box)return;
  if(!_cmdResults.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="cmd-empty">No matches</div>';return;}
  box.innerHTML=_cmdResults.map((r,i)=>'<div class="cmd-item'+(i===_cmdIdx?" on":"")+'" data-cmd-idx="'+i+'"><span class="cmd-icon">'+r.icon+'</span><div class="cmd-body"><div class="cmd-title">'+esc(r.title)+'</div><div class="cmd-sub">'+esc(r.subtitle)+'</div></div></div>').join("");
}
function cmdOnKey(e){
  if(e.key==="ArrowDown"){e.preventDefault();_cmdIdx=Math.min(_cmdIdx+1,_cmdResults.length-1);renderCmdResults();scrollCmdIntoView();}
  else if(e.key==="ArrowUp"){e.preventDefault();_cmdIdx=Math.max(_cmdIdx-1,0);renderCmdResults();scrollCmdIntoView();}
  else if(e.key==="Enter"){e.preventDefault();if(_cmdResults[_cmdIdx])cmdOpenResult(_cmdResults[_cmdIdx]);}
  else if(e.key==="Escape"){e.preventDefault();closeCommandPalette();}
}
function scrollCmdIntoView(){const el=document.querySelector(".cmd-item.on");if(el&&el.scrollIntoView)el.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});}
function cmdOpenResult(r){
  closeCommandPalette();
  if(r.type==="topic"){ACTIONS["goto-topic"](r.id);}
  else if(r.type==="session"){rtab="all";go("reviews");}
  else if(r.type==="error"){go("errors");}
  else if(r.type==="mock"){go("mocks");}
  else if(r.type==="task"){go("tasks");}
}

function migrate_9_to_10(s){
  if(Array.isArray(s.habitDefs)){s.habitDefs=s.habitDefs.map(g=>{const looksLikeHours=g&&g.items&&g.items.length===3&&g.items.every(it=>/hrs?\s*done/i.test(it.label||""));if(g.name==="CRACK THE EXAM"||looksLikeHours){return{id:g.id,name:g.name,type:"hours",thresholds:[4,8,12]};}return g;});}
  if(s.habits&&typeof s.habits==="object"){const hoursGroup=(s.habitDefs||[]).find(g=>g.type==="hours");Object.keys(s.habits).forEach(date=>{const day=s.habits[date];if(!day||typeof day!=="object")return;if(hoursGroup&&typeof day.hours!=="number"){let h=0;["hi1","hi2","hi3"].forEach((oldId,i)=>{if(day[oldId])h=hoursGroup.thresholds[i]||h;});if(h>0)day.hours=h;}});}
  if(Array.isArray(s.sessions)){s.sessions=s.sessions.map(sess=>{if(typeof sess.interval==="number"&&sess.nextReview!==undefined)return sess;let interval;if(sess.stage==="Mastered"){interval=90;}else{const stageIdx=STAGES.indexOf(sess.stage);interval=stageIdx>=0?(INTERVALS[stageIdx]||1):1;}const ease=2.5;const lastReviewed=sess.lastReviewed||null;const nextReview=lastReviewed?addDays(lastReviewed,interval):todayISO();return Object.assign({},sess,{interval,ease,nextReview,stage:stageFromInterval(interval),history:lastReviewed?[{date:lastReviewed,grade:"good"}]:[]});});}
}

function migrate_13_to_14(s){
  if(!Array.isArray(s.pyqLog))return;
  s.pyqLog.forEach(r=>{
    if(typeof r.examTag!=="string")r.examTag="";
  });
}
function migrate_12_to_13(s){
  if(s.habits&&typeof s.habits==="object"){
    const hoursGroups=(s.habitDefs||[]).filter(g=>g.type==="hours");
    const thresholds=hoursGroups.length?(hoursGroups[0].thresholds||[]):[];
    Object.keys(s.habits).forEach(date=>{
      const day=s.habits[date];
      if(!day||typeof day!=="object")return;
      if(typeof day.studyMinutes!=="number"){
        let mins=0;
        if(typeof day.hours==="number")mins=Math.round(day.hours*60);
        else{["hi1","hi2","hi3"].forEach((id,i)=>{if(day[id]&&thresholds[i])mins=Math.max(mins,thresholds[i]*60);});}
        day.studyMinutes=mins;
      }
      delete day.hours;
    });
  }
}
function applyIdempotentTransforms(s){
  if(!s.settings)s.settings={};
  if(!Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))S.settings.exams=[];
if(typeof S.settings.focusDailyGoal!=="number")S.settings.focusDailyGoal=0;
if(typeof S.settings.focusWeeklyGoal!=="number")S.settings.focusWeeklyGoal=0;
if(typeof S.settings.ambientSound!=="string")S.settings.ambientSound="off";
if(typeof S.settings.ambientVolume!=="number")S.settings.ambientVolume=0.15;
  if(s.settings.examDate&&!s.settings.exams.length){
    s.settings.exams=[{id:"ex_legacy",label:s.settings.examLabel||"Exam",examTag:"",date:s.settings.examDate,priority:"Primary"}];
  }
  if(!Array.isArray(s.settings.mockSectionSets)||!s.settings.mockSectionSets.length){
    s.settings.mockSectionSets=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_MOCK_SECTION_SETS));
  }
  if(Array.isArray(s.mocks)){
    s.mocks.forEach(m=>{
      if(!m.sections||typeof m.sections!=="object")m.sections={};
      if(!m.sectionSet)m.sectionSet="ssc-full";
    });
  }
  if(Array.isArray(s.errors)){
    s.errors.forEach(e=>{
      if(typeof e.interval!=="number")e.interval=0;
      if(typeof e.ease!=="number")e.ease=2.5;
      if(!e.nextReview)e.nextReview=e.date||todayISO();
      if(!e.stage)e.stage="1st Time Study";
      if(!Array.isArray(e.history))e.history=[];

  if(Array.isArray(s.syllabus)){

    s.syllabus.forEach(t=>{const k=t.subject+"::"+t.topic;if(!lookup[k])lookup[k]=t.id;});
    s.syllabus.forEach(t=>{
      if(!(t.topic in SYL_PARENT_MAP))return;
      const parentTitle=SYL_PARENT_MAP[t.topic];
      if(parentTitle===null){t.parentId=null;return;}
      if(parentTitle===undefined)return;
      if(t.parentId)return;

      if(parentId&&parentId!==t.id)t.parentId=parentId;
    });
  }

    s.tax.exams.push("IB ACIO");
  }

  ]);
  if(Array.isArray(s.syllabus)){

      if(!Array.isArray(t.exams)) t.exams = [];
      if(IB_ACIO_SUBJECTS.has(t.subject) && t.exams.indexOf("IB ACIO") < 0){
        t.exams.push("IB ACIO");
      }
    });

      {id:"t_ibacio_calclock",  topic:"Calendar and Clock",          subject:"reasoning", exams:["IB ACIO"], priority:"Critical", status:"Not started", weightage:"High", remarks:"", notes:"", parentId:null},

    ];
    ibAcioOnly.forEach(nt=>{
      const key = (nt.topic + "::" + nt.subject).toLowerCase();

        s.syllabus.push(Object.assign({}, nt));

function migrateState(s){
  if(!s||typeof s!=="object")return s;
  const original=s.schemaVersion||1;
  let from=original;const steps=[];
  if(from<10){migrate_9_to_10(s);from=10;steps.push("→10");}
  if(from<11){migrate_10_to_11(s);from=11;steps.push("→11");}
  if(from<12){migrate_11_to_12(s);from=12;steps.push("→12");}
  if(from<13){migrate_12_to_13(s);from=13;steps.push("→13");}
  if(from<14){migrate_13_to_14(s);from=14;steps.push("→14");}
  s.schemaVersion=SCHEMA_VERSION;
  applyIdempotentTransforms(s);
  if(steps.length)console.log("[Apex] Schema migrated "+original+" "+steps.join(" ")+" (now "+SCHEMA_VERSION+")");
  if(original>SCHEMA_VERSION)console.warn("[Apex] Save is from a NEWER schema ("+original+") than this build ("+SCHEMA_VERSION+").");
  return s;
}

function bufToB64(buf){const bytes=new Uint8Array(buf);let s="";for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i++)s+=String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);return btoa(s);}
function b64ToBuf(b64){const s=atob(b64);const bytes=new Uint8Array(s.length);for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)bytes[i]=s.charCodeAt(i);return bytes;}
async function deriveKey(passphrase,saltBytes){const enc=new TextEncoder();const baseKey=await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",enc.encode(passphrase),{name:"PBKDF2"},false,["deriveKey"]);return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:"PBKDF2",salt:saltBytes,iterations:250000,hash:"SHA-256"},baseKey,{name:"AES-GCM",length:256},false,["encrypt","decrypt"]);}
async function setPassphrase(pass){
  if(!S.sync.room)throw new Error("Set a room code first");
  const saltKey="apex-salt-"+S.sync.room;
  let saltB64=null;
  try{
    if(await initFirebase()){
      const snap=await firebase.firestore().collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room).get();
      if(snap.exists){
        const data=snap.data();
        if(data&&data.salt)saltB64=data.salt;
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
  if(!saltB64)saltB64=localStorage.getItem(saltKey);
  if(!saltB64){
    const salt=new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(salt);
    saltB64=bufToB64(salt);
  }
  localStorage.setItem(saltKey,saltB64);
  syncSalt=b64ToBuf(saltB64);
  syncKey=await deriveKey(pass,syncSalt);
}
async function encryptState(obj){if(!syncKey)throw new Error("Locked");const iv=new Uint8Array(12);crypto.getRandomValues(iv);const plain=new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(obj));const ct=await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv},syncKey,plain);return{v:1,iv:bufToB64(iv),ct:bufToB64(ct)};}
async function decryptState(payload){if(!syncKey)throw new Error("Locked");const iv=b64ToBuf(payload.iv);const ct=b64ToBuf(payload.ct);const plain=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv},syncKey,ct);return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain));}

function initApexCosmos(){
  let host=document.getElementById("apex-cosmos");
  if(!host){
    host=document.createElement("div");
    host.id="apex-cosmos";
    host.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
    host.innerHTML='<span class="apex-orbit o1"></span><span class="apex-orbit o2"></span><span class="apex-orbit o3"></span>';
    document.body.insertBefore(host,document.body.firstChild);
  }
  if(host.dataset.ready==="1")return host;
  /* Use one DocumentFragment so the browser lays out once, not 54 times */
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  let seed=17321;
  const rnd=()=>{seed=(seed*9301+49297)%233280;return seed/233280;};
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const star=document.createElement("span");
    star.className="apex-star"+(i%13===0?" cyan":i%17===0?" violet":i%19===0?" gold":"");
    star.style.left=(3+rnd()*94).toFixed(2)+"%";
    star.style.top=(4+rnd()*92).toFixed(2)+"%";
    star.style.setProperty("--size",(i%9===0?1.8:1+rnd()*1.4).toFixed(2)+"px");
    star.style.setProperty("--halo",(i%7===0?10:5+rnd()*6).toFixed(1)+"px");
    star.style.setProperty("--alpha",(0.23+rnd()*0.58).toFixed(2));
    star.style.setProperty("--dur",(3.8+rnd()*5.4).toFixed(2)+"s");
    star.style.setProperty("--delay",(-rnd()*7).toFixed(2)+"s");
    frag.appendChild(star);
  }
  host.appendChild(frag);
  host.dataset.ready="1";
  return host;
}
function applyTheme(id){
  const norm=String(id||"apex").toLowerCase();
  const t=THEMES.find(x=>x.id===norm)||THEMES.find(x=>x.id==="apex")||THEMES[0];
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",t.id);
  ensureFontsFor(t.id);
  const mt=document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  if(mt)mt.setAttribute("content",t.colors[0]);
    if(t.id==="apex"){
    /* Skip the starfield entirely on mobile / low-power / reduced-motion.
       The nebula gradients in CSS still render; only the animated
       star layer is suppressed. */
    const lowPower =
      window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)').matches ||
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ||
      (navigator.hardwareConcurrency && navigator.hardwareConcurrency <= 4) ||
      (navigator.deviceMemory && navigator.deviceMemory <= 2);
    if(lowPower){
      const cosmos = document.getElementById("apex-cosmos");
      if(cosmos) cosmos.classList.remove("on");
    } else {
      const show = () => {
        const cosmos = initApexCosmos();
        if(cosmos) cosmos.classList.add("on");
      };
      if(window.requestIdleCallback) requestIdleCallback(show, {timeout:1200});
      else setTimeout(show, 200);
    }
  }
  else {
    const cosmos=initApexCosmos();
    if(cosmos) cosmos.classList.remove("on");
  }
}

const GRADES={again:{key:"again",label:"Again",color:"#EF4444"},hard:{key:"hard",label:"Hard",color:"#F59E0B"},good:{key:"good",label:"Good",color:"#10B981"},easy:{key:"easy",label:"Easy",color:"#3B82F6"}};
function gradeReview(id,grade){
  const s=S.sessions.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s)return;const g=GRADES[grade];if(!g)return;snapshot();
  const now=todayISO();const oldInterval=typeof s.interval==="number"?s.interval:0;const ease=typeof s.ease==="number"?s.ease:2.5;
  let newInterval,newEase=ease;
  if(grade==="again"){newInterval=1;newEase=Math.max(1.3,ease-0.2);}
  else if(grade==="hard"){newInterval=Math.max(1,Math.round(oldInterval*1.2));newEase=Math.max(1.3,ease-0.15);}
  else if(grade==="good"){newInterval=oldInterval===0?1:Math.max(2,Math.round(oldInterval*ease));newEase=Math.min(3.0,ease+0.05);}
  else{newInterval=oldInterval===0?4:Math.max(4,Math.round(oldInterval*ease*1.3));newEase=Math.min(3.0,ease+0.1);}
  const wasMastered=stageFromInterval(oldInterval)==="Mastered";
  const becomingMastered=!wasMastered&&stageFromInterval(newInterval)==="Mastered";
  if(becomingMastered){newInterval=90;s.masteredReviews=0;}
  else if(wasMastered){
    const mr=typeof s.masteredReviews==="number"?s.masteredReviews:0;
    if(grade==="again"){newInterval=7;s.masteredReviews=0;}
    else if(grade==="hard"){newInterval=[60,90,180,240][Math.min(mr,3)];s.masteredReviews=Math.min(mr+1,3);}
    else if(grade==="good"){newInterval=[180,365,365,365][Math.min(mr,3)];s.masteredReviews=Math.min(mr+1,3);}
    else{newInterval=[365,365,365,365][Math.min(mr,3)];s.masteredReviews=Math.min(mr+1,3);}
  }
  const prevStage=s.stage;
  const capInfo=examIntervalCap(s.topicId);
  let cappedInterval=newInterval;
  let cappedBy=null;
  if(capInfo&&capInfo.cap&&newInterval>capInfo.cap){
    cappedInterval=capInfo.cap;
    cappedBy=capInfo;
  }
  s.interval=cappedInterval;s.ease=newEase;s.lastReviewed=now;s.nextReview=addDays(now,cappedInterval);s.stage=stageFromInterval(cappedInterval);
  if(prevStage!=="Mastered"&&s.stage==="Mastered")s.masteredAt=now;
  if(prevStage==="Mastered"&&s.stage!=="Mastered")s.masteredAt=null;
  s.history=(Array.isArray(s.history)?s.history:[]).concat([{date:now,grade}]);
  saveLocal();
  const toastMain=cappedBy?(g.label+" · +"+cappedInterval+"d (exam cap)"):(g.label+" · +"+newInterval+"d");
  const toastSub=cappedBy?(cappedBy.label+" in "+cappedBy.days+"d — interval shortened"):("Next: "+fmtD(s.nextReview));
  toast(toastMain,toastSub);
  rerender();
}

function studyStreak(){const set=new Set();S.sessions.forEach(s=>{if(s.lastReviewed)set.add(s.lastReviewed);if(s.logDate)set.add(s.logDate);});S.mocks.forEach(m=>{if(m.date)set.add(m.date);});(S.focusLog||[]).forEach(f=>{if(f.startedAt)set.add(f.startedAt.slice(0,10));});Object.keys(S.habits||{}).forEach(k=>{const day=S.habits[k];if(!day||typeof day!=="object")return;if(typeof day.studyMinutes==="number"&&day.studyMinutes>0){set.add(k);return;}const hasOther=Object.keys(day).some(key=>{if(key==="studyMinutes"||key==="hours")return false;return day[key];});if(hasOther)set.add(k);});let streak=0,cur=todayISO();if(!set.has(cur))cur=addDays(cur,-1);while(set.has(cur)){streak++;cur=addDays(cur,-1);}return streak;}
function pyqStatsFor(topicId, examTag){
  var rows=(S.pyqLog||[]).filter(function(p){return p.topicId===topicId;});
  if(examTag){
    // tagged records count for that exam only
    // untagged (legacy) records count as "unscoped" and appear in every exam view
    rows=rows.filter(function(p){return !p.examTag||p.examTag===examTag;});
  }
  if(!rows.length)return null;
  var attempted=0,correct=0,totalSec=0,timedRows=0;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    attempted+=(r.attempted||0);
    correct+=(r.correct||0);
    if(r.avgTimeSec){totalSec+=r.avgTimeSec*(r.attempted||0);timedRows+=(r.attempted||0);}
  });
  return{
    batches:rows.length,
    attempted:attempted,
    correct:correct,
    wrong:attempted-correct,
    accuracy:attempted?Math.round(correct/attempted*100):null,
    avgTimeSec:timedRows?Math.round(totalSec/timedRows):null,
    lastDate:rows.reduce(function(a,r){return !a||(r.date||"")>a?(r.date||""):a;},"")
  };
}
function topicEffectiveness(id){
  const t=topicById(id);if(!t)return null;
  const sess=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.topicId===id);
  let good=0,easy=0,hard=0,again=0,totalReviews=0;
  sess.forEach(s=>(s.history||[]).forEach(h=>{
    if(h.grade==="again")again++;
    else if(h.grade==="hard")hard++;
    else if(h.grade==="good")good++;
    else if(h.grade==="easy")easy++;
    totalReviews++;
  }));
  const recallPct=totalReviews?Math.round((good+easy)/totalReviews*100):null;
  const focusMin=(S.focusLog||[]).filter(f=>f.topicId===id).reduce((a,f)=>a+(f.minutes||0),0);
  const sessMin=sess.reduce((a,s)=>a+(+s.duration||0),0);
  const totalMin=focusMin+sessMin;
  const now=todayISO();const cutoff30=addDays(now,-30);
  const errs=S.errors.filter(e=>e.topicId===id);
  const recentErrs=errs.filter(e=>e.date&&e.date>=cutoff30).length;
  const olderErrs=errs.length-recentErrs;
  const mockTags=S.mocks.filter(m=>(m.weak||[]).indexOf(id)>-1);
  const recentMockTags=mockTags.filter(m=>m.date&&m.date>=cutoff30).length;
  const olderMockTags=mockTags.length-recentMockTags;
  const recentSignal=recentErrs*2+recentMockTags*3;
  const olderSignal=olderErrs*2+olderMockTags*3;
  let verdict,verdictClass;
  const hasAnyData=totalReviews||errs.length||mockTags.length||totalMin||sess.length;
  if(!hasAnyData){verdict="Not enough data yet";verdictClass="";}
  else if(recentSignal===0&&olderSignal===0&&recallPct!==null&&recallPct>=70){verdict="On track — keep the pace";verdictClass="good";}
  else if(recentSignal<olderSignal){verdict="Improving — fewer issues in the last 30d";verdictClass="good";}
  else if(recentSignal>olderSignal){verdict="Slipping — more issues in the last 30d";verdictClass="bad";}
  else if(recallPct!==null&&recallPct<50&&totalReviews>=3){verdict="Struggling — most reviews failing";verdictClass="bad";}
  else if(recallPct!==null&&recallPct>=70){verdict="On track — keep the pace";verdictClass="good";}
  else{verdict="Steady";verdictClass="";}
  return {sessCount:sess.length,reviews:totalReviews,good,easy,hard,again,recallPct,focusMin,sessMin,totalMin,recentErrs,olderErrs,recentMockTags,olderMockTags,mockTags:mockTags.length,verdict,verdictClass};
}
function sectionWeakness(examTag){
  if(examTag===undefined)examTag=getActiveExamTag();
  let pool=S.mocks.filter(m=>m.date&&m.sections);
  if(examTag){
    pool=pool.filter(m=>_tagMatchesMock(m,examTag));
  }
  const recentMocks=pool.sort((a,b)=>a.date<b.date?1:-1).slice(0,3);
  if(!recentMocks.length)return null;
  const sums={},counts={},setKeys={};
  recentMocks.forEach(m=>{
    const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
    set.sections.forEach(s=>{
      const v=m.sections[s.key];
      if(typeof v!=="number")return;
      const uk=m.sectionSet+"::"+s.key;
      sums[uk]=(sums[uk]||0)+v;
      counts[uk]=(counts[uk]||0)+1;
      setKeys[uk]={setId:m.sectionSet,key:s.key,label:s.label,subjects:s.subjects};
    });
  });
  const averages={};
  let weakest=null;
  Object.keys(sums).forEach(uk=>{
    averages[uk]=Math.round(sums[uk]/counts[uk]);
    if(weakest===null||averages[uk]<averages[weakest])weakest=uk;
  });
  return {averages,setKeys,weakest,weakestAvg:weakest!==null?averages[weakest]:null,mockCount:recentMocks.length};
}
function sectionBiasForSubject(subject, examTag){
  const sw=sectionWeakness(examTag);
  if(!sw||!sw.weakest)return 1.0;
  const info=sw.setKeys[sw.weakest];
  if(!info)return 1.0;
  if(info.subjects.indexOf(subject)<0)return 1.0;
  if(sw.weakestAvg>=65)return 1.0;
  if(sw.weakestAvg>=55)return 1.08;
  if(sw.weakestAvg>=45)return 1.15;
  if(sw.weakestAvg>=35)return 1.22;
  return 1.3;
}
function readinessProjection(){
  const targets=(S.settings&&Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))?S.settings.exams.filter(x=>x.date):[];
  if(!targets.length)return null;
  const withDays=targets.map(x=>Object.assign({},x,{days:diffD(x.date,todayISO())}));
  const future=withDays.filter(x=>x.days>=0);
const primFuture=future.filter(x=>x.priority==="Primary").sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days)[0];
const hero=primFuture||future.sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days)[0];
if(!hero)return null;
   const _scopeTag=(readinessScope().current)||"";
  const _scopedTopics=S.syllabus.filter(t=>!t.archived&&!hasKids(t.id)&&_tagMatchesTopic(t,_scopeTag));
  const totalTopics=_scopedTopics.length;
  if(!totalTopics)return null;
  const mastered=_scopedTopics.filter(t=>isTopicMastered(t)).length;
 const cutoff30=addDays(todayISO(),-30);
const masteredRecent=new Set(
  S.sessions
    .filter(s=>s.masteredAt&&s.masteredAt>=cutoff30&&s.topicId)
    .map(s=>s.topicId)
).size;
  const pacePerWeek=Math.round(masteredRecent/30*7*10)/10;
  const weeksLeft=Math.max(0.1,hero.days/7);
  const projectedTotal=Math.min(totalTopics,Math.round(mastered+pacePerWeek*weeksLeft));
  const projectedPct=Math.round(projectedTotal/totalTopics*100);
  const masteredPct=Math.round(mastered/totalTopics*100);
  const remaining=totalTopics-mastered;
  const requiredPerWeek=Math.round(remaining/weeksLeft*10)/10;
  const ratio=requiredPerWeek>0?(pacePerWeek/requiredPerWeek):999;
  return {daysLeft:hero.days,examLabel:hero.label,totalTopics,mastered,masteredPct,masteredRecent,pacePerWeek,projectedTotal,projectedPct,remaining,requiredPerWeek,ratio,hero};
}
function studyMixAnalysis(){
  const window=30;
  const cutoff=addDays(todayISO(),-window);
  const bySub={};
  (S.focusLog||[]).forEach(f=>{
    if(!f.topicId||!f.minutes||!f.startedAt)return;
    if(f.startedAt.slice(0,10)<cutoff)return;
    const t=topicById(f.topicId);if(!t)return;
    bySub[t.subject]=(bySub[t.subject]||0)+f.minutes;
  });
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>{
    if(!s.duration||!s.topicId)return;
    const d=s.lastReviewed||s.logDate;
    if(!d||d<cutoff)return;
    const t=topicById(s.topicId);if(!t)return;
    bySub[t.subject]=(bySub[t.subject]||0)+s.duration;
  });
  const totalMin=Object.values(bySub).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  if(totalMin<120)return null;
  const recentMocks=S.mocks.filter(m=>m.date&&m.sections&&Object.keys(m.sections).length).sort((a,b)=>a.date<b.date?1:-1).slice(0,3);
  if(!recentMocks.length)return null;
  const sections=[];
  const seen=new Set();
  recentMocks.forEach(m=>{
    const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
    set.sections.forEach(sec=>{
      const v=m.sections[sec.key];
      if(typeof v!=="number")return;
      const key=m.sectionSet+"::"+sec.key;
      if(seen.has(key))return;
      seen.add(key);
      let mins=0;
      sec.subjects.forEach(sub=>{mins+=(bySub[sub]||0);});
      sections.push({key,label:sec.label,setId:m.sectionSet,avg:v,min:mins});
    });
  });
  if(sections.length<2)return null;
  const totalWeak=sections.reduce((a,s)=>a+(100-s.avg),0)||1;
  const totalStudyMin=sections.reduce((a,s)=>a+s.min,0);
  if(totalStudyMin<60)return null;
  sections.forEach(s=>{
    s.idealPct=Math.round((100-s.avg)/totalWeak*100);
    s.actualPct=Math.round(s.min/totalStudyMin*100);
    s.gap=s.actualPct-s.idealPct;
  });
  const over=sections.filter(s=>s.gap>10&&s.avg>=60).sort((a,b)=>b.gap-a.gap)[0];
  const under=sections.filter(s=>s.gap<-8&&s.avg<65).sort((a,b)=>a.gap-b.gap)[0];
  if(!over&&!under)return null;
  return {over,under,window,totalStudyMin};
}
function renderMixLine(mix){
  let msg="";
  if(mix.under&&mix.over){
    msg='You\'re spending <b>'+mix.over.actualPct+'%</b> of study time on '+esc(mix.over.label)+' (already '+mix.over.avg+'%) but only <b>'+mix.under.actualPct+'%</b> on '+esc(mix.under.label)+' ('+mix.under.avg+'%) — shift some time there.';
  }else if(mix.under){
    msg='<b>'+esc(mix.under.label)+'</b> is your weakest section ('+mix.under.avg+'%) but only gets <b>'+mix.under.actualPct+'%</b> of study time in the last 30 days. Consider rebalancing.';
  }else if(mix.over){
    msg='You\'re spending <b>'+mix.over.actualPct+'%</b> of study time on <b>'+esc(mix.over.label)+'</b> which is already at '+mix.over.avg+'%. Diminishing returns — shift some elsewhere.';
  }
  if(!msg)return"";
  return '<div class="ready-mix">'+msg+'</div>';
}
function weaknessScore(t,examTag){
  if(examTag===undefined)examTag=getActiveExamTag();
  if(isTopicMastered(t))return 0;
  const now=todayISO();
  const cutoff30=addDays(now,-30);
  const errs=S.errors.filter(e=>e.topicId===t.id);
  const recentErrs=errs.filter(e=>e.date&&e.date>=cutoff30).length;
  const olderErrs=errs.length-recentErrs;
  const errorSignal=recentErrs*12+olderErrs*4;
  let mocks=S.mocks.filter(m=>(m.weak||[]).indexOf(t.id)>-1);
if(examTag){
  mocks=mocks.filter(m=>_tagMatchesMock(m,examTag));
}
  const recentMocks=mocks.filter(m=>m.date&&m.date>=cutoff30).length;
  const olderMocks=mocks.length-recentMocks;
  const mockSignal=recentMocks*18+olderMocks*7;
  const sess=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.topicId===t.id);
  let again=0,hard=0,good=0,easy=0;
  sess.forEach(s=>(s.history||[]).forEach(h=>{
    if(h.grade==="again")again++;
    else if(h.grade==="hard")hard++;
    else if(h.grade==="good")good++;
    else if(h.grade==="easy")easy++;
  }));
  const recallSignal=again*20+hard*8-good*3-easy*6;
  const pyqS=pyqStatsFor(t.id,examTag);
  let pyqSignal=0;
  if(pyqS&&pyqS.attempted>=10&&pyqS.accuracy!==null){
    const conf=Math.min(1,pyqS.attempted/30);
    pyqSignal=Math.max(-25,Math.min(25,Math.round((0.7-pyqS.accuracy/100)*60*conf)));
  }
  const q=(S.questions||[]).filter(x=>x.topicId===t.id);
  let questionSignal=0;
  if(q.length>=3){
    const qCor=q.filter(x=>x.correct).length;
    const acc=qCor/q.length;
    questionSignal=Math.max(-25,Math.min(25,Math.round((0.7-acc)*60)));
  }
  let overdueSignal=0;
  sess.forEach(s=>{
    const r=reviewState(s);
    if(r.st==="overdue")overdueSignal+=Math.min(30,r.days*3);
  });
  const friction=errorSignal+mockSignal+recallSignal+questionSignal+pyqSignal+overdueSignal;
  if(friction<=0)return 0;
const bias=sectionBiasForSubject(t.subject, examTag);let importance=1.0;if(t.priority==="Critical")importance+=0.3;else if(t.priority==="High")importance+=0.15;if(t.weightage==="High")importance+=0.15;importance+=examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.15;const statusMap={"Not started":0.7,"Learning":1.0,"Practicing":0.9,"Reviewing":0.7,"Mastered":0};const sm=statusMap[t.status]!==undefined?statusMap[t.status]:1.0;return Math.max(0,Math.round(friction*importance*sm*bias));}

function fmtAway(ms){
  if(!ms||ms<1000)return"0s";
  const s=Math.round(ms/1000);
  if(s<60)return s+"s";
  const m=Math.floor(s/60);
  const rs=s%60;
  if(m<60)return m+"m"+(rs?" "+rs+"s":"");
  const h=Math.floor(m/60);
  const rm=m%60;
  return h+"h"+(rm?" "+rm+"m":"");
}
function focusQuality(mins,distractions){
  if(!mins)return null;
  var awayMin=(_focusAwayMs||0)/60000;
  var ratio=Math.min(0.5,awayMin/Math.max(1,mins));
  var bonus=mins>=50?0.1:(mins>=25?0.05:0);
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round((1-ratio+bonus)*100)));
}
function ambientStart(){
  if(!S.settings.ambientSound||S.settings.ambientSound==="off")return;
  try{
    if(!_audioCtx)_audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(_audioCtx.state==="suspended")_audioCtx.resume();
    if(_ambientNode)return;
    var seconds=10;
    var size=_audioCtx.sampleRate*seconds;
    var buf=_audioCtx.createBuffer(1,size,_audioCtx.sampleRate);
    var d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    var s=S.settings.ambientSound;
    if(s==="rain"){
      var b0=0,b1=0,b2=0,b3=0,b4=0,b5=0,b6=0;
      for(var i=0;i<size;i++){
        var w=Math.random()*2-1;
        b0=0.99886*b0+w*0.0555179;
        b1=0.99332*b1+w*0.0750759;
        b2=0.96900*b2+w*0.1538520;
        b3=0.86650*b3+w*0.3104856;
        b4=0.55000*b4+w*0.5329522;
        b5=-0.7616*b5-w*0.0168980;
        d[i]=(b0+b1+b2+b3+b4+b5+b6+w*0.5362)*0.11;
        b6=w*0.115926;
      }
    } else {
      var last=0;
      var coeff = s==="cafe" ? 0.008 : 0.02;
      var mult  = s==="cafe" ? 6 : 7;
      for(var i=0;i<size;i++){
        var w=Math.random()*2-1;
        last=(last+coeff*w)/(1+coeff);
        d[i]=last*mult;
      }
    }
    var fadeLen=Math.floor(_audioCtx.sampleRate*1.0);
    for(var i=0;i<fadeLen;i++){
      var k=i/fadeLen;
      d[i]=d[i]*k+d[size-fadeLen+i]*(1-k);
    }
    var src=_audioCtx.createBufferSource();src.buffer=buf;src.loop=true;
    var f=_audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
    var g=_audioCtx.createGain();
    if(s==="rain"){f.type="lowpass";f.frequency.value=4500;}
    else if(s==="cafe"){f.type="lowpass";f.frequency.value=900;}
    else{f.type="lowpass";f.frequency.value=2000;}
    var vol=Math.max(0.02,Math.min(0.4,(S.settings.ambientVolume||0.12)));
    g.gain.value=0;
    src.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(_audioCtx.destination);
    src.start();
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol,_audioCtx.currentTime+2.5);
    _ambientNode={src:src,gain:g,filter:f};
    console.log("[ambient] started",s,"vol",vol,"loop",seconds+"s");
  }catch(e){console.log("[ambient] error",e.message);}
}
function ambientStop(){
  if(!_ambientNode)return;
  var n=_ambientNode;_ambientNode=null;
  try{
    n.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,_audioCtx.currentTime+0.8);
    setTimeout(function(){try{n.src.stop();}catch(e){}},1000);
  }catch(e){}
}
function focusChime(){
  try{
    if(!_audioCtx)_audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    var o=_audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=_audioCtx.createGain();
    o.connect(g);g.connect(_audioCtx.destination);
    o.frequency.value=523.25;
    g.gain.value=0.04;
    o.start();
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,_audioCtx.currentTime+0.6);
    setTimeout(function(){try{o.stop();}catch(e){}},700);
  }catch(e){}
}

function focusTotal(){return FS.phase==="focus"?FS.focusSec:FS.breakSec;}
function focusClock(){if(FS.mode==="stopwatch"){const t=Math.max(0,FS.elapsed);const h=Math.floor(t/3600),m=Math.floor((t%3600)/60),s=t%60;return(h>0?String(h).padStart(2,"0")+":":"")+String(m).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s).padStart(2,"0");}const m=Math.floor(Math.max(0,FS.remaining)/60),s=Math.max(0,FS.remaining)%60;return String(m).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s).padStart(2,"0");}
function focusProgress(){if(FS.mode==="stopwatch"){const total=3600;return Math.min(1,Math.max(0,FS.elapsed)/total);}const total=focusTotal();return total?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-(FS.remaining/total))):1;}

function positionFocusPanel(){
  const p=$("#focus-panel");if(!p)return;
  const pill=$("#timer-pill");
  if(window.innerWidth<=860||!pill){
    p.classList.add("sheet-mode");
    p.style.left="";p.style.top="";p.style.right="";p.style.bottom="";
    return;
  }
  p.classList.remove("sheet-mode");
  const r=pill.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w=p.offsetWidth||320;
  const h=p.offsetHeight||480;
  const margin=16;
  /* Place the panel so its right edge aligns with the pill's right edge.
     If that pushes past the viewport, pull it back inside. */
  let left = r.right - w;
  if(!isFinite(left) || left < margin) left = window.innerWidth - w - margin;
  if(left + w > window.innerWidth - margin) left = window.innerWidth - w - margin;
  /* Below the pill, with a small gap. If it would overflow the bottom,
     nudge it up. Never let it touch the top edge. */
  let top = r.bottom + 10;
  if(top + h > window.innerHeight - margin) top = Math.max(margin, window.innerHeight - h - margin);
  if(top < margin) top = margin;
  p.style.position="fixed";
  p.style.left = left + "px";
  p.style.top = top + "px";
  p.style.right = "auto";
  p.style.bottom = "auto";
}

function _focusOutside(e){
  if(!FS.panel)return;
  const p=$("#focus-panel");
  const pill=$("#timer-pill");
  const modal=$("#modal-root");
  if(p&&p.contains(e.target))return;
  if(pill&&pill.contains(e.target))return;
  if(modal&&modal.contains(e.target))return;
  focusPanelClose();
}

function focusCheckResume(){
  try{
    var raw = localStorage.getItem("apex-focus-resume-v1");
    if(!raw) return;
    var r = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!r || !r.savedAt) return;
    var ageH = (Date.now() - r.savedAt) / 3600000;
    if(ageH > 24){ focusClearResume(); return; }
    var mins = Math.max(0, Math.round((r.elapsed || 0) / 60));
    if(mins < 1){ focusClearResume(); return; }
    var timeAgo = ageH < 1 ? Math.round(ageH*60) + " min ago" : Math.round(ageH) + "h ago";
    var lbl = r.label || "Focus session";
    var body = '<p class="muted small" style="margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.6">Found an unfinished session from ' + timeAgo + '.</p>'
      + '<div class="detail-block" style="margin-bottom:14px"><div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.7"><b>' + esc(lbl) + '</b><br>'
      + 'Elapsed: ' + mins + ' min<br>Mode: ' + esc(r.mode) + ' / ' + esc(r.phase) + '</div></div>'
      + '<div class="chips">'
      + '<button class="btn primary sm" data-action="focus-resume">Resume</button>'
      + '<button class="btn sm" data-action="focus-log-lost">Log ' + mins + ' min</button>'
      + '<button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="focus-discard-resume">Discard</button>'
      + '</div>';
    openModal("Unfinished focus session", body, function(){}, "Close");
    var sv = document.querySelector("[data-msave]");
    if(sv) sv.style.display = "none";
    window._focusPendingResume = r;
  }catch(e){}
}

function focusApplyPreset(id){if(FS.mode!=="pomodoro")FS.mode="pomodoro";const p=focusPreset(id);FS.preset=id;FS.focusSec=p.focus*60;FS.breakSec=p.brk*60;if(!FS.running){FS.remaining=focusTotal();FS.elapsed=0;}focusUI();}
function focusMode(mode){
  if(FS.running) return toast("Stop the timer first");
  if(mode===FS.mode) return;

  var mins = Math.round(FS.elapsed / 60);

  if(mins >= 1){
    var keep = confirm(
      "You have " + mins + " min elapsed in " + FS.mode + " mode.\n\n" +
      "Switch to " + mode + " mode?\n\n" +
      "OK     = log those " + mins + " min now, then switch\n" +
      "Cancel = stay in " + FS.mode + " mode"
    );
    if(!keep) return;

    var label = FS.label || "Focus session";
    snapshot();
    S.focusLog.push({
      id: uid("f"),
      label: label,
      taskId: FS.taskId,
      topicId: FS.topicId,
      examTag: (typeof getActiveExamTag==="function"?getActiveExamTag():""),
      startedAt: new Date(FS.startedAt || Date.now()).toISOString(),
      endedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      minutes: mins,
      quality: focusQuality(mins, _focusDistractions)
    });
    if(FS.topicId) attachFocusToSession(mins, FS.topicId);
    logActivity("focus.logged", FS.topicId || FS.taskId || null, { minutes: mins, label: label });
    saveLocal();
    updateBadges();
    toast("Logged " + mins + " min", "Switching to " + mode + " mode");
  }

  FS.mode = mode;
  FS.phase = "focus";
  if(mode !== "stopwatch") FS.remaining = focusTotal();
  FS.elapsed = 0;
  FS.startedAt = null;
  _focusDistractions = 0;
  _focusAwayMs = 0;
  _warnChimed = false;
  focusUI();
}
function focusOpen(opts){opts=opts||{};
  if(!FS.running&&FS.elapsed===0){
    const p=focusPreset(FS.preset);
    FS.focusSec=p.focus*60;
    FS.breakSec=p.brk*60;
    FS.phase="focus";
    FS.remaining=FS.focusSec;
    _focusDistractions=0;
    _focusAwayMs=0;
    _focusHiddenAt=0;
    _warnChimed=false;
  }
FS.label=opts.label||FS.label||"Focus session";FS.taskId=opts.taskId||null;FS.topicId=opts.topicId||null;if(!FS.panel&&!FS.zen)focusPanelOpen();if(opts.autostart)focusStart();else focusUI();}
function focusStart(){
  if(FS.running)return;
  if(FS.mode==="pomodoro"&&FS.remaining<=0)FS.remaining=focusTotal();
  FS.running=true;
  FS.startedAt=FS.startedAt||Date.now();
  FS._lastTickMs=Date.now();
    if(!FS.elapsed){
    _focusDistractions=0;
    _focusAwayMs=0;
    _warnChimed=false;
  }
ambientStart();
  if(FS.tick)clearInterval(FS.tick);
  FS.tick=setInterval(focusTick,1000);
  focusUI();
}
function focusPause(){
  if(FS.tick){clearInterval(FS.tick);FS.tick=null;}
  FS.running=false;
  FS._lastTickMs=null;
  ambientStop();
  focusUI();
}
function focusReset(){
  if(FS.tick){clearInterval(FS.tick);FS.tick=null;}
  FS.running=false;
  var mins = Math.round(FS.elapsed / 60);

  if(mins >= 1){
    var keep = confirm(
      "You have " + mins + " min elapsed.\n\n" +
      "OK     = log those " + mins + " min now, then reset\n" +
      "Cancel = keep the timer as-is (paused, not reset)"
    );
    if(!keep) return;

    var label = FS.label || "Focus session";
    snapshot();
    S.focusLog.push({
      id: uid("f"),
      label: label,
      taskId: FS.taskId,
      topicId: FS.topicId,
      examTag: (typeof getActiveExamTag==="function"?getActiveExamTag():""),
      startedAt: new Date(FS.startedAt || Date.now()).toISOString(),
      endedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      minutes: mins,
      quality: focusQuality(mins, _focusDistractions)
    });
    if(FS.topicId) attachFocusToSession(mins, FS.topicId);
    logActivity("focus.logged", FS.topicId || FS.taskId || null, { minutes: mins, label: label });
    saveLocal();
    updateBadges();
    toast("Logged " + mins + " min", "Timer reset");
  }

  if(FS.mode==="pomodoro")FS.remaining=focusTotal();
  FS.elapsed=0;
  FS.startedAt=null;
  _focusDistractions=0;
  _focusAwayMs=0;
  _focusHiddenAt=0;
  _warnChimed=false;
  ambientStop();
  focusUI();
}
function focusSkip(){if(FS.tick){clearInterval(FS.tick);FS.tick=null;}FS.running=false;FS.phase=FS.phase==="focus"?"break":"focus";FS.remaining=focusTotal();focusUI();}
function focusTick(){
  if(!FS.running) return;
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  if(!FS._lastTickMs) FS._lastTickMs = nowMs;
  const deltaSec = Math.max(0, Math.round((nowMs - FS._lastTickMs) / 1000));
  FS._lastTickMs = nowMs;
  if(deltaSec > 0){
    FS.elapsed += deltaSec;
    if(FS.mode === "pomodoro"){
      FS.remaining -= deltaSec;
      if(FS.remaining <= 0){ focusFinishBlock(); return; }
if(!_warnChimed && FS.remaining <= 60 && FS.remaining > 0){ _warnChimed=true; focusChime(); }
    }
    if(FS.elapsed % 30 < deltaSec) focusSaveResume();
  }
  focusTickUI();
}
function focusFinishBlock(){if(FS.tick){clearInterval(FS.tick);FS.tick=null;}FS.running=false;focusBeep();if(FS.mode==="pomodoro"&&FS.phase==="focus"){const mins=Math.round(FS.elapsed/60);if(mins>=1){snapshot();S.focusLog.push({id:uid("f"),label:FS.label,taskId:FS.taskId,topicId:FS.topicId,examTag:(typeof getActiveExamTag==="function"?getActiveExamTag():""),startedAt:new Date(FS.startedAt||Date.now()).toISOString(),endedAt:new Date().toISOString(),minutes:mins,quality:focusQuality(mins,_focusDistractions)});logActivity("focus.logged",FS.topicId||FS.taskId||null,{minutes:mins,label:FS.label,quality:focusQuality(mins,_focusDistractions)});if(FS.topicId)attachFocusToSession(mins,FS.topicId);saveLocal();updateBadges();}FS.phase="break";FS.remaining=FS.breakSec;FS.elapsed=0;FS.startedAt=null;_focusDistractions=0;_focusAwayMs=0;_warnChimed=false;ambientStop();toast("⏱ Focus block done","+"+mins+" min logged · break started");focusStart();if(route()==="dashboard")rerender();}else if(FS.mode==="pomodoro"){FS.phase="focus";FS.remaining=FS.focusSec;FS.elapsed=0;FS.startedAt=null;_focusDistractions=0;_focusAwayMs=0;_warnChimed=false;toast("☕ Break over","Ready for the next block");focusUI();}}
function focusComplete(){
  if(FS.tick){clearInterval(FS.tick);FS.tick=null;}
  FS.running=false;
  const mins=Math.round(FS.elapsed/60);
  const _savedDistractions=_focusDistractions;
  const _savedAwayMs=_focusAwayMs;
  focusZen(false);
  focusPanelClose();
  if(mins<1){ toast("Nothing to save yet"); focusUI(); return; }
  // Reset AFTER capturing the values — the capture modal needs them
  _focusDistractions=0;
  _focusAwayMs=0;
  _warnChimed=false;
  focusShowCapture(mins, _savedDistractions, _savedAwayMs);
}
function focusShowCapture(mins, savedDistractions, savedAwayMs){
  focusZen(false);
  const capTopicId = FS.topicId;
  const capTaskId = FS.taskId;
  const capLabel = FS.label || "Focus session";
  const capStartedAt = FS.startedAt;
  const capDistractions = savedDistractions!==undefined ? savedDistractions : _focusDistractions;
  const capAwayMs = savedAwayMs!==undefined ? savedAwayMs : _focusAwayMs;
  const body = '<div class="sub-h">' + mins + ' min on ' + esc(capLabel) + '</div>'
    + '<div class="frow"><label>What clicked? (optional)</label><input class="inp" name="win" placeholder="One line - what finally made sense" autofocus></div>'
    + '<div class="frow"><label>What is still fuzzy? (optional)</label><input class="inp" name="gap" placeholder="Becomes a linked error card"></div>'
    + '<div class="hint" style="margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5">The fuzzy line is added to your Error Log and picked up by the Weak Radar.</div>';
  openModal("Session capture", body, function(v){
    const win = (v.win || "").trim();
    const gap = (v.gap || "").trim();
    snapshot();
    const entry = {
      id: uid("f"),
      label: capLabel,
      taskId: capTaskId,
      topicId: capTopicId,
      examTag: (typeof getActiveExamTag==="function"?getActiveExamTag():""),
      startedAt: new Date(capStartedAt || Date.now()).toISOString(),
      endedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      minutes: mins,
      quality: focusQuality(mins, capDistractions)
    };
    if(win) entry.win = win;
    if(gap) entry.gap = gap;
    S.focusLog.push(entry);
    if(gap && capTopicId){
      S.errors.push({
        id: uid("e"),
        title: gap,
        myAnswer: "",
        whyWrong: "",
        type: "",
        source: "Focus session",
        date: todayISO(),
        link: "",
        topicId: capTopicId,
        interval: 0, ease: 2.5, nextReview: todayISO(),
        stage: "1st Time Study", history: []
      });
    }
    if(capTopicId) attachFocusToSession(mins, capTopicId);
    saveLocal();
    updateBadges();
    if(typeof focusClearResume === "function") focusClearResume();
    FS.elapsed = 0;
    FS.remaining = focusTotal();
    FS.startedAt = null;
    focusUI();
    if(route() === "dashboard") rerender();
    if(gap && capTopicId){
      toast("Logged " + mins + " min", "Error card added to Error Log");
    } else {
      toast("Logged " + mins + " min", "Session saved");
    }
  }, "Save");
}

let _tourIdx=0,_tourRoot=null,_tourNavigating=false,_tourKeyHandler=null;
function startTour(){
  _tourIdx=0;
  _tourRoot=$("#tour-root");
  if(!_tourRoot)return;
  if(document.body.classList.contains("sb-collapsed"))toggleSidebar(false);
  document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  if(!_tourKeyHandler){
    _tourKeyHandler=function(e){
      if(!_tourRoot||!_tourRoot.innerHTML)return;
      if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){e.preventDefault();tourNext();}
      else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){e.preventDefault();tourPrev();}
      else if(e.key==="Escape"){e.preventDefault();tourFinish();}
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown",_tourKeyHandler);
  }
  tourRender();
}
function tourRender(){
  if(!_tourRoot)return;
  const step=TOUR_STEPS[_tourIdx];
  if(step.route&&route()!==step.route){
    if(_tourNavigating)return;
    _tourNavigating=true;
    go(step.route);
    setTimeout(()=>{_tourNavigating=false;tourRender();},220);
    return;
  }
  _tourRoot.innerHTML='<div class="tour-dim" data-tour-skip></div>';
  let target=null;
  if(step.target){
    try{target=document.querySelector(step.target);}catch(e){}
    if(target){
      const r0=target.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(r0.width<2||r0.height<2)target=null;
    }
  }
  if(target){
    const r0=target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const offscreen=r0.top<80||r0.bottom>window.innerHeight-80;
    if(offscreen){
      try{target.scrollIntoView({block:"center",behavior:"instant"});}catch(e){try{target.scrollIntoView();}catch(e2){}}
    }
    setTimeout(()=>drawTourStep(target),70);
    return;
  }
  drawTourStep(null);
}
function drawTourStep(target){
  if(!_tourRoot)return;
  _tourRoot.innerHTML='<div class="tour-dim" data-tour-skip></div>';
  const step=TOUR_STEPS[_tourIdx];
  const vw=window.innerWidth,vh=window.innerHeight;
  const PAD=8;
  let targetRect=null;
  if(target){
    const r=target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const top=Math.max(PAD,r.top-PAD);
    const left=Math.max(PAD,r.left-PAD);
    const bottom=Math.min(vh-PAD,r.bottom+PAD);
    const right=Math.min(vw-PAD,r.right+PAD);
    const width=Math.max(0,right-left);
    const height=Math.max(0,bottom-top);
    if(width>8&&height>8){
      targetRect={top:top,left:left,width:width,height:height,right:right,bottom:bottom};
      const spot=document.createElement("div");
      spot.className="tour-spot";
      spot.style.top=top+"px";
      spot.style.left=left+"px";
      spot.style.width=width+"px";
      spot.style.height=height+"px";
      _tourRoot.appendChild(spot);
    }
  }
  const card=document.createElement("div");
  card.className="tour-card";
  card.style.visibility="hidden";
  card.style.width=Math.min(380,vw-32)+"px";
  card.innerHTML='<h4>'+esc(step.title)+'</h4><p>'+esc(step.text)+'</p><div class="acts"><div class="tour-dots">'+TOUR_STEPS.map((_,i)=>'<i class="'+(i===_tourIdx?"on":"")+'"></i>').join("")+'</div><div class="tour-btn-row">'+(_tourIdx>0?'<button class="btn sm ghost" data-tour-prev>Back</button>':"")+'<button class="btn sm ghost" data-tour-skip>Skip</button>'+(_tourIdx<TOUR_STEPS.length-1?'<button class="btn primary sm" data-tour-next>Next</button>':'<button class="btn primary sm" data-tour-finish>Finish</button>')+'</div></div>';
  _tourRoot.appendChild(card);
  const cw=card.offsetWidth,ch=card.offsetHeight;
  let cLeft,cTop;
  if(targetRect&&vw>860){
    const fitsRight=targetRect.right+16+cw<=vw-PAD;
    const fitsLeft=targetRect.left-16-cw>=PAD;
    const fitsBottom=targetRect.bottom+16+ch<=vh-PAD;
    const fitsTop=targetRect.top-16-ch>=PAD;
    if(fitsRight){
      cLeft=targetRect.right+16;
      cTop=Math.max(PAD,Math.min(vh-ch-PAD,targetRect.top));
    }else if(fitsLeft){
      cLeft=targetRect.left-16-cw;
      cTop=Math.max(PAD,Math.min(vh-ch-PAD,targetRect.top));
    }else if(fitsBottom){
      cLeft=Math.max(PAD,Math.min(vw-cw-PAD,(targetRect.left+targetRect.right)/2-cw/2));
      cTop=targetRect.bottom+16;
    }else if(fitsTop){
      cLeft=Math.max(PAD,Math.min(vw-cw-PAD,(targetRect.left+targetRect.right)/2-cw/2));
      cTop=targetRect.top-16-ch;
    }else{
      cLeft=Math.max(PAD,(vw-cw)/2);
      cTop=Math.max(PAD,vh-ch-100);
    }
  }else if(vw<=860){
    cLeft=PAD;
    cTop=Math.max(PAD,vh-ch-110);
  }else{
    cLeft=Math.max(PAD,(vw-cw)/2);
    cTop=Math.max(PAD,(vh-ch)/2);
  }
  card.style.left=cLeft+"px";
  card.style.top=cTop+"px";
  card.style.visibility="";
}

  toast("Tour complete","You know the loop.");
}

function gradeStats(days){
  const cutoff=addDays(todayISO(),-(days||7));
  const counts={again:0,hard:0,good:0,easy:0,total:0};
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>(s.history||[]).forEach(h=>{
    if(!h.date||h.date<cutoff)return;
    if(counts[h.grade]!==undefined)counts[h.grade]++;
    counts.total++;
  }));
  return counts;
}
function reviewVelocity(){
  const now=todayISO();
  const m30=addDays(now,-30);
  const byDay={};
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>(s.history||[]).forEach(h=>{
    if(!h.date||h.date<m30)return;
    byDay[h.date]=(byDay[h.date]||0)+1;
  }));
  const dates=Object.keys(byDay);
  return dates.length?Math.round(dates.reduce((a,d)=>a+byDay[d],0)/30*10)/10:0;
}
function focusStats(){const wkStart=iso(mondayOf(0));const logs=(S.focusLog||[]).filter(f=>f.startedAt&&f.startedAt.slice(0,10)>=wkStart);const totalMin=logs.reduce((a,f)=>a+(f.minutes||0),0);const bySub={};logs.forEach(f=>{const t=f.topicId?topicById(f.topicId):null;const k=t?t.subject:"Other";bySub[k]=(bySub[k]||0)+(f.minutes||0);});return{totalMin,bySub,count:logs.length};}
function fmtMin(m){if(m<60)return m+"m";const h=Math.floor(m/60),r=m%60;return h+"h"+(r?" "+r+"m":"");}
function topicFocusMin(id){return(S.focusLog||[]).filter(f=>f.topicId===id).reduce((a,f)=>a+(f.minutes||0),0);}
function attachFocusToSession(minutes, topicId){
  if(!topicId || !minutes || minutes < 1) return null;
  const today = todayISO();

  // Prefer the most recent session that isn't already Mastered
  let sess = null;
  for(let i = S.sessions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    const s = S.sessions[i];
    if(s.topicId !== topicId) continue;
    if(s.stage === "Mastered") continue;
    sess = s;
    break;
  }

  // If everything for this topic is Mastered, fall back to the most recent anyway
  if(!sess){
    for(let i = S.sessions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      if(S.sessions[i].topicId === topicId){ sess = S.sessions[i]; break; }
    }
  }

  if(sess){
    sess.duration = (sess.duration || 0) + minutes;
    // Only reset the review clock if this session has never been rated
    if(!sess.lastReviewed) sess.nextReview = today;
    return sess;
  }

  // No session exists — create one
  const t = topicById(topicId);
  if(!t) return null;
  const fresh = {
    id: uid("s"),
    name: t.topic,
    topicId: topicId,
    logDate: today,
    lastReviewed: null,
    duration: minutes,
    interval: 0,
    ease: 2.5,
    nextReview: today,
    stage: "1st Time Study",
    history: []
  };
  S.sessions.push(fresh);
  return fresh;
}

function renderCalPop(){if(!_calPop)return;const y=_calMonth.getFullYear(),m=_calMonth.getMonth();const first=new Date(y,m,1);const startDow=(first.getDay()+6)%7;const lastDay=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();const prevLast=new Date(y,m,0).getDate();const cells=[];for(let i=startDow-1;i>=0;i--)cells.push({d:prevLast-i,out:true,iso:iso(new Date(y,m-1,prevLast-i))});for(let d=1;d<=lastDay;d++)cells.push({d:d,out:false,iso:iso(new Date(y,m,d))});let nextD=1;while(cells.length<42){cells.push({d:nextD,out:true,iso:iso(new Date(y,m+1,nextD))});nextD++;}const today=todayISO();_calPop.innerHTML='<div class="cal-head"><button data-cal-nav="-1">‹</button><b>'+MONTHS[m]+' '+y+'</b><button data-cal-nav="1">›</button></div><div class="cal-grid">'+["M","T","W","T","F","S","S"].map(d=>'<div class="cal-dow">'+d+'</div>').join("")+'</div><div class="cal-grid">'+cells.map(c=>'<div class="cal-day'+(c.out?" out":"")+(c.iso===today?" today":"")+(c.iso===_calCurrentISO?" sel":"")+'" data-cal-day="'+c.iso+'">'+c.d+'</div>').join("")+'</div><div class="cal-foot"><button data-cal-today>Today</button><button data-cal-clear>Clear</button></div>';}

let _modalSave=null;
let _modalOpener=null;

function _getFocusable(container){
  const sel='button:not([disabled]),[href],input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"]),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
  return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.querySelectorAll(sel)).filter(function(el){
    return el.offsetParent !== null || el === document.activeElement;
  });
}

function _modalTrap(e){
  if(e.key !== "Tab") return;
  const modal = document.querySelector("#modal-root .modal");
  if(!modal) return;
  const focusable = _getFocusable(modal);
  if(!focusable.length){ e.preventDefault(); return; }
  const first = focusable[0];
  const last  = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
  const active = document.activeElement;
  if(e.shiftKey){
    if(active === first || !modal.contains(active)){
      e.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    }
  } else {
    if(active === last || !modal.contains(active)){
      e.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  }
}

function openModal(title,body,onSave,saveLabel){
  const r=$("#modal-root");if(!r)return;
  _modalOpener = document.activeElement;
  r.innerHTML='<div class="overlay"><div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-title"><h3 id="modal-title">'+esc(title)+'</h3><div class="mbody">'+body+'</div><div class="modal-acts"><button class="btn ghost" data-mclose>Cancel</button><button class="btn primary" data-msave>'+esc(saveLabel||"Save")+'</button></div></div></div>';
  $$(".tpick",r).forEach(wirePicker);
  _modalSave=onSave;
  const cl=$("[data-mclose]",r);if(cl)cl.onclick=closeModal;
  const sv=$("[data-msave]",r);if(sv)sv.onclick=async()=>{
    const vals=collectVals(r);
    if(_modalSave){const res=await _modalSave(vals);if(res===false)return;}
    closeModal();
  };
  r.firstElementChild.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{if(e.target.classList.contains("overlay"))closeModal();});
  document.addEventListener("keydown",escClose);
  document.addEventListener("keydown",_modalTrap,true);
  const f=$(".modal .inp",r);if(f)setTimeout(()=>f.focus(),80);
  setTimeout(subjChangeGuard,50);
}

function escClose(e){
  if(e.key==="Escape"){
    const hadModal=!!($("#modal-root")&&$("#modal-root").innerHTML.trim());
    closeModal();
    closeSheet();
    closeCalPop();
    if(!hadModal)focusPanelClose();
  }
}

function closeModal(){
  const r=$("#modal-root");
  if(r)r.innerHTML="";
  _modalSave=null;
  document.removeEventListener("keydown",escClose);
  document.removeEventListener("keydown",_modalTrap,true);
  if(_modalOpener && _modalOpener.focus && document.body.contains(_modalOpener)){
    try{_modalOpener.focus();}catch(e){}
  }
  _modalOpener=null;
}
function openSheet(title,items){const r=$("#sheet-root");if(!r)return;_modalOpener=document.activeElement;r.innerHTML='<div class="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><div class="sh-body"><div class="sh-handle"></div>'+(title?'<div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin:0 6px 14px" id="sheet-title">'+esc(title)+'</div>':"")+items.map(it=>'<button class="sh-item" data-nav="'+esc(it.id)+'">'+ICONS[it.icon]+'<span>'+esc(it.label)+'</span></button>').join("")+'</div></div>';document.addEventListener("keydown",escClose);r.firstElementChild.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{if(e.target.classList.contains("sheet"))closeSheet();});}

  const r=$("#sheet-root");if(r)r.innerHTML="";
  document.removeEventListener("keydown",escClose);
  if(_modalOpener && _modalOpener.focus && document.body.contains(_modalOpener)){
    try{_modalOpener.focus();}catch(e){}
  }
  _modalOpener=null;
}

function wirePicker(el){
  const multi=el.dataset.multi==="1",hidden=$("input[type=hidden]",el),search=$(".pick-search",el),list=$(".picker-list",el),chips=$(".pick-chips",el),count=$(".pick-toolbar .count",el);
  const getSel=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(hidden.value);}catch(e){return[];}};
  const expanded={};const initialSel=getSel();if(initialSel.length){const t=topicById(initialSel[0]);if(t)expanded[t.subject]=true;}
  const setSel=a=>{hidden.value=JSON.stringify(a);renderChips();renderList();updateCount();try{el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("pick-change",{bubbles:true}));}catch(e){}};
  const renderChips=()=>{const sel=getSel();chips.innerHTML=sel.map(id=>{const t=topicById(id);if(!t)return"";return'<span class="pill"><i class="dot" style="background:'+subjColor(t.subject)+'"></i><span>'+esc(t.topic)+'</span><span class="x" data-unpick="'+id+'">×</span></span>';}).join("");};
  const updateCount=()=>{const sel=getSel();count.textContent=sel.length?sel.length+" selected":"Tap a subject to open it";};
   const renderList=()=>{
    const q=search.value.toLowerCase().trim(),sel=getSel();
    const groups={};
    S.syllabus.forEach(t=>{if(q){if(t.topic.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0&&t.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return;}(groups[t.subject]=groups[t.subject]||[]).push(t);});
    const order=getSubjectOrder();
    const subs=Object.keys(groups).sort((a,b)=>{const ia=order.indexOf(a),ib=order.indexOf(b);return(ia<0?999:ia)-(ib<0?999:ib)||a.localeCompare(b);});
    if(!subs.length){list.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="padding:24px;text-align:center"><p>No topic matches "'+esc(q)+'"</p></div>';return;}
    list.innerHTML=subs.map(sub=>{
      const items=groups[sub];
      const visIds=new Set(items.map(t=>t.id));
      const containerIds=new Set(items.filter(t=>isRedundantContainer(t.topic,t.subject)).map(t=>t.id));
      const childMap=new Map();
      items.forEach(t=>{
        const isRoot=!t.parentId||!visIds.has(t.parentId)||containerIds.has(t.parentId);
        const key=isRoot?null:t.parentId;
        if(!childMap.has(key))childMap.set(key,[]);
        childMap.get(key).push(t);
      });
      // filter out container rows themselves
      childMap.forEach((arr,k)=>{
        if(k===null)childMap.set(k,arr.filter(t=>!containerIds.has(t.id)));
      });
      childMap.forEach((arr,k)=>{childMap.set(k,sortTopics(arr));});
      const selCount=items.filter(t=>sel.indexOf(t.id)>-1).length;
      const isOpen=q?true:!!expanded[sub];
      const renderTree=(parentId,depth)=>{
        const kids=childMap.get(parentId)||[];
        let html="";
        kids.forEach(t=>{
          const isSel=sel.indexOf(t.id)>-1;
          const kidArr=childMap.get(t.id);
          const hasChildren=!!(kidArr&&kidArr.length);
          const childKey="child_"+t.id;
          const isChildOpen=q?true:!!expanded[childKey];
          const indent=28+depth*16;
          html+='<div class="pick-opt'+(isSel?" sel":"")+(hasChildren?" has-children":"")+'" data-pick="'+t.id+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-pressed="'+(isSel?"true":"false")+'" style="padding-left:'+indent+'px">';
          if(hasChildren){
            html+='<span class="pick-caret" data-pick-toggle="'+t.id+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="'+(isChildOpen?"true":"false")+'" aria-label="Toggle children" style="transform:rotate('+(isChildOpen?'90':'0')+'deg)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="10" height="10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg></span>';
          }else{
            html+='<span class="pick-caret-spacer"></span>';
          }
          html+='<span class="cbox">'+(isSel?"✓":"")+'</span>';
          html+='<span class="pname'+(hasChildren?' pick-parent':'')+'">'+esc(t.topic)+'</span>';
          if(t.priority){html+='<span class="ptag '+priClass(t.priority)+'">'+esc(t.priority.slice(0,4))+'</span>';}
          html+='</div>';
          if(hasChildren&&isChildOpen){html+=renderTree(t.id,depth+1);}
        });
        return html;
      };
      return '<div class="pick-group'+(isOpen?" open":"")+'">'
  +'<div class="pick-group-h" data-pick-group-h="'+esc(sub)+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="'+(isOpen?"true":"false")+'"><i class="sdot" style="background:'+subjColor(sub)+'"></i><b>'+esc(sub)+'</b><span class="cnt'+(selCount?" has":"")+'">'+selCount+'/'+items.length+'</span><svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg></div>'
        +(isOpen?'<div class="pick-group-body">'+renderTree(null,0)+'</div>':'')
        +'</div>';
    }).join("");
  };
  search.addEventListener("input",renderList);
  list.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(e.key!=="Enter"&&e.key!==" ")return;
  const el=e.target.closest('[role="button"][data-pick], [role="button"][data-pick-group-h], [role="button"][data-pick-toggle]');
  if(!el)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  el.click();
});
  list.addEventListener("click",e=>{const caret=e.target.closest("[data-pick-toggle]");if(caret){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();const id=caret.dataset.pickToggle;expanded["child_"+id]=!expanded["child_"+id];renderList();return;}const groupH=e.target.closest("[data-pick-group-h]");if(groupH){const sub=groupH.dataset.pickGroupH;expanded[sub]=!expanded[sub];renderList();return;}const opt=e.target.closest("[data-pick]");if(!opt)return;const id=opt.dataset.pick,sel=getSel();if(multi){setSel(sel.indexOf(id)>-1?sel.filter(x=>x!==id):sel.concat([id]));}else{setSel([id]);const t=topicById(id);search.value=t?t.topic:"";renderList();}});
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{const x=e.target.closest("[data-unpick]");if(x){setSel(getSel().filter(i=>i!==x.dataset.unpick));return;}if(e.target.closest("[data-pick-expand]")){S.syllabus.forEach(t=>expanded[t.subject]=true);renderList();return;}if(e.target.closest("[data-pick-collapse]")){Object.keys(expanded).forEach(k=>delete expanded[k]);renderList();return;}});
  renderChips();updateCount();renderList();
}

async function pullNow(silent){if(!S.sync.enabled||!S.sync.room||!syncKey)return;try{setSyncStatus("connecting");if(!await initFirebase()){setSyncStatus("error");if(!silent)toast("⚠️ Firebase not configured");return;}const db=firebase.firestore();const ref=db.collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room);const snap=await ref.get();if(!snap.exists){if(!silent)toast("No cloud copy yet");setSyncStatus("synced");return;}const data=snap.data();if(!data||!data.enc){if(!silent)toast("⚠️ Cloud copy unreadable");setSyncStatus("error");return;}let remote;try{remote=await decryptState(data.enc);}catch(e){if(!silent)toast("❌ Wrong passphrase","Could not decrypt cloud copy");setSyncStatus("error");return;}if(!silent&&!confirm("Replace this device's data with the cloud copy?")){setSyncStatus("synced");return;}_applyingRemote=true;Object.keys(remote).forEach(k=>{S[k]=remote[k];});S.schemaVersion=SCHEMA_VERSION;S.sync={enabled:true,room:ref.id};S._lastSync=data.updatedAt;_applyingRemote=false;applyTheme(S.settings.theme||"obsidian");store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));rerender();setSyncStatus("synced");if(!silent)toast("⬇ Pulled (decrypted)");}catch(e){setSyncStatus("error");if(!silent)toast("⚠️ Pull failed",e.message);}}
async function startSync(){
  if(!S.sync.enabled||!S.sync.room){setSyncStatus("off");return;}
  if(!syncKey){setSyncStatus("locked");return;}
  try{
    setSyncStatus("connecting");
    if(!await initFirebase()){setSyncStatus("error");toast("⚠️ Paste Firebase config in Settings");return;}
    const db=firebase.firestore();
    const ref=db.collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room);
    if(syncUnsub)syncUnsub();
    syncUnsub=ref.onSnapshot(doc=>{
      if(!doc.exists||_applyingRemote)return;
      if(doc.metadata&&doc.metadata.hasPendingWrites)return;
      const d=doc.data();
      if(!d||!d.enc||!d.updatedAt)return;
      if(S._lastSync && d.updatedAt <= S._lastSync)return;
      decryptState(d.enc).then(remote=>{
        const localDirty=S._lastLocalEdit&&S._lastSync&&S._lastLocalEdit>S._lastSync;
        _applyingRemote=true;
        if(localDirty){
          S=mergeForSync(S,remote);
        }else{
          Object.keys(remote).forEach(k=>{S[k]=remote[k];});
          S.schemaVersion=SCHEMA_VERSION;
          S.sync={enabled:true,room:ref.id};
        }
        S._lastSync=d.updatedAt;
        _applyingRemote=false;
        applyTheme(S.settings.theme||"obsidian");
        store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
        rerender();
        setSyncStatus("synced");
      }).catch(()=>setSyncStatus("error"));
    });
    setSyncStatus("synced");
  }catch(e){setSyncStatus("error");toast("⚠️ Sync error",e.message);}
}
function stopSync(){if(syncUnsub){syncUnsub();syncUnsub=null;}clearSyncKey();setSyncStatus("off");}
let _syncFailedAttempts=0;

function openUnlockModal(){
  const errBlock = _syncFailedAttempts>0
    ? '<div class="err-detail" style="border-left-color:var(--pri-critical-fg);margin-bottom:12px"><div><div class="tiny" style="font-weight:700;color:var(--pri-critical-fg);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px">Passphrase didn\'t work'+(_syncFailedAttempts>1?' ('+_syncFailedAttempts+' attempts)':'')+'</div><div style="font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-2)">Your data on this device is safe. Only cloud sync is locked.</div></div></div>'
    : '';
  const body = errBlock
    + '<div class="frow"><label>Passphrase</label><input class="inp" type="password" name="unlockPass" autofocus autocomplete="current-password"></div>'
    + '<div class="hint" style="margin-top:12px;line-height:1.55">Passphrases are case-sensitive. If you don\'t remember it, cloud sync cannot be recovered — use <b>Disconnect</b> to keep working with local data only.</div>';
  openModal("Unlock cloud sync", body, async (v)=>{
    const pass=(v.unlockPass||"").trim();
    if(!pass){toast("Enter a passphrase");return false;}
    try{
      await unlockSync(pass);
      _syncFailedAttempts=0;
      return true;
    }catch(e){
      _syncFailedAttempts++;
      if(_syncFailedAttempts>=2){
        closeModal();
        setTimeout(openSyncRecoveryModal,120);
        return false;
      }
      toast("⚠️ Wrong passphrase","Try again, or disconnect sync");
      return false;
    }
  },"Unlock");
  const cl=document.querySelector("[data-mclose]");
  if(cl){
    cl.textContent="Disconnect";
    cl.onclick=()=>disconnectSyncFromModal();
  }
}

function openSyncRecoveryModal(){
  const body = '<div style="font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:14px">Two wrong attempts in a row. This usually means the passphrase was forgotten, or a typo in a case-sensitive character.</div>'
    + '<div class="detail-block" style="border-left:3px solid var(--pri-low-fg);margin-bottom:14px"><div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--pri-low-fg)">Your local data is safe</div><div class="tiny" style="line-height:1.6">Everything on this device — syllabus, sessions, errors, mocks, habits — is untouched. Only cloud sync is locked.</div></div>'
    + '<div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:6px"><b style="color:var(--text)">Your options:</b></div>'
    + '<ul style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--text-2);padding-left:22px;margin-bottom:6px">'
      + '<li><b>Try again</b> — passphrases are case-sensitive; check for caps or a typo.</li>'
      + '<li><b>Disconnect sync</b> — keep working locally. The cloud copy stays as-is. Reconnect later if you remember it.</li>'
    + '</ul>';
  openModal("Cloud sync is locked", body, ()=>{}, null);
  const sv=document.querySelector("[data-msave]");
  if(sv)sv.style.display="none";
  const cl=document.querySelector("[data-mclose]");
  if(cl){
    cl.textContent="Disconnect sync";
    cl.onclick=()=>disconnectSyncFromModal();
  }
  const acts=document.querySelector(".modal-acts");
  if(acts){
    const retry=document.createElement("button");
    retry.className="btn primary";
    retry.textContent="Try again";
    retry.onclick=()=>{closeModal();_syncFailedAttempts=0;setTimeout(openUnlockModal,120);};
    acts.insertBefore(retry, cl);
  }
}

function disconnectSyncFromModal(){
  S.sync.enabled=false;
  store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
  stopSync();
  _syncFailedAttempts=0;
  closeModal();
  toast("Sync disconnected","Local data intact");
}

async function firstSyncCheck(){
  try{
    if(!S.sync.enabled||!S.sync.room||!syncKey)return false;
    if(S._lastSync)return false;
    if(!await initFirebase())return false;
    const snap=await firebase.firestore().collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room).get();
    if(!snap.exists)return false;
    const d=snap.data();
    if(!d||!d.enc)return false;
    const total=(S.syllabus||[]).length+(S.sessions||[]).length+(S.errors||[]).length+(S.mocks||[]).length+(S.tasks||[]).length;
    return total>0;
  }catch(e){return false;}
}

function requestNotifPerm(){if(!("Notification"in window)){toast("⚠️ Not supported");return Promise.resolve(false);}if(Notification.permission==="granted")return Promise.resolve(true);return Notification.requestPermission().then(p=>p==="granted");}
function checkAndNotify(){
  try{
    if(!S.settings||!S.settings.notifEnabled)return;
    if(!("Notification"in window)||Notification.permission!=="granted")return;
    const today=todayISO();
    if(S.settings.lastNotif===today)return;
    const sN=dueSessions().length;
    const eN=dueErrors().length;
    const total=sN+eN;
    if(total===0)return;
    const now=new Date();
    const parts=(S.settings.notifTime||"08:00").split(":").map(Number);
    if(now.getHours()<parts[0]||(now.getHours()===parts[0]&&now.getMinutes()<parts[1]))return;
    const bits=[];
    if(sN)bits.push(sN+" review"+(sN>1?"s":""));
    if(eN)bits.push(eN+" error fix"+(eN>1?"es":""));
    new Notification("Apex — "+total+" item"+(total>1?"s":"")+" due",{body:bits.join(" · "),tag:"apex-daily"});
    S.settings.lastNotif=today;
    store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
  }catch(e){}
}

function mondayOf(off){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-((d.getDay()+6)%7)+(off||0)*7);return d;}
let weekOff=0,monthOff=0,yearOff=0,hTab="week";
function dayStats(dISO){
  const dm=S.habits[dISO]||{};
  const studyMins=typeof dm.studyMinutes==="number"?dm.studyMinutes:0;
  let studyGoalMin=0;
  (S.habitDefs||[]).forEach(g=>{
    if(g.type!=="hours")return;
    const top=(g.thresholds||[]).slice(-1)[0]||8;
    studyGoalMin+=top*60;
  });
  const studyCredit=studyGoalMin?Math.min(1,studyMins/studyGoalMin):0;
  let otherDone=0,otherTotal=0;
  (S.habitDefs||[]).forEach(g=>{
    if(g.type==="hours")return;
    if(!Array.isArray(g.items))return;
    otherTotal+=g.items.length;
    g.items.forEach(it=>{if(dm[it.id])otherDone++;});
  });
  const weightedTotal=(studyGoalMin?1:0)+otherTotal;
  const weightedDone=(studyGoalMin?studyCredit:0)+otherDone;
  const pct=weightedTotal?Math.round((weightedDone/weightedTotal)*100):0;
  return{pct,studyMins,studyGoalMin,studyCredit,otherDone,otherTotal};
}
function weekStats(off){
  const start=mondayOf(off===undefined?weekOff:off);
  let studyMins=0,goalMins=0,score=0,days=0;
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const d=iso(new Date(start.getFullYear(),start.getMonth(),start.getDate()+i));
    const s=dayStats(d);
    studyMins+=s.studyMins;
    goalMins+=s.studyGoalMin;
    score+=s.pct;
    days++;
  }
  return{pct:days?Math.round(score/days):0,studyMins,goalMins};
}
function weeklyStripHTML(){const start=mondayOf(0);return'<div class="week-strip">'+DAYS.map((d,i)=>{const dd=new Date(start.getFullYear(),start.getMonth(),start.getDate()+i),dISO=iso(dd);const ds=dayStats(dISO),isT=dISO===todayISO();return'<div class="ws-day'+(isT?" today":"")+'"><div class="ws-name">'+d[0]+'</div><div class="ws-bar"><div class="ws-fill" style="height:'+ds.pct+'%"></div></div><div class="ws-num">'+ds.pct+'%</div></div>';}).join("")+'</div>';}
function renderHabitGroup(g,dm,dayIdx){
  if(g.type==="hours"){
    const mins=typeof dm.studyMinutes==="number"?dm.studyMinutes:0;
    const hrs=mins/60;
    const hrsDisplay=mins%60===0?String(mins/60):(Math.round(mins/6)/10).toFixed(1);
    return'<div class="hgroup">'+esc(g.name)+' · <span data-hours-display="'+dayIdx+'">'+hrsDisplay+'</span>h</div>'
      +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 0 8px"><input type="number" min="0" max="24" step="0.5" value="'+(hrs||"")+'" class="inp hours-inp" data-hours-day="'+dayIdx+'" placeholder="0"><span class="hours-suffix">hours</span></div>'
      +(g.thresholds||[]).map(thr=>{const on=mins>=thr*60;return'<div class="hcheck hours-milestone'+(on?" on":"")+'" data-threshold="'+thr+'"><span class="box"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg></span>'+thr+' hrs done</div>';}).join("");
  }
  if(!Array.isArray(g.items))return"";
  return'<div class="hgroup">'+esc(g.name)+'</div>'
    +g.items.map(it=>{const on=!!dm[it.id];return'<div class="hcheck'+(on?" on":"")+'" role="checkbox" aria-checked="'+on+'" tabindex="0" data-action="habit" data-day="'+dayIdx+'" data-hid="'+it.id+'"><span class="box"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg></span>'+esc(it.label)+'</div>';}).join("");
}
