function agendaRow(s){const rel=s.topicId?relPill(s.topicId):"";return'<div class="row-item" style="flex-wrap:wrap"><div class="grow" style="min-width:100%"><div class="t">'+esc(s.name)+'</div><div class="m">'+stagePill(s.stage)+' '+rel+' '+dueTag(s)+'</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;width:100%;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="mini-icon" data-action="gcal-review" data-id="'+s.id+'">'+ICONS.cal+'</button><button class="mini-icon accent" data-action="focus-task-from-review" data-id="'+s.id+'"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>'+gradeRowHTML(s.id)+'</div></div>';}
function hourBucket(){const h=new Date().getHours();if(h<5)return"night";if(h<12)return"morning";if(h<17)return"afternoon";if(h<22)return"evening";return"night";}
function recentSubjectWork(){
  let latest=null;
  (S.focusLog||[]).forEach(f=>{
    if(!f.topicId||!f.startedAt)return;
    const ts=new Date(f.endedAt||f.startedAt).getTime();
    if(!latest||ts>latest.ts){const t=topicById(f.topicId);if(t)latest={ts,subject:t.subject};}
  });
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>{
    if(!s.topicId)return;
    const ts=parseD(s.lastReviewed||s.logDate||"")?.getTime()||0;
    if(!ts)return;
    if(!latest||ts>latest.ts){const t=topicById(s.topicId);if(t)latest={ts,subject:t.subject};}
  });
  return latest?latest.subject:null;
}
function consecutiveFails(sessId){const s=S.sessions.find(x=>x.id===sessId);if(!s||!Array.isArray(s.history))return 0;let n=0;for(let i=s.history.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(s.history[i].grade==="again")n++;else break;}return n;}
function daysSinceLastMock(){if(!S.mocks.length)return null;const last=S.mocks.slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.date||"")<(b.date||"")?1:-1)[0];return last&&last.date?diffD(todayISO(),last.date):null;}
function interleavePenalty(subject){const recent=recentSubjectWork();if(!recent||!subject)return 0;return recent===subject?0.15:0;}
function examIntervalCap(topicId){
  const t=topicId?topicById(topicId):null;
  if(!t)return 99999;
  const targets=(S.settings&&Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))?S.settings.exams.filter(x=>x.date):[];
  if(!targets.length)return 99999;
  const topicTags=Array.isArray(t.exams)?t.exams:[];
  const relevant=targets.filter(x=>x.examTag&&topicTags.indexOf(x.examTag)>-1);
  const pool=relevant.length?relevant:targets;
  let nearest=null,nearestLabel="";
  pool.forEach(x=>{
    const d=diffD(x.date,todayISO());
    if(d<0)return;
    if(nearest===null||d<nearest){nearest=d;nearestLabel=x.label||x.examTag||"exam";}
  });
  if(nearest===null)return 99999;
  let cap;
  if(nearest>180)cap=99999;
  else if(nearest>90)cap=60;
  else if(nearest>30)cap=30;
  else if(nearest>14)cap=14;
  else if(nearest>7)cap=7;
  else if(nearest>3)cap=3;
  else cap=1;
  return {cap,days:nearest,label:nearestLabel};
}
function urgencyFromDays(d){if(d<0)return 0.3;if(d>180)return 0.3;if(d>90)return 0.5;if(d>30)return 0.7;if(d>7)return 0.9;return 1.0;}
function examUrgencyForTopic(t){
  const targets=(S.settings&&Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))?S.settings.exams.filter(x=>x.date):[];
  if(!targets.length){if(!S.settings||!S.settings.examDate)return 0.5;return urgencyFromDays(diffD(S.settings.examDate,todayISO()));}
  const topicTags=Array.isArray(t.exams)?t.exams:[];
  const relevant=targets.filter(x=>x.examTag&&topicTags.indexOf(x.examTag)>-1);
  const pool=relevant.length?relevant:targets;
  const priFactor={Primary:1.0,Secondary:0.85,Backup:0.7};
  let best=null;
  pool.forEach(x=>{
    const d=diffD(x.date,todayISO());
    const score=urgencyFromDays(d)*(priFactor[x.priority]||1.0);
    if(!best||score>best.score)best={score,days:d};
  });
  return best?Math.max(0.2,Math.min(1.0,best.score)):0.5;
}
function recommendSmart(){
  const candidates=[];
  const bucket=hourBucket();
  const sinceMock=daysSinceLastMock();
  const due=dueSessions();
  due.filter(s=>reviewState(s).st==="overdue").forEach(s=>{
    const t=s.topicId?topicById(s.topicId):null;const days=reviewState(s).days;const cf=consecutiveFails(s.id);
    let score=100+Math.min(days,14)*3;
    if(t){score*=1+examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.5;score*=1-interleavePenalty(t.subject);if(cf>=2)score*=1.3;if(bucket==="evening"||bucket==="night")score*=1.15;}
    candidates.push({kind:"overdue",score,title:s.name,subtitle:(t?t.topic+" · ":"")+days+"d overdue",reason:"Overdue "+days+"d"+(cf>=2?" · repeated fails":"")+(t&&examUrgencyForTopic(t)>=0.7?" · exam-near":""),sessionId:s.id,topicId:s.topicId||null,primaryAction:{a:"focus-task-from-review",id:s.id,label:"⚡ Start Focus"},secondaryAction:{a:"grade-review",id:s.id,grade:"good",label:"Mark Good"}});
  });
  due.filter(s=>["today","new"].indexOf(reviewState(s).st)>-1).forEach(s=>{
    const t=s.topicId?topicById(s.topicId):null;let score=70;
    if(t){score*=1+examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.4;score*=1-interleavePenalty(t.subject);}
    if(bucket==="evening"||bucket==="night")score*=1.2;else if(bucket==="morning")score*=0.9;
    candidates.push({kind:"today",score,title:s.name,subtitle:(t?t.topic+" · ":"")+s.stage,reason:"Due today"+(t?" · "+t.subject:"")+(bucket==="evening"?" · evening is review time":""),sessionId:s.id,topicId:s.topicId||null,primaryAction:{a:"focus-task-from-review",id:s.id,label:"⚡ Start Focus"},secondaryAction:{a:"grade-review",id:s.id,grade:"good",label:"Mark Good"}});
  });
  weakTopics(5).forEach(w=>{
    const t=w.t;let score=w.score*0.6;score*=1+examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.6;score*=1-interleavePenalty(t.subject);
    if(bucket==="morning"||bucket==="afternoon")score*=1.15;
    candidates.push({kind:"weak",score,title:t.topic,subtitle:"Friction "+w.score+" · "+t.subject,reason:"Friction "+w.score+(t.priority?" · "+t.priority:"")+(t.weightage==="High"?" · Wt High":""),topicId:t.id,sessionId:null,primaryAction:{a:"focus-start-topic",id:t.id,label:"⚡ Focus 25 min"},secondaryAction:{a:"goto-topic",id:t.id,label:"Open Topic"}});
  });
  S.syllabus.filter(t=>["Learning","Practicing"].indexOf(t.status)>-1).sort((a,b)=>priRank(a)-priRank(b)).slice(0,3).forEach(t=>{
    let score=40;score*=1+examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.5;score*=1-interleavePenalty(t.subject);
    if(bucket==="morning")score*=1.3;else if(bucket==="night")score*=0.7;
    candidates.push({kind:"continue",score,title:t.topic,subtitle:t.status+" · "+t.subject,reason:"In progress"+(t.priority?" · "+t.priority:"")+(bucket==="morning"?" · morning = new material":""),topicId:t.id,sessionId:null,primaryAction:{a:"focus-start-topic",id:t.id,label:"⚡ Continue"},secondaryAction:{a:"goto-topic",id:t.id,label:"Open Topic"}});
  });
  if(sinceMock===null||sinceMock>=7){
    let score=sinceMock===null?50:sinceMock>=14?70:sinceMock>=10?55:30;
    if(bucket==="morning")score*=1.2;
    candidates.push({kind:"mock",score,title:"Take a mock",subtitle:sinceMock===null?"No mocks logged yet":sinceMock+"d since last mock",reason:sinceMock===null?"Never logged a mock":"Last mock "+sinceMock+"d ago",topicId:null,sessionId:null,primaryAction:{a:"goto-mocks",id:"",label:"Log a Mock"},secondaryAction:{a:"goto-errors",id:"",label:"See Errors"}});
  }
  const unlinked=S.errors.filter(e=>!e.topicId).length;
  if(unlinked>=3){
    candidates.push({kind:"error-hygiene",score:25+Math.min(unlinked,10),title:unlinked+" errors without a topic",subtitle:"Link them to sharpen the Weak Radar",reason:"Radar accuracy depends on error → topic links",topicId:null,sessionId:null,primaryAction:{a:"goto-errors",id:"",label:"Open Errors"},secondaryAction:{a:"goto-syllabus",id:"",label:"Syllabus"}});
  }
  dueErrors().slice(0,3).forEach(e=>{
    const t=e.topicId?topicById(e.topicId):null;
    const rs=reviewState(e);
    let score=95;
    if(rs.st==="overdue")score+=Math.min(rs.days,10)*2;
    if(t){score*=1+examUrgencyForTopic(t)*0.4;score*=1-interleavePenalty(t.subject);}
    candidates.push({
      kind:"error",score,
      title:"⚠️ "+e.title,
      subtitle:(t?t.topic+" · ":"")+(e.type||"mistake"),
      reason:rs.st==="overdue"?("Mistake overdue "+rs.days+"d"):(rs.st==="new"?"Mistake not yet reviewed":"Mistake due for review"),
      topicId:e.topicId||null,sessionId:null,
      primaryAction:{a:"grade-error",id:e.id,grade:"good",label:"✓ Got it now"},
      secondaryAction:{a:"grade-error",id:e.id,grade:"again",label:"Still unclear"}
    });
  });
  if(!candidates.length)return{kind:"clear",title:"All clear",subtitle:"Take a mock or add a new topic",reason:"Nothing overdue · nothing weak · nothing in progress",topicId:null,sessionId:null,primaryAction:{a:"goto-mocks",id:"",label:"Log a Mock"},secondaryAction:{a:"goto-syllabus",id:"",label:"Browse Syllabus"}};
  candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
  return candidates[0];
}
function recommend(){return recommendSmart();}
const priRank=t=>{const i=taxList("priorities").indexOf(t.priority);return i<0?9:i;};
function quickLogHTML(){
  return '<div class="quicklog"><span class="ql-icon">⚡</span><div class="ql-input-wrap"><input class="ql-input" data-quicklog-input placeholder="Quick log — e.g. Percentage 45" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"><div class="ql-suggest" data-quicklog-suggest></div></div><span class="ql-hint">↵ to log</span><button class="btn primary sm" data-action="quicklog-go">Log</button></div>';
}
function quickLogParse(text){
  text=String(text||"").trim();
  if(!text)return{topicText:"",minutes:0};
  const m=text.match(/(\d+)\s*(m|min|mins|minutes?|h|hr|hrs|hour|hours)?\s*$/i);
  let minutes=0,topicText=text;
  if(m&&text.length>m[0].length){
    const n=parseInt(m[1],10)||0;
    const unit=(m[2]||"m").toLowerCase();
    minutes=unit.charAt(0)==="h"?Math.min(1440,n*60):Math.min(1440,n);
    topicText=text.slice(0,-m[0].length).trim();
  }
  return{topicText,minutes};
}
function quickLogSuggest(q){
  q=String(q||"").toLowerCase().trim();
  if(!q)return[];
  const scored=[];
  S.syllabus.forEach(t=>{
    const name=t.topic.toLowerCase();
    const subj=t.subject.toLowerCase();
    let score=0;
    if(name===q)score=200;
    else if(name.startsWith(q))score=120;
    else if(name.indexOf(q)>-1)score=70;
    else if(subj.indexOf(q)>-1)score=40;
    else return;
    if(t.status==="Learning")score+=8;
    else if(t.status==="Practicing")score+=5;
    else if(t.status==="Mastered")score-=40;
    if(t.priority==="Critical")score+=3;
    score-=name.length/100;
    scored.push({t,score});
  });
  scored.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
  return scored.slice(0,6).map(x=>x.t);
}
function quickLogRenderSuggest(q){
  const box=document.querySelector("[data-quicklog-suggest]");
  if(!box)return;
  const matches=quickLogSuggest(q);
  if(!q||!q.trim()){box.innerHTML="";box.classList.remove("on");return;}
  if(!matches.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="ql-empty">No topic matches "'+esc(q)+'"</div>';box.classList.add("on");return;}
  box.innerHTML=matches.map(t=>'<div class="ql-sug-item" data-quicklog-pick="'+t.id+'"><i class="ql-sug-dot" style="background:'+subjColor(t.subject)+'"></i><span class="ql-sug-name">'+esc(t.topic)+'</span><span class="ql-sug-sub">'+esc(t.subject)+'</span></div>').join("");
  box.classList.add("on");
}
function quickLogDo(forcedTopicId){
  const inp=document.querySelector("[data-quicklog-input]");
  if(!inp)return;
  const parsed=quickLogParse(inp.value);
  if(!parsed.topicText&&!forcedTopicId){toast("Type a topic name");return;}
  let t=forcedTopicId?topicById(forcedTopicId):null;
  if(!t){
    const matches=quickLogSuggest(parsed.topicText);
    if(!matches.length){toast("No topic found","Try a different name");return;}
    if(matches.length===1){t=matches[0];}
    else{
      const exact=matches.find(m=>m.topic.toLowerCase()===parsed.topicText.toLowerCase());
      if(exact)t=exact;
      else{quickLogRenderSuggest(parsed.topicText);toast("Multiple matches","Pick one from the list");return;}
    }
  }
  snapshot();
  const now=todayISO();
  S.sessions.push({id:uid("s"),name:t.topic,topicId:t.id,logDate:now,lastReviewed:null,duration:parsed.minutes||0,interval:0,ease:2.5,nextReview:now,stage:"1st Time Study",history:[]});
  saveLocal();
  inp.value="";
  const box=document.querySelector("[data-quicklog-suggest]");
  if(box){box.innerHTML="";box.classList.remove("on");}
  rerender();
  toast("✓ Logged",t.topic+(parsed.minutes?" · "+parsed.minutes+"m":" · no duration"));
}
function readinessScope(){
  const targets=(S.settings&&Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))?S.settings.exams.filter(x=>x.date):[];
  const tags=[];
  targets.forEach(t=>{if(t.examTag&&tags.indexOf(t.examTag)<0)tags.push(t.examTag);});
  const cur=S.settings.readinessExam||"";
  const current=tags.indexOf(cur)>-1?cur:(tags[0]||"");
  return{tags,current};
}
function getActiveExamTag(){
  return S.settings.readinessExam||"";
}
function _tagMatchesTopic(t,tag){
  if(!tag)return true;
  const tExams=Array.isArray(t.exams)?t.exams:[];
  const tagL=String(tag).toLowerCase();
  return tExams.some(e=>{const eL=String(e).toLowerCase();return eL===tagL||eL.indexOf(tagL)>-1||tagL.indexOf(eL)>-1;});
}
function _tagMatchesMock(m,tag){
  if(!tag)return true;
  if(typeof m.examTag==="string"){
    if(m.examTag==="")return true;
    return String(m.examTag).toLowerCase()===String(tag).toLowerCase();
  }
  return String(m.type||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(String(tag).toLowerCase())>-1;
}
function examReadiness(){
  const scope=readinessScope();
  const tag=scope.current;
  const syllabus=S.syllabus.filter(t=>!t.archived&&!hasKids(t.id)&&_tagMatchesTopic(t,tag));
  const total=syllabus.length;
  if(!total)return null;
  const started=syllabus.filter(t=>t.status!=="Not started").length;
  const coveragePct=Math.round(started/total*100);
  const mastered=syllabus.filter(t=>isTopicMastered(t)).length;
  const masteryPct=Math.round(mastered/total*100);
  const cutoff60=addDays(todayISO(),-60);
  const inScopeIds=new Set(syllabus.map(t=>t.id));
  let totalReviews=0,goodReviews=0;
  S.sessions.forEach(s=>{
    if(tag&&(!s.topicId||!inScopeIds.has(s.topicId)))return;
    if(tag&&s.examTag&&String(s.examTag).toLowerCase()!==String(tag).toLowerCase())return;
    (s.history||[]).forEach(h=>{
      if(!h.date||h.date<cutoff60)return;
      totalReviews++;
      if(h.grade==="good"||h.grade==="easy")goodReviews++;
    });
  });
  const recallPct=totalReviews?Math.round(goodReviews/totalReviews*100):null;
  const recentMocks=S.mocks.filter(m=>m.date&&_tagMatchesMock(m,tag)).sort((a,b)=>a.date<b.date?1:-1).slice(0,3);
  const mockAccuracyPct=recentMocks.length?Math.round(recentMocks.reduce((a,m)=>a+(+m.accuracy||0),0)/recentMocks.length):null;
  const scopedSW=(function(){
    if(!recentMocks.length)return null;
    const sums={},counts={},setKeys={};
    recentMocks.forEach(m=>{
      const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
      set.sections.forEach(s=>{
        const v=m.sections&&m.sections[s.key];
        if(typeof v!=="number")return;
        const uk=m.sectionSet+"::"+s.key;
        sums[uk]=(sums[uk]||0)+v;counts[uk]=(counts[uk]||0)+1;
        setKeys[uk]={setId:m.sectionSet,key:s.key,label:s.label,subjects:s.subjects};
      });
    });
    const averages={};let weakest=null;
    Object.keys(sums).forEach(uk=>{averages[uk]=Math.round(sums[uk]/counts[uk]);if(weakest===null||averages[uk]<averages[weakest])weakest=uk;});
    return{averages,setKeys,weakest,weakestAvg:weakest!==null?averages[weakest]:null,mockCount:recentMocks.length};
  })();
  const sectionPct=scopedSW&&scopedSW.weakestAvg!==null?scopedSW.weakestAvg:null;
  const c30=addDays(todayISO(),-30);
  const c60=addDays(todayISO(),-60);
  const inScopeErrors=S.errors.filter(e=>{if(!tag)return true;if(!e.topicId)return false;if(e.examTag&&String(e.examTag).toLowerCase()!==String(tag).toLowerCase())return false;return inScopeIds.has(e.topicId);});
  const recentErrs=inScopeErrors.filter(e=>e.date&&e.date>=c30).length;
  const priorErrs=inScopeErrors.filter(e=>e.date&&e.date>=c60&&e.date<c30).length;
  let errorTrend=null;
  if(recentErrs+priorErrs>0){
    if(priorErrs===0)errorTrend=30;
    else errorTrend=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(100-(recentErrs/Math.max(1,priorErrs))*50)));
  }
  const confReviews=Math.min(1,totalReviews/40);
  const confMocks=Math.min(1,recentMocks.length/5);
  const confSections=Math.min(1,recentMocks.length/3);
  const parts=[],weights=[];
  parts.push(coveragePct);weights.push(0.15);
  parts.push(masteryPct);weights.push(0.30);
  if(recallPct!==null&&confReviews>0){parts.push(recallPct);weights.push(0.20*confReviews);}
  if(mockAccuracyPct!==null&&confMocks>0){parts.push(mockAccuracyPct);weights.push(0.20*confMocks);}
  if(sectionPct!==null&&confSections>0){parts.push(sectionPct);weights.push(0.10*confSections);}
  if(errorTrend!==null){parts.push(errorTrend);weights.push(0.05);}
  let num=0,den=0;
  for(let i=0;i<parts.length;i++){num+=parts[i]*weights[i];den+=weights[i];}
  let composite=den>0?Math.round(num/den):0;
  const masteryCeiling=Math.min(100,Math.round(masteryPct*2.5+15));
  if(composite>masteryCeiling)composite=masteryCeiling;
  return{composite,coveragePct,masteryPct,recallPct,mockAccuracyPct,sectionPct,errorTrend,totalReviews,recentMocks:recentMocks.length,scopeTag:tag,scopeTags:scope.tags};
}
function marksLeakage(){
  const sw=sectionWeakness();
  if(!sw||!sw.weakest)return null;
  const sections=[];
  Object.keys(sw.averages).forEach(uk=>{
    const info=sw.setKeys[uk];
    if(!info)return;
    const avg=sw.averages[uk];
    const gap=100-avg;
    const critLeft=S.syllabus.filter(t=>{
      if(t.archived)return false;
      if(t.priority!=="Critical")return false;
      if(t.status==="Mastered")return false;
      const kids=S.syllabus.filter(x=>x.parentId===t.id&&!x.archived);
      if(kids.length)return false;
      if(info.subjects.indexOf(t.subject)<0)return false;
      return true;
    }).length;
    const leakage=gap*Math.min(critLeft,20)/2;
    sections.push({label:info.label,avg,gap,critLeft,leakage,subjects:info.subjects});
  });
  sections.sort((a,b)=>b.leakage-a.leakage);
  return{sections,top:sections[0]};
}
function marksLeakageHTML(){
  const ml=marksLeakage();
  if(!ml||!ml.sections.length)return"";
  const max=ml.sections[0].leakage||1;
  return '<div class="card hover" style="margin-bottom:20px">'
    +'<div class="card-h"><h2>Section Gap</h2><span class="sub">evidence-based performance gap &middot; not estimated marks lost</span></div>'
    +ml.sections.map(s=>{
      const pct=Math.round(s.leakage/max*100);
      const color=s.avg<50?"#EF4444":s.avg<70?"#F59E0B":"#10B981";
      return '<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:6px"><span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600">'+esc(s.label)+'</span><span class="tiny">'+s.avg+'% · '+s.critLeft+' Critical left</span></div>'+pbar(pct,color)+'</div>';
    }).join("")
    +'<div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6">→ <b>Focus '+esc(ml.top.label)+' first.</b> '+ml.top.gap+'% gap with '+ml.top.critLeft+' Critical topic'+(ml.top.critLeft===1?'':'s')+' still open — highest leverage.</div>'
  +'</div>';
}
function readinessHTML(){
  const proj=readinessProjection();
  const ready=examReadiness();
  if(!proj&&!ready)return"";
  const projPart=proj?('<div class="ready-legend" style="margin-bottom:8px"><span><b>'+proj.mastered+'</b> / '+proj.totalTopics+' mastered</span><span>D-'+proj.daysLeft+' · '+esc(proj.examLabel)+'</span></div>'
    +'<div class="ready-bar"><div class="ready-fill" style="width:'+proj.masteredPct+'%"></div><div class="ready-proj" style="left:'+Math.max(proj.projectedPct,proj.masteredPct)+'%"></div></div>'
    +'<div class="ready-legend"><span>Projected <b>'+proj.projectedPct+'%</b> at D-Day</span><span>'+(proj.requiredPerWeek<=0?'':proj.requiredPerWeek>30?'<b>Not achievable</b> in time remaining':'Need <b>'+proj.requiredPerWeek.toFixed(1)+'</b>/wk')+'</span></div>'):"";
  const composite=ready?ready.composite:0;
  const cls=!ready?"":(composite<40?"behind":composite<70?"close":"ontrack");
  const rows=ready?[
    ["Coverage",ready.coveragePct],
    ["Mastery",ready.masteryPct],
    ["Recall (60d)",ready.recallPct],
    ["Mock accuracy",ready.mockAccuracyPct],
    ["Weakest section",ready.sectionPct],
    ["Error trend",ready.errorTrend]
  ]:null;
  const breakdown=rows?rows.map(function(row){
    var label=row[0],val=row[1];
    // Recall needs ≥5 reviews to be meaningful
    if(label==="Recall (60d)" && ready && ready.totalReviews < 5){
      var n=ready.totalReviews||0;
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12.5px"><span>'+label+'</span><span class="tiny">'+n+' review'+(n===1?"":"s")+' — need 5+</span></div>';
    }
    if(val===null||val===undefined)return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12.5px"><span>'+label+'</span><span class="tiny">no data</span></div>';
    var c=val>=70?"#10B981":val>=50?"#F59E0B":"#EF4444";
    return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12.5px"><span>'+label+'</span><b style="color:'+c+'">'+val+'%</b></div>';
  }).join(""):"";
    // Precompute composite for every scope tag so inactive chips can show it.
  // Bypass the Perf-v3 examReadiness cache by clearing it before each call.
  const _tagComposites = {};
  if(ready && ready.scopeTags && ready.scopeTags.length > 1){
    const savedTag = S.settings.readinessExam;
    ready.scopeTags.forEach(function(tag){
      try{
        S.settings.readinessExam = tag;
        if(window._apexRCache) window._apexRCache.delete("examReadiness");
        const r = examReadiness();
        _tagComposites[tag] = r ? r.composite : null;
      }catch(e){ _tagComposites[tag] = null; }
    });
    S.settings.readinessExam = savedTag;
    if(window._apexRCache) window._apexRCache.delete("examReadiness");
    // Re-prime the cache for the actual active tag so downstream consumers get the right value
    examReadiness();
  }
  return '<div class="ready-card '+cls+'" style="padding:22px 26px">'
+'<div class="ready-head" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div><div class="ready-title">Exam Readiness</div><div class="ready-sub">'+(ready&&ready.scopeTag?('Scope: '+esc(ready.scopeTag)+' — '):'Composite — ')+'coverage × recall × mocks × errors</div></div><div class="ready-pct">'+composite+'<span class="ready-pct-sign">%</span></div></div>'
+(ready&&ready.scopeTags&&ready.scopeTags.length>1?'<div class="chips" style="margin-bottom:10px">'+ready.scopeTags.map(t=>{
  const isActive=ready.scopeTag===t;
  let composite=null;
  if(!isActive){
    try{
      const cached=window.apexRcache("readinessByTag::"+t,function(){
        const saved=S.settings.readinessExam;
        S.settings.readinessExam=t;
        const r=examReadiness();
        S.settings.readinessExam=saved;
        return r?r.composite:null;
      });
      composite=cached;
    }catch(e){}
  }
  const c = isActive ? null : _tagComposites[t];
  const label=esc(t)+(c!==null&&c!==undefined?' · '+c+'%':'');
  return '<button class="chip'+(isActive?" on":"")+'" data-action="readiness-exam-set" data-id="'+esc(t)+'" style="padding:5px 11px;font-size:11.5px;min-height:30px">'+label+'</button>';
}).join("")+'</div>':"")
    +'<div class="ready-bar" style="height:10px"><div class="ready-fill" style="width:'+composite+'%;background:'+(composite>=70?"#10B981":composite>=40?"#F59E0B":"#EF4444")+'"></div></div>'
    +breakdown
    +'<div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border)">'
      +'<div class="tiny" style="font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--text-3);margin-bottom:8px">Syllabus projection</div>'
      +projPart
    +'</div>'
    +((function(){const m=studyMixAnalysis();return m?renderMixLine(m):"";})())
  +'</div>';
}
function ddayBannerHTML(){
  const targets=(S.settings&&Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))?S.settings.exams.filter(x=>x.date):[];
  if(!targets.length)return '<button class="dday-empty" data-action="open-exams-manager"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:6px"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/></svg>Add an exam target to unlock the D-Day counter</button>';
  const withDays=targets.map(x=>Object.assign({},x,{days:diffD(x.date,todayISO())}));

  // Split future vs past. Future exams always rank higher than past.
  const future=withDays.filter(x=>x.days>=0);
  const past=withDays.filter(x=>x.days<0);
  const rankFn=(a,b)=>{
    const aF=a.days>=0, bF=b.days>=0;
    if(aF&&!bF)return -1;
    if(!aF&&bF)return 1;
    if(aF&&bF)return a.days-b.days;      // soonest future first
    return b.days-a.days;                 // most recent past first (i.e. -1 before -5)
  };
  const primFuture=future.filter(x=>x.priority==="Primary").sort(rankFn)[0];
  const hero=primFuture||future[0]||past.sort(rankFn)[0];
  if(!hero)return '';
  const rest=withDays.filter(x=>x.id!==hero.id).sort(rankFn);
  const isPast=hero.days<0;
  const cls=isPast?"past":hero.days===0?"urgent":hero.days<=30?"urgent":hero.days<=90?"soon":"ok";
  const labelLine=esc(hero.label)+((hero.examTag)?" · "+esc(hero.examTag):"");

  // Grammar-aware sub line
  let subLine;
  if(isPast){
    const d=Math.abs(hero.days);
    subLine=(d===1?"1 day since":d+" days since")+" · "+fmtDY(hero.date);
  } else if(hero.days===0){
    subLine="today — go get it · "+fmtDY(hero.date);
  } else {
    const d=hero.days;
    subLine=(d===1?"1 day to go":d+" days to go")+" · "+fmtDY(hero.date);
  }
  const numDisplay=isPast
    ? '<span style="font-size:.55em;letter-spacing:.08em;opacity:.7">✓</span>'
    : Math.abs(hero.days);
  let html='<div class="dday-wrap"><div class="dday-banner '+cls+'" data-action="open-exams-manager" style="cursor:pointer" title="Click to edit exam dates"><div class="dday-num">'+numDisplay+'</div><div class="dday-info"><div class="dday-label">'+labelLine+'</div><div class="dday-sub">'+subLine+'</div></div></div>';
  if(rest.length){
    html+='<div class="dday-rest">'+rest.map(x=>{
      const isPastX=x.days<0;
      const c=isPastX?"var(--text-3)":x.days<=30?"var(--pri-critical-fg)":x.days<=90?"var(--pri-medium-fg)":"var(--text-2)";
      const num=isPastX?('<span style="opacity:.7">✓ '+Math.abs(x.days)+'d</span>'):Math.abs(x.days)+'d';
      return '<span class="dday-rest-item" data-action="open-exams-manager" style="cursor:pointer" title="Click to edit exam dates"><span class="dday-rest-num" style="color:'+c+'">'+num+'</span><span class="dday-rest-label">'+esc(x.label)+'</span></span>';
    }).join("")+'</div>';
  }
  html+='</div>';
  return html;
}

  function gradeDistHTML(days){
  const g=gradeStats(days);
  if(!g.total)return'<div class="tiny" style="padding:8px 0">No reviews logged in the last '+days+' days. Rate some cards to see the distribution.</div>';
  const row=(label,count,color)=>'<div style="margin-bottom:10px"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:4px"><span>'+label+'</span><b style="color:'+color+'">'+count+' · '+Math.round(count/g.total*100)+'%</b></div>'+pbar(Math.round(count/g.total*100),color)+'</div>';
  return '<div style="width:100%">'
    +row("Again",g.again,"#EF4444")
    +row("Hard",g.hard,"#F59E0B")
    +row("Good",g.good,"#10B981")

  +'</div>';
}
function urgentRow(x){const btn=x.type==="sess"?'<button class="btn green sm" data-action="complete-review" data-id="'+x.id+'">✓</button>':'<button class="btn sm" data-action="start-topic" data-id="'+x.id+'">Start</button>';return'<div class="urgent-item"><i class="sdot" style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:#EF4444;flex:0 0 auto"></i><div class="t">'+esc(x.txt)+'</div><span class="tiny">'+esc(x.sub)+'</span>'+btn+'</div>';}
function momentumHTML(){
  const scored=S.syllabus.filter(t=>t.status!=="Mastered").map(t=>{
    const e=topicEffectiveness(t.id);
    if(!e)return null;
    const recent=e.recentErrs*2+e.recentMockTags*3;
    const older=e.olderErrs*2+e.olderMockTags*3;
    const hasSignal=e.reviews>=2||e.recentErrs||e.olderErrs||e.mockTags;
    if(!hasSignal)return null;
    return {t,e,delta:recent-older};
  }).filter(Boolean);
  const improving=scored.filter(x=>x.delta<0).sort((a,b)=>a.delta-b.delta).slice(0,2);
  const slipping=scored.filter(x=>x.delta>0).sort((a,b)=>b.delta-a.delta).slice(0,2);
  if(!improving.length&&!slipping.length)return null;
  const row=(x,cls)=>{
    const arrow=cls==="up"?"↘":"↗";
    const color=cls==="up"?"#10B981":"#EF4444";
    const extra=cls==="up"?(x.e.recallPct!==null?x.e.recallPct+"% good":""):(x.e.recentMockTags+" mock tag"+(x.e.recentMockTags===1?"":"s"));
    return '<div class="detail-row" data-action="topic-detail" data-id="'+x.t.id+'" style="cursor:pointer;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:6px"><span style="color:'+color+';font-weight:800;margin-right:8px;font-size:14px">'+arrow+'</span><span style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px;font-weight:500">'+esc(x.t.topic)+'</span>'+(extra?'<span class="tiny">'+extra+'</span>':"")+'</div>';
  };
  let h='';
  if(improving.length)h+='<div class="hgroup" style="margin-top:0">↘ Improving</div>'+improving.map(x=>row(x,"up")).join("");
  if(slipping.length)h+='<div class="hgroup" style="margin-top:12px">↗ Slipping</div>'+slipping.map(x=>row(x,"down")).join("");
  return h;
}
function buildPlan(budgetMin){const plan=[];let rem=budgetMin;const used=new Set();function push(item,min){if(rem<min)return false;plan.push(item);rem-=min;return true;}function maybeBreak(){if(rem>=15){plan.push({type:"break",minutes:5,label:"Break"});rem-=5;}}const oe=dueErrors().filter(e=>reviewState(e).st==="overdue").slice(0,3);for(const e of oe){if(!push({type:"error",minutes:5,label:"Fix: "+e.title,topicId:e.topicId,refId:e.id},5))break;if(e.topicId)used.add(e.topicId);maybeBreak();}const os=dueSessions().filter(s=>reviewState(s).st==="overdue").slice(0,6);if(os.length&&rem>=12){const bm=Math.min(15,rem-5);plan.push({type:"review-batch",minutes:bm,label:"Reviews · "+os.length+" overdue",sessionIds:os.map(s=>s.id)});rem-=bm;maybeBreak();}const weak=weakTopics(12).filter(w=>!used.has(w.t.id))[0];if(weak&&rem>=25){plan.push({type:"focus",minutes:25,label:"Deep dive: "+weak.t.topic,topicId:weak.t.id,reason:"friction "+weak.score});used.add(weak.t.id);rem-=25;maybeBreak();}const pyq=S.syllabus.filter(t=>{if(used.has(t.id))return false;const p=pyqStatsFor(t.id);return p&&p.attempted>=10&&p.accuracy!==null&&p.accuracy<70;})[0];if(pyq&&rem>=25){const p=pyqStatsFor(pyq.id);plan.push({type:"practice",minutes:25,label:"Practice: "+pyq.topic,topicId:pyq.id,reason:"accuracy "+p.accuracy+"%"});used.add(pyq.id);rem-=25;maybeBreak();}const cont=S.syllabus.filter(t=>!used.has(t.id)&&(t.status==="Learning"||t.status==="Practicing")).sort((a,b)=>priRank(a)-priRank(b))[0];if(cont&&rem>=20){const bm=Math.min(30,rem);plan.push({type:"focus",minutes:bm,label:"Continue: "+cont.topic,topicId:cont.id,reason:cont.status});rem-=bm;}if(!plan.length)return null;return{blocks:plan,totalMin:budgetMin,usedMin:budgetMin-rem};}

function fullPlanModal(){
  const today=todayISO();
  const list=(S.tasks||[]).filter(t=>{
    if(t.due)return t.due===today;
    return !!t.tbS;
  });
  list.sort((a,b)=>{
    const at=a.tbS||"99:99",bt=b.tbS||"99:99";
    return at.localeCompare(bt);
  });
  const pending=list.filter(t=>t.status!=="Completed");
  const done=list.filter(t=>t.status==="Completed");
  const rowHTML=t=>{
    const done=t.status==="Completed";
    const active=t.status==="In Progress";
    const time=t.tbS?(t.tbS+(t.tbE?" – "+t.tbE:"")):"—";
    return '<div class="plan-row'+(done?" completed":"")+(active?" active":"")+'"><span class="plan-time">'+esc(time)+'</span><span class="plan-title'+(done?" done":"")+'">'+esc(t.title)+'</span>'+(done?'<span class="plan-check">✓</span>':'<button class="mini-icon'+(active?' accent':'')+'" data-action="task-advance" data-id="'+t.id+'" title="'+(active?"Complete":"Start")+'">'+(active?"C":"P")+'</button>')+'<button class="mini-icon" data-action="edit-task" data-id="'+t.id+'" title="Edit">'+ICONS.pencil+'</button></div>';
  };
  const body='<div class="sub-h">'+list.length+' scheduled today · '+pending.length+' open · '+done.length+' done</div>'
    +(pending.length?'<div style="font:700 10px Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3);margin:12px 0 6px">Pending</div><div class="plan-list">'+pending.map(rowHTML).join("")+'</div>':'')
    +(done.length?'<div style="font:700 10px Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3);margin:18px 0 6px">Completed</div><div class="plan-list">'+done.map(rowHTML).join("")+'</div>':'')
    +(!list.length?'<div class="empty" style="padding:20px 12px"><b>Nothing scheduled</b><p>Add tasks with a time block or use the routine template.</p></div>':'');
  openModal("Today's Plan — "+fmtDY(today),body,()=>{},"Close");
  const sv=document.querySelector("[data-msave]");if(sv)sv.style.display="none";
}
function nextUpHTML(){
  const now=new Date();
  const curMin=now.getHours()*60+now.getMinutes();
  const list=(S.tasks||[]).filter(t=>t.tbS&&t.status!=="Completed");
  const upcoming=list.map(t=>{
    const [h,m]=(t.tbS||"0:0").split(":").map(Number);
    return {t,min:h*60+m};
  }).filter(x=>x.min>=curMin).sort((a,b)=>a.min-b.min);
  if(!upcoming.length){
    return '<div class="plan-nextup plan-nextup-done"><span class="plan-nextup-k">ALL DONE</span><span class="plan-nextup-t">Nothing left today</span></div>';
  }
  const nx=upcoming[0];
  const mins=nx.min-curMin;
  const rel=mins<1?"now":mins<60?("in "+mins+" min"):("in "+Math.floor(mins/60)+"h"+(mins%60?" "+(mins%60)+"m":""));
  return '<div class="plan-nextup"><span class="plan-nextup-k">NEXT UP</span><span class="plan-nextup-t">'+esc(nx.t.title)+'</span><span class="plan-nextup-time">'+esc(nx.t.tbS)+' · '+rel+'</span></div>';
}

    +'</div>'
    +'<div style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:space-between"><button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="open-add-task">'+ICONS.plus+' Add</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="task-template">Routine</button></div>';

function isRedundantContainer(topicName,subject){
  const a=String(topicName||"").toLowerCase().trim();
  const b=String(subject||"").toLowerCase().trim();
  if(a===b)return true;
  if(b==="english grammar"&&a==="english")return true;
  if(b==="economical issues"&&a==="economic issues")return true;
  if(b==="descriptive english"&&a==="descriptive english/writing")return true;
  if(b==="ca"&&a==="edutap ca")return true;
  return false;
}

function hasKids(id){return S.syllabus.some(x=>x.parentId===id&&!x.archived);}
function isTopicMastered(t){
  if(!t||t.archived)return false;
  // manual override wins
  if(t.status==="Mastered")return true;
  // otherwise: mastered if any of its sessions reached Mastered stage AND none are due for review
  const sessions=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.topicId===t.id);
  if(!sessions.length)return false;
  const anyMastered=sessions.some(s=>s.stage==="Mastered");
  if(!anyMastered)return false;
  // if any session is overdue, it's not truly mastered anymore
  const anyDue=sessions.some(s=>["overdue","today"].indexOf(reviewState(s).st)>-1);
  return !anyDue;
}
function topicDerivedStatus(t){const kids=S.syllabus.filter(x=>x.parentId===t.id&&!x.archived);if(!kids.length)return t.status;const statuses=kids.map(k=>topicDerivedStatus(k));if(statuses.every(s=>s==="Mastered"))return"Mastered";if(statuses.indexOf("Reviewing")>-1)return"Reviewing";if(statuses.indexOf("Practicing")>-1)return"Practicing";if(statuses.indexOf("Learning")>-1)return"Learning";return"Not started";}
function topicLeafCount(t){const kids=S.syllabus.filter(x=>x.parentId===t.id&&!x.archived);if(!kids.length)return 1;return kids.reduce((a,k)=>a+topicLeafCount(k),0);}
function topicLeafMastered(t){const kids=S.syllabus.filter(x=>x.parentId===t.id&&!x.archived);if(!kids.length)return t.status==="Mastered"?1:0;return kids.reduce((a,k)=>a+topicLeafMastered(k),0);}
function topicRow(t,depth,hasChildren,isCollapsed,childCount,focusMin){
  const d0=depth||0;const indent0=8+(d0*18);
  if(_bulkMode){
    const sel=_bulkSelection.has(t.id);
    return '<div class="topic-row'+(sel?' bulk-sel':'')+'" data-bulk-id="'+t.id+'" style="padding-left:'+indent0+'px;cursor:pointer;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;align-items:flex-start'+(d0>0?';background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) '+(d0===1?'2':'3')+'%,transparent)':'')+'"><div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;border:1.5px solid '+(sel?'var(--accent-2)':'var(--border-2)')+';display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--btn-primary-fg);background:'+(sel?'var(--accent-2)':'transparent')+';flex-shrink:0">'+(sel?'✓':'')+'</div><div style="min-width:0;flex:1"><div style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:'+(hasChildren?'700':'500')+';color:var(--text)">'+esc(t.topic)+'</div><div class="tags" style="margin-top:4px">'+examTags(t)+'</div></div></div>';
  }
  const pc=priClass(t.priority);const d=depth||0;const indent=8+(d*18);const fMin=focusMin||0;
  const isParent=hasKids(t.id);
  const displayStatus=isParent?topicDerivedStatus(t):t.status;
  const leafPct=isParent?Math.round(topicLeafMastered(t)/Math.max(1,topicLeafCount(t))*100):statusPct(t.status);
  const chev=hasChildren?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>':'<span style="width:14px;display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0"></span>';
  const folderIcon=hasChildren?'<span style="color:'+subjColor(t.subject)+';opacity:.5;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">▶</span>':'';
  const statusControl=isParent
    ?'<span class="pill" style="font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 9px;border-color:'+statusColor(displayStatus)+'33;background:'+statusColor(displayStatus)+'15;color:'+statusColor(displayStatus)+'">'+esc(displayStatus)+'</span>'
    :'<select class="mini-sel" data-change="syl-status" data-id="'+t.id+'">'+selOpts(taxList("statuses"),t.status)+'</select>';
  return '<div class="topic-row" data-id="'+t.id+'" data-depth="'+d+'" style="padding-left:'+indent+'px'+(d>0?';background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) '+(d===1?'2':'3')+'%,transparent)':'')+'">'
    +'<button class="mini-icon" data-action="toggle-topic" data-id="'+t.id+'" style="width:22px;height:22px;'+(hasChildren?'':'opacity:.3')+'"'+(hasChildren?'':' disabled')+'>'+chev+'</button>'
    +'<button class="drag-handle" data-drag-handle aria-label="Drag" tabindex="-1" style="touch-action:none"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="1" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="1" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="15" cy="6" r="1" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="15" cy="18" r="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>'
    +'<div class="topic-body" style="min-width:0">'
      +'<div style="display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">'+folderIcon+'<div class="name" data-action="topic-detail" data-id="'+t.id+'">'+esc(t.topic)+'</div>'+(t.priority?'<span class="pill '+pc+'" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px">'+esc(t.priority)+'</span>':'')+'</div>'
      +'<div class="tags">'+examTags(t)+(t.remarks?'<span class="tiny">📝</span>':"")+(fMin>0?'<span class="tiny">· '+fmtMin(fMin)+'</span>':"")+'</div>'
      +(leafPct>0?'<div style="margin-top:8px;max-width:340px">'+pbar(leafPct,isParent?subjColor(t.subject):statusColor(displayStatus))+'</div>':'')
    +'</div>'
    +'<div class="topic-controls">'
      +statusControl
      +'<select class="mini-sel" data-change="syl-priority" data-id="'+t.id+'"><option value="">—</option>'+selOpts(taxList("priorities"),t.priority)+'</select>'
      +'<select class="mini-sel" data-change="syl-weight" data-id="'+t.id+'"><option value="">—</option>'+selOpts(taxList("weights"),t.weightage)+'</select>'
      +'<div class="row-actions">'
        +'<button class="mini-icon" data-action="add-subtopic" data-id="'+t.id+'" title="Add subtopic">'+ICONS.plus+'</button>'
        +'<button class="mini-icon" data-action="edit-topic" data-id="'+t.id+'" title="Edit">'+ICONS.pencil+'</button>'
        +'<button class="mini-icon danger" data-action="del-topic" data-id="'+t.id+'" title="Archive">'+ICONS.trash+'</button>'
      +'</div>'
    +'</div>'
  +'</div>';
}
function renderSylList(){
  const list=sylFiltered();
  const visibleIds=new Set(list.map(t=>t.id));
  const childrenMap=new Map();
  for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
    const t=list[i];
    const isRoot=!t.parentId||!visibleIds.has(t.parentId);
    const key=isRoot?null:t.parentId;
    let arr=childrenMap.get(key);
    if(!arr){arr=[];childrenMap.set(key,arr);}
    arr.push(t);
  }
  const roots=(childrenMap.get(null)||[]).slice();
  const containerIds=new Set();
  for(const t of roots){
    if(isRedundantContainer(t.topic,t.subject))containerIds.add(t.id);
  }
  if(containerIds.size){
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const t=list[i];
      if(t.parentId&&containerIds.has(t.parentId)){
        let nullArr=childrenMap.get(null);
        if(!nullArr){nullArr=[];childrenMap.set(null,nullArr);}
        nullArr.push(t);
      }
    }
    const newRoots=(childrenMap.get(null)||[]).filter(t=>!containerIds.has(t.id));
    childrenMap.set(null,newRoots);
  }
  childrenMap.forEach((arr,k)=>{childrenMap.set(k,sortTopics(arr));});
  const focusMap=new Map();(S.focusLog||[]).forEach(f=>{if(f.topicId)focusMap.set(f.topicId,(focusMap.get(f.topicId)||0)+(f.minutes||0));});
  const groups={};for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){const t=list[i];(groups[t.subject]=groups[t.subject]||[]).push(t);}
  const order=getSubjectOrder();
  const subs=Object.keys(groups).sort((a,b)=>{const ia=order.indexOf(a),ib=order.indexOf(b);return(ia<0?999:ia)-(ib<0?999:ib)||a.localeCompare(b);});
  const el=$("#syl-list");if(!el)return;
  let out="";
  for(let si=0;si<subs.length;si++){
    const sub=subs[si];const allInSub=groups[sub];const totalCount=allInSub.length;
    let doneCount=0,sumPct=0;for(let i=0;i<allInSub.length;i++){if(allInSub[i].status==="Mastered")doneCount++;sumPct+=statusPct(allInSub[i].status);}
    const avg=totalCount?Math.round(sumPct/totalCount):0;
    const closed=sf.closed[sub];const orderIdx=order.indexOf(sub);const isFirst=orderIdx<=0,isLast=orderIdx>=order.length-1;
    const subjectIds=new Set(allInSub.map(t=>t.id));
    const subMap=new Map();
    subMap.set(null,(childrenMap.get(null)||[]).filter(t=>t.subject===sub));
    childrenMap.forEach((arr,k)=>{
      if(k===null)return;
      const filtered=arr.filter(t=>subjectIds.has(t.id));
      if(filtered.length)subMap.set(k,filtered);
    });
    const renderTreeSub=(pid,depth)=>{
      const kids=subMap.get(pid);if(!kids||!kids.length)return"";
      let html="";
      for(let i=0;i<kids.length;i++){const t=kids[i];const childArr=subMap.get(t.id);const hasChildren=!!(childArr&&childArr.length);const isCollapsed=!!sf.closedTopics[t.id];html+=topicRow(t,depth,hasChildren,isCollapsed,childArr?childArr.length:0,focusMap.get(t.id)||0);if(hasChildren&&!isCollapsed)html+=renderTreeSub(t.id,depth+1);}
      return html;
    };
    const bodyHTML=closed?"":renderTreeSub(null,0);
    out+='<div class="subj-group'+(closed?" closed":"")+'" data-subj="'+esc(sub)+'"><div class="subj-head" data-action="toggle-subj" data-id="'+esc(sub)+'"><i class="sdot" style="background:'+subjColor(sub)+'"></i><b>'+esc(sub)+'</b><span class="cnt">'+doneCount+'/'+totalCount+'</span><div class="pbar"><div class="pfill" style="width:'+avg+'%;background:'+subjColor(sub)+'"></div></div><span class="tiny">'+avg+'%</span><div class="subj-actions"><button class="mini-icon" data-action="subj-up" data-id="'+esc(sub)+'" title="Move up" '+(isFirst?"disabled":"")+'>'+ICONS.up+'</button><button class="mini-icon" data-action="subj-down" data-id="'+esc(sub)+'" title="Move down" '+(isLast?"disabled":"")+'>'+ICONS.down+'</button><button class="mini-icon danger" data-action="del-subject" data-id="'+esc(sub)+'" title="Delete subject">'+ICONS.trash+'</button></div><svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg></div><div class="subj-body">'+bodyHTML+'</div></div>';
  }
  el.innerHTML=out||'<div class="empty"><div class="ic">'+emptyArt("search")+'</div><b>No topics match</b><p>Clear a filter or search term.</p></div>';
  const c=$("#syl-count");if(c)c.textContent=list.length+" of "+S.syllabus.length+" topics";
}
function postSyllabus(){renderSylList();const q=$("#syl-q");if(q){let _sylSearchTmr;q.addEventListener("input",()=>{clearTimeout(_sylSearchTmr);_sylSearchTmr=setTimeout(()=>{sf.q=q.value.toLowerCase();renderSylList();},140);});}const exSel=$("#syl-exam");if(exSel)exSel.addEventListener("change",e=>{sf.exam=e.target.value;renderSylList();});const st=$("#syl-status");if(st)st.addEventListener("change",e=>{sf.status=e.target.value;renderSylList();});$$("[data-pri]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{const p=b.dataset.pri;sf.priority=sf.priority===p?"All":p;rerender();}));var _archBtn=$("[data-archived-toggle]");if(_archBtn)_archBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{sf.archived=!sf.archived;rerender();});}
function subjChangeGuard(){
  const subjectSel=document.querySelector('.modal [name="subject"]');
  const picker=document.querySelector('.modal .tpick');
  if(!subjectSel||!picker)return;
  subjectSel.addEventListener("change",()=>{
    const hidden=picker.querySelector('input[type=hidden]');
    if(!hidden)return;
    try{
      const ids=JSON.parse(hidden.value);
      if(ids&&ids.length){
        const t=topicById(ids[0]);
        if(t&&t.subject!==subjectSel.value){
          hidden.value="[]";
          const chips=picker.querySelector(".pick-chips");
          if(chips)chips.innerHTML="";
          toast("Parent cleared","Subject changed");
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  });
}

    +'<div class="f2"><div class="frow"><label>Priority</label><select class="inp" name="priority"><option value="">—</option>'+selOpts(taxList("priorities"),t?t.priority:"")+'</select></div><div class="frow"><label>Weightage</label><select class="inp" name="weightage"><option value="">—</option>'+selOpts(taxList("weights"),t?t.weightage:"")+'</select></div></div>'

    +'<div class="frow"><label>Parent topic (optional)</label>'+pickerHTML("parentIds",initParent?[initParent]:[],false)+'<div class="hint">Leave empty for a top-level topic.</div></div>'

    +'<div class="frow"><label>Study notes — shown on every review</label><textarea class="inp" name="notes" rows="4" placeholder="Formulas, tricks, what tripped you up. This shows on the review card.">'+esc(t?t.notes:"")+'</textarea></div>',
    v=>{
      if(!v.topic){toast("⚠️ Topic required");return false;}
      const parentIds=pickVals(v.parentIds);let parentId=parentIds[0]||null;
      if(t&&parentId){
        const descendants=new Set();const stack=[t.id];
        while(stack.length){const cid=stack.pop();S.syllabus.filter(x=>x.parentId===cid).forEach(x=>{descendants.add(x.id);stack.push(x.id);});}
        if(descendants.has(parentId)){toast("⚠️ Cannot set a descendant as parent");return false;}
        if(parentId===t.id){toast("⚠️ Cannot be its own parent");return false;}
      }
      const data={topic:v.topic,subject:v.subject||"other",status:v.status||"Not started",priority:v.priority||"",weightage:v.weightage||"",remarks:v.remarks||"",notes:v.notes||"",exams:Array.isArray(v.exams)?v.exams:(v.exams?[v.exams]:[]),parentId};
      if(data.subject&&taxList("subjects").indexOf(data.subject)<0)taxAdd("subjects",data.subject);
      edit(()=>{if(t)Object.assign(t,data);else S.syllabus.push(Object.assign({id:uid("t")},data));});
      toast(t?"Topic updated":"Topic added");
    },t?"Save":"Add");
}
function exportNotesHTML(){
  const topics=S.syllabus.filter(t=>t.notes&&t.notes.trim());
  if(!topics.length){toast("No notes to export","Add notes to a topic first");return;}
  const bySub={};
  topics.forEach(t=>{(bySub[t.subject]=bySub[t.subject]||[]).push(t);});
  const order=getSubjectOrder();
  const subs=Object.keys(bySub).sort((a,b)=>{
    const ia=order.indexOf(a),ib=order.indexOf(b);
    return (ia<0?999:ia)-(ib<0?999:ib)||a.localeCompare(b);
  });
  subs.forEach(sub=>{bySub[sub].sort((a,b)=>a.topic.localeCompare(b.topic));});
  const esc2=s=>String(s==null?"":s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
  const renderNotes=(notes)=>renderMath(notes).replace(/\n/g,"<br>");
  const sections=subs.map(sub=>{
    const list=bySub[sub];
    return '<section class="subj"><h2>'+esc2(sub)+'</h2>'+list.map(t=>'<article class="topic"><h3>'+esc2(t.topic)+'</h3><div class="notes">'+renderNotes(t.notes)+'</div></article>').join("")+'</section>';
  }).join("");
  const html='<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>Apex Notes — '+todayISO()+'</title>'
    +'<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.css">'
    +'<style>'
    +'*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}'
    +'body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Inter","Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;color:#18181b;background:#fff;line-height:1.65;padding:40px 32px;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;font-size:14px}'
    +'header{border-bottom:2px solid #18181b;padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:28px}'
    +'header h1{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:4px}'
    +'header .meta{font-size:12px;color:#71717a}'
    +'header .print-btn{float:right;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #18181b;background:#18181b;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}'
    +'section.subj{margin-bottom:36px}'
    +'section.subj h2{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#71717a;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e0}'
    +'article.topic{margin-bottom:22px;page-break-inside:avoid}'
    +'article.topic h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:6px}'
    +'article.topic .notes{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.75;color:#2a2a2a;white-space:pre-wrap}'
    +'article.topic .notes .katex{font-size:1.05em}'
    +'footer{margin-top:40px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #e5e5e0;font-size:11.5px;color:#a1a1aa;text-align:center}'
    +'@media print{body{padding:20px 16px;font-size:12.5px}header .print-btn{display:none}article.topic{page-break-inside:avoid}}'
    +'</style></head><body>'
    +'<header><button class="print-btn" onclick="setTimeout(function(){window.print();},80)">Print / Save as PDF</button>'
    +'<h1>Apex Notes — '+todayISO()+'</h1>'
    +'<div class="meta">'+topics.length+' topics · '+subs.length+' subjects</div>'
    +'</header>'
    +sections
    +'<footer style="margin-top:40px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #e5e5e0;font-size:11.5px;color:#a1a1aa;text-align:center"><span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;justify-content:center"><span style="display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:4px;background:#18181b;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif">A</span>Designed &amp; built by Ayush Tomar · Generated '+new Date().toLocaleString()+'</span></footer>'
    +'</body></html>';
  const blob=new Blob([html],{type:"text/html;charset=utf-8"});

  if(!win){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);toast("Popup blocked","Allow popups for this site to export");return;}

  toast("Notes opened in new tab",topics.length+" topics · ⌘P to save as PDF");

function bulkImportModal(){
  openModal("Bulk import topics",
    '<div class="frow"><label>Paste topics — one per line</label><textarea class="inp" name="data" rows="14" style="font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6" placeholder="Format: name, subject, exams (pipe-separated), priority, weightage&#10;Only name is required.&#10;&#10;Example:&#10;Water Pollution, environment, CHSL|CGL, Critical&#10;Air Quality Index, environment, CHSL|CGL, Critical, High&#10;Soil Erosion, geography, CGL, High, High&#10;Noise Pollution"></textarea><div class="hint">Comma-separated. <b>name</b> (required) · subject · exams (pipe-separated) · priority · weightage. Skips duplicates (same name + subject).</div></div>',
    v=>{
      const lines=(v.data||"").split("\n").map(l=>l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if(!lines.length){toast("Nothing to import");return false;}
      const existing=new Set(S.syllabus.map(t=>(t.topic+"::"+t.subject).toLowerCase()));
      let added=0,skipped=0;
      const newTopics=[];
      lines.forEach(line=>{
        const parts=line.split(",").map(p=>p.trim());
        const topic=parts[0];
        if(!topic)return;
        const subject=(parts[1]||"other").toLowerCase();
        const exams=parts[2]?parts[2].split("|").map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean):[];
        const priority=parts[3]||"";
        const weightage=parts[4]||"";
        const key=(topic+"::"+subject).toLowerCase();
        if(existing.has(key)){skipped++;return;}
        existing.add(key);
        newTopics.push({id:uid("t"),topic:topic,subject:subject,exams:exams,priority:priority,status:"Not started",weightage:weightage,remarks:"",notes:"",parentId:null});
        if(S.tax.subjects.indexOf(subject)<0)S.tax.subjects.push(subject);
        added++;
      });
      if(!added){toast("No new topics","All were duplicates");return false;}
      edit(()=>{S.syllabus.push(...newTopics);});
      toast("Imported "+added+(skipped?" · skipped "+skipped+" duplicates":""));
    },"Import");
}

function effectivenessBlockHTML(id){
  const e=topicEffectiveness(id);if(!e)return"";
  const rows=[];
  if(e.reviews>0){
    const color=e.recallPct>=70?"#10B981":e.recallPct>=50?"#F59E0B":"#EF4444";
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Recall</span><span><b style="color:'+color+'">'+e.recallPct+'% Good/Easy</b> <span class="tiny">· '+e.reviews+' reviews</span></span></div>');
  }else{
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Recall</span><span class="tiny">not yet reviewed</span></div>');
  }
  if(e.recentErrs||e.olderErrs){
    const trend=e.olderErrs>0&&e.recentErrs<e.olderErrs?"↘ improving":(e.recentErrs>e.olderErrs?"↗ worsening":"→ steady");
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Errors</span><span><b>'+e.olderErrs+' → '+e.recentErrs+'</b> <span class="tiny">· last 30d '+trend+'</span></span></div>');
  }
  if(e.mockTags){
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Mocks</span><span><b>'+e.mockTags+'</b> <span class="tiny">· '+e.recentMockTags+' in last 30d</span></span></div>');
  }
  if(e.totalMin>0){
    const bd=[e.focusMin>0?"⚡ "+fmtMin(e.focusMin):"",e.sessMin>0?"📝 "+fmtMin(e.sessMin):""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    let paired="";
    if(e.recallPct!==null){
      const minHrs=e.totalMin/60;
      let read="";
      if(e.recallPct>=75)read=minHrs<=2?"cheap — strong recall on low investment":"strong recall — investment is paying off";
      else if(e.recallPct>=55)read=minHrs>=5?"expensive — middling recall on high investment":"middling recall — worth another pass";
      else read=minHrs>=4?"expensive — weak recall on high investment — change approach":"weak recall — keep investing, it hasn't stuck yet";
      paired=" · "+read;
    }
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Investment</span><span><b>'+fmtMin(e.totalMin)+'</b> <span class="tiny">· '+bd+paired+'</span></span></div>');
  }else if(e.sessCount>0){
    rows.push('<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2)">Investment</span><span class="tiny">'+e.sessCount+' session'+(e.sessCount===1?"":"s")+' · no duration logged</span></div>');
  }
  const vColor=e.verdictClass==="good"?"#10B981":e.verdictClass==="bad"?"#EF4444":"var(--text-2)";
  rows.push('<div style="padding:10px 0 2px;font-size:12.5px;color:'+vColor+';font-weight:600">'+esc(e.verdict)+'</div>');
  return '<div class="detail-block" style="border-left:2px solid var(--accent-2)"><h5>Effectiveness</h5>'+rows.join("")+'</div>';
}
function notesEditor(topicId){
  const t=topicById(topicId);
  if(!t)return;
  openModal("Notes — "+t.topic,
'<div class="frow"><label>Study notes</label><textarea class="inp" name="notes" rows="14" style="font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.65" placeholder="Formulas, tricks, what trips you up.&#10;&#10;LaTeX supported:&#10;  $$formula$$ for display math&#10;  \\(formula\\) for inline math">'+esc(t.notes||"")+'</textarea><div class="hint">Rendered on every review card for this topic. Display math: wrap in double dollar signs. Inline math: wrap in backslash-paren pairs.</div></div>',    v=>{
      edit(()=>{t.notes=v.notes||"";});
      toast("Notes saved");
    },"Save");
}

function pyqModal(prefillTopicId){
  const defaultExam=S.settings.readinessExam||"";
  openModal("Log practice session",
    '<div class="frow"><label>Topic</label>'+pickerHTML("topicIds",prefillTopicId?[prefillTopicId]:[],false)+'</div>'
    +'<div class="frow"><label>Exam <span style="color:var(--text-3);font-weight:500">(optional)</span></label><select class="inp" name="examTag"><option value="">— Unscoped (counts for all exams) —</option>'+selOpts(taxList("exams"),defaultExam)+'</select><div class="hint">Tagged records count only for that exam. Leave blank for mixed practice.</div></div>'
    +'<div class="f2"><div class="frow"><label>Attempted</label><input class="inp" type="number" min="1" name="attempted" placeholder="20" autofocus></div><div class="frow"><label>Correct</label><input class="inp" type="number" min="0" name="correct" placeholder="17"></div></div>'
    +'<div class="f2"><div class="frow"><label>Avg time / Q (sec)</label><input class="inp" type="number" min="0" name="avgTimeSec" placeholder="45"></div><div class="frow"><label>Date</label>'+dateFieldHTML("date",todayISO())+'</div></div>'
    +'<div class="frow"><label>Source</label><input class="inp" name="source" placeholder="e.g. Kiran PYQ 2019"></div>',
    function(v){
      var ids=pickVals(v.topicIds);
      var att=parseInt(v.attempted,10)||0;
      var cor=parseInt(v.correct,10)||0;
      if(!ids[0]){toast("Pick a topic");return false;}
      if(att<1){toast("Attempted must be ≥ 1");return false;}
      if(cor>att){toast("Correct can't exceed attempted");return false;}
      snapshot();
      S.pyqLog.push({
        id:uid("p"),
        topicId:ids[0],
        examTag:(v.examTag||"").trim(),
        date:v.date||todayISO(),
        attempted:att,
        correct:cor,
        avgTimeSec:parseInt(v.avgTimeSec,10)||null,
        source:(v.source||"").trim()
      });
      logActivity("pyq.logged",ids[0],{attempted:att,correct:cor,examTag:(v.examTag||"").trim()});
      saveLocal();
      rerender();
      toast("Logged","+"+att+" Q · "+Math.round(cor/att*100)+"% correct");
    },"Log");
}

function topicFocusNotes(topicId){
  if(!topicId)return[];
  return (S.focusLog||[]).filter(function(f){return f.topicId===topicId&&(f.win||f.gap);}).slice(-3).reverse();

function _fcEnabled(){return S.settings&&S.settings.flashcardMode===true;}
function _fcLocked(s){
  if(!_fcEnabled())return false;
  if(!s||!s.topicId)return false;
  const t=topicById(s.topicId);
  const hasTopicNote=!!(t&&t.notes);
  const hasFocusNote=(typeof topicFocusNotes==="function"?topicFocusNotes(s.topicId).length:0)>0;
  return hasTopicNote||hasFocusNote;
}

}

function mockSectionsHTML(m){
  const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
  const sec=m.sections||{};
  const filled=set.sections.filter(s=>typeof sec[s.key]==="number");
  if(!filled.length)return"";
  const sorted=filled.slice().sort((a,b)=>sec[a.key]-sec[b.key]);
  const weakest=sorted[0].key;
  return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat('+filled.length+',1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:10px">'
    +filled.map(s=>{
      const v=sec[s.key];
      const c=v>=70?"#10B981":v>=50?"#F59E0B":"#EF4444";
      const isWeak=s.key===weakest&&filled.length>1;
      return '<div style="padding:8px 6px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid '+(isWeak?"var(--pri-critical-bd)":"var(--border)")+';background:'+(isWeak?"var(--pri-critical-bg)":"var(--surface-2)")+';text-align:center"><div class="tiny" style="font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:10px">'+esc(s.label)+'</div><div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:'+c+';margin-top:2px;line-height:1.1">'+v+'<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;opacity:.6">%</span></div></div>';
    }).join("")+'</div>';
}
function mockSuggestedTopics(m){
  const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
  const sec=m.sections||{};
  const filled=set.sections.filter(s=>typeof sec[s.key]==="number");
  if(!filled.length)return[];
  const weakest=filled.slice().sort((a,b)=>sec[a.key]-sec[b.key])[0];
  const existing=new Set(m.weak||[]);
  const candidates=S.syllabus.filter(t=>{if(existing.has(t.id))return false;if(weakest.subjects.indexOf(t.subject)<0)return false;return true;});
  const ranked=candidates.map(t=>{
    let score=0;
    if(t.priority==="Critical")score+=3;else if(t.priority==="High")score+=2;else if(t.priority==="Medium")score+=1;
    if(t.weightage==="High")score+=2;
    if(t.status==="Learning")score+=1.5;else if(t.status==="Practicing")score+=1;else if(t.status==="Not started")score+=0.5;
    return {t,score};
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.t.topic.localeCompare(b.t.topic)).slice(0,3);
  return ranked.map(r=>r.t);
}
function mockSuggestedHTML(m){
  const sug=mockSuggestedTopics(m);
  if(!sug.length)return"";
  const set=getMockSectionSet(m);
  const sec=m.sections||{};
  const filled=set.sections.filter(s=>typeof sec[s.key]==="number");
  const weakest=filled.slice().sort((a,b)=>sec[a.key]-sec[b.key])[0];
  return '<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px dashed var(--border-2)"><div class="tiny" style="margin-bottom:7px;font-weight:600">Weakest section was <b style="color:var(--pri-critical-fg)">'+esc(weakest.label)+'</b> ('+sec[weakest.key]+'%). Suggested topics to tag:</div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+sug.map(t=>'<button class="chip" data-action="mock-tag-topic" data-id="'+t.id+'" data-mock="'+m.id+'" style="padding:4px 10px;min-height:28px;font-size:11.5px">+ '+esc(t.topic)+'</button>').join("")+'</div></div>';
}
function sectionChart(){
  const ms=S.mocks.filter(m=>m.date&&m.sections&&Object.keys(m.sections).length).sort((a,b)=>a.date<b.date?-1:1);
  if(ms.length<2)return"";
  const setIds=[...new Set(ms.map(m=>m.sectionSet))];
  const W=680,H=240,PL=38,PR=90,PT=16,PB=30;
  const X=i=>ms.length===1?PL+(W-PL-PR)/2:PL+i*(W-PL-PR)/(ms.length-1);
  const Y=v=>PT+(100-Math.max(0,Math.min(100,+v||0)))*(H-PT-PB)/100;
  const colors=["#8B5CF6","#F59E0B","#10B981","#3B82F6","#EC4899","#06B6D4","#84CC16"];
  const grid=[0,25,50,75,100].map(v=>'<line x1="'+PL+'" y1="'+Y(v)+'" x2="'+(W-PR)+'" y2="'+Y(v)+'" stroke="color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 6%,transparent)"/><text x="'+(PL-8)+'" y="'+(Y(v)+4)+'" fill="var(--text-3)" font-size="10" text-anchor="end">'+v+'</text>').join("");
  const xlab=ms.map((m,i)=>'<text x="'+X(i)+'" y="'+(H-8)+'" fill="var(--text-3)" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">'+fmtD(m.date)+'</text>').join("");
  let lines="",colorIdx=0;
  setIds.forEach(setId=>{
    const set=getSectionSet(setId);
    set.sections.forEach(s=>{
      const pts=[];
      ms.forEach((m,i)=>{if(m.sectionSet!==setId)return;const v=m.sections[s.key];if(typeof v==="number")pts.push([X(i),Y(v),i]);});
      if(pts.length<2)return;
      const col=colors[colorIdx%colors.length];colorIdx++;
      lines+='<polyline points="'+pts.map(p=>p[0].toFixed(1)+","+p[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ")+'" fill="none" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
      lines+=pts.map(p=>'<circle cx="'+p[0].toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p[1].toFixed(1)+'" r="4" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="2.5"><title>'+esc(s.label)+' — '+esc(ms[p[2]].title)+'</title></circle>').join("");
    });
  });
  if(!lines)return"";
  return '<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'">'+grid+xlab+lines+'</svg>';
}

  const sets=mockSectionSets();

  const sec=(m&&m.sections)||{};

    '<div class="frow"><label>Title</label><input class="inp" name="title" value="'+esc(m?m.title:"")+'" placeholder="e.g. CGL PYQ 2025"></div>'

      const sections={};

      const data={title:v.title,date:v.date||todayISO(),type:v.type,raw:parseFloat(v.raw)||0,percentile:parseFloat(v.percentile)||0,accuracy:parseFloat(v.accuracy)||0,weak:m?(m.weak||[]):[],sections:sections,sectionSet:setId,examTag:v.examTag||""};
      edit(()=>{if(m)Object.assign(m,data);else S.mocks.push(Object.assign({id:uid("m")},data));logActivity("mock.logged",m?m.id:S.mocks[S.mocks.length-1].id,{title:data.title,type:data.type,percentile:data.percentile});});
      toast(m?"Mock updated":"Mock logged");
    },m?"Save":"Log");
  const setSel=document.querySelector("#mock-section-set");
  const box=document.querySelector("#mock-sections-box");

    });
  }
}

function _weekISO(off){const d=mondayOf(off);return d.getFullYear()+"-"+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");}
function _trendBar(pct,color){
  var h=Math.max(2,Math.min(100,pct));
  return '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0"><div style="flex:1;width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:5px;position:relative;overflow:hidden"><div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:'+h+'%;background:'+color+';border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 0 12px '+color+'66;transition:height .4s ease"></div></div><div style="font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-3);text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%">'+pct+'</div></div>';
}
function viewHabitsTrend(){
  var weeks=[];
  for(var i=11;i>=0;i--){
    var off=-i;
    var dISO=_weekISO(off);
    var endISO=addDays(dISO,6);
    var st=weekStats(off);
    var rev=0,errRev=0;
    S.sessions.forEach(function(s){(s.history||[]).forEach(function(h){if(h.date&&h.date>=dISO&&h.date<=endISO)rev++;});});
    S.errors.forEach(function(e){(e.history||[]).forEach(function(h){if(h.date&&h.date>=dISO&&h.date<=endISO)errRev++;});});
    weeks.push({off:off,dISO:dISO,endISO:endISO,pct:st.pct,mins:st.studyMins,rev:rev+errRev});
  }
  var active=weeks.filter(function(w){return w.pct>0||w.mins>0||w.rev>0;});
  if(!active.length){
    return '<div class="card"><div class="empty" style="padding:40px 20px"><b>Not enough data yet</b><p>Log study hours for a few days, then come back to see your trend across the last 12 weeks.</p></div></div>';
  }
  var avg=Math.round(weeks.reduce(function(a,w){return a+w.pct;},0)/12);
  var thisWeek=weeks[11];
  var last4=weeks.slice(8);
  var avg4=Math.round(last4.reduce(function(a,w){return a+w.pct;},0)/4);
  var delta=thisWeek.pct-avg4;
  var deltaTxt=delta>0?("+"+delta+"%"):(delta<0?("-"+Math.abs(delta)+"%"):"0%");
  var deltaCol=delta>0?"#10B981":(delta<0?"#EF4444":"var(--text-3)");
  var withPct=weeks.filter(function(w){return w.pct>0;});
  var best=withPct.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.pct-a.pct;})[0];
  var bestTxt=best?best.pct+"% ("+fmtD(best.dISO)+")":"—";
  var maxRev=Math.max.apply(null,weeks.map(function(w){return w.rev;}).concat([1]));
  var habitBars=weeks.map(function(w,idx){
    var label="W"+(idx+1);
    var color=idx===11?"var(--accent)":"var(--accent-2)";
    return '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0"><div style="flex:1;width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:5px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;height:150px"><div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:'+Math.max(2,Math.min(100,w.pct))+'%;background:'+color+';border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 0 12px '+color+'55"></div></div><div style="font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-3)">'+label+'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  var revBars=weeks.map(function(w,idx){
    var pct=maxRev?Math.round(w.rev/maxRev*100):0;
    var color=idx===11?"var(--accent)":"var(--accent-2)";
    return '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0"><div style="flex:1;width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:5px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;height:100px"><div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:'+Math.max(2,pct)+'%;background:'+color+';border-radius:5px"></div></div><div style="font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-3)">'+w.rev+'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  var weekLabels=weeks.map(function(w,idx){
    return '<div style="font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-3);text-align:center">'+fmtD(w.dISO)+'</div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h2>Habit consistency</h2><span class="sub">last 12 weeks</span></div>'
    +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:6px;height:170px;margin-bottom:6px">'+habitBars+'</div>'
    +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px">'+weekLabels+'</div>'
    +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">'

function validateImport(d){
  if(!d||typeof d!=="object"||Array.isArray(d))return"Not an object";
  if(!Array.isArray(d.syllabus))return"Missing 'syllabus' array";
  for(let i=0;i<d.syllabus.length;i++){
    const t=d.syllabus[i];
    if(!t||typeof t!=="object")return"syllabus["+i+"] not an object";
    if(typeof t.id!=="string")return"syllabus["+i+"].id missing";
    if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(t.id))return"syllabus["+i+"].id has invalid characters";
    if(typeof t.topic!=="string")return"syllabus["+i+"].topic missing";
    if(typeof t.subject!=="string")return"syllabus["+i+"].subject missing";
  }
  const arrKeys=["sessions","errors","mocks","tasks","links","focusLog"];
  for(const k of arrKeys){
    if(d[k]===undefined)continue;
    if(!Array.isArray(d[k]))return"'"+k+"' must be an array";
    for(let i=0;i<d[k].length;i++){
      const item=d[k][i];
      if(!item||typeof item!=="object")return k+"["+i+"] not an object";
      if(typeof item.id!=="string")return k+"["+i+"].id missing";
      if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(item.id))return k+"["+i+"].id has invalid characters";
    }
  }
  if(d.habits!==undefined){
    if(typeof d.habits!=="object"||Array.isArray(d.habits))return"'habits' must be an object";
    for(const date of Object.keys(d.habits)){
      if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date))return"habits key '"+date+"' not a valid date";
      const day=d.habits[date];
      if(!day||typeof day!=="object"||Array.isArray(day))return"habits['"+date+"'] not an object";
    }
  }
  if(d.habitDefs!==undefined&&!Array.isArray(d.habitDefs))return"'habitDefs' must be an array";
  if(d.settings!==undefined&&(typeof d.settings!=="object"||Array.isArray(d.settings)))return"'settings' must be an object";
  return null;
}
function mergeStates(base,incoming){
  const out=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(base));
  const mergeArr=(key,idField)=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(incoming[key]))return;
    if(!Array.isArray(out[key]))out[key]=[];
    const seen=new Set(out[key].map(x=>x&&x[idField]));
    incoming[key].forEach(item=>{if(item&&!seen.has(item[idField]))out[key].push(item);});
  };
  mergeArr("syllabus","id");
  mergeArr("sessions","id");
  mergeArr("errors","id");
  mergeArr("mocks","id");
  mergeArr("tasks","id");
  mergeArr("links","id");
  mergeArr("focusLog","id");
  mergeArr("scratch","id");
  mergeArr("pyqLog","id");
  mergeArr("questions","id");
  mergeArr("resources","id");
  mergeArr("activity","id");
  if(incoming.habits&&typeof incoming.habits==="object"){
    if(!out.habits||typeof out.habits!=="object")out.habits={};
    Object.keys(incoming.habits).forEach(date=>{
      if(!out.habits[date]){out.habits[date]=incoming.habits[date];return;}
      const day=incoming.habits[date];
      if(!day||typeof day!=="object")return;
      Object.keys(day).forEach(k=>{
        if(out.habits[date][k]===undefined)out.habits[date][k]=day[k];
      });
    });
  }
  if(incoming.tombstones&&typeof incoming.tombstones==="object"){
    if(!out.tombstones||typeof out.tombstones!=="object")out.tombstones={};
    Object.keys(incoming.tombstones).forEach(coll=>{
      if(!out.tombstones[coll]||typeof out.tombstones[coll]!=="object")out.tombstones[coll]={};
      const inc=incoming.tombstones[coll];
      if(!inc||typeof inc!=="object")return;
      Object.keys(inc).forEach(id=>{
        const existing=out.tombstones[coll][id]||0;
        const v=inc[id]||0;
        if(v>existing)out.tombstones[coll][id]=v;
      });
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function examTargetModal(t){
  const exams=taxList("exams");
  const pris=["Primary","Secondary","Backup"];
  const isNew=!t;
  const body='<div class="frow"><label>Label</label><input class="inp" name="label" value="'+esc(t?t.label:"")+'" placeholder="e.g. SSC CGL Tier 1" autofocus></div>'
    +'<div class="f2"><div class="frow"><label>Date</label>'+dateFieldHTML("date",(t&&t.date)||"")+'</div><div class="frow"><label>Priority</label><select class="inp" name="priority">'+selOpts(pris,(t&&t.priority)||"Primary")+'</select></div></div>'
    +'<div class="frow"><label>Exam tag (links to your syllabus)</label><select class="inp" name="examTag"><option value="">— None (generic) —</option>'+selOpts(exams,(t&&t.examTag)||"")+'</select><div class="hint">Pick the tag your syllabus topics are tagged with. A topic inherits urgency from the nearest exam whose tag matches its own.</div></div>';
  openModal(isNew?"Add exam target":"Edit exam target",body,v=>{
    if(!v.label||!v.label.trim()){toast("⚠️ Label required");return false;}
    if(!v.date){toast("⚠️ Date required");return false;}
    const data={label:v.label.trim(),date:v.date,priority:v.priority||"Primary",examTag:v.examTag||""};
    snapshot();
    if(t){Object.assign(t,data);}
    else{if(!Array.isArray(S.settings.exams))S.settings.exams=[];S.settings.exams.push(Object.assign({id:uid("ex")},data));}
    saveLocal();rerender();
    // reopen the manager so the user sees the updated list
    setTimeout(openExamsManager,60);
    toast(isNew?"Exam added":"Exam updated");

function _renderThemeGridHTML(){
  const currentNonFeatured=!THEMES.find(t=>t.id===S.settings.theme&&t.featured);
  const showAll=S.settings.showAllThemes||currentNonFeatured;
  const visible=showAll?THEMES:THEMES.filter(t=>t.featured);
  const advancedCount=THEMES.filter(t=>!t.featured).length;
  return '<div class="theme-grid">'+visible.map(t=>'<div class="theme-sw'+(S.settings.theme===t.id?" on":"")+'" data-theme-pick="'+t.id+'"><div class="sw">'+t.colors.map(cc=>'<span style="background:'+cc+'"></span>').join("")+'</div><div class="tn">'+t.name+'</div><div class="td">'+t.desc+'</div></div>').join("")+'</div>'
    +(!currentNonFeatured
      ? (showAll
          ? '<button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="toggle-all-themes" style="margin-top:12px;width:100%;justify-content:center">Show featured only</button>'
          : '<button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="toggle-all-themes" style="margin-top:12px;width:100%;justify-content:center">Show '+advancedCount+' more themes</button>')
      : '');
}

function _rerenderThemeGrid(){
  const modal=document.querySelector(".modal");
  if(!modal)return;
  const oldGrid=modal.querySelector(".theme-grid");
  if(!oldGrid)return;
  const wrap=oldGrid.parentNode;
  const btn=wrap.querySelector('[data-action="toggle-all-themes"]');
  if(btn)btn.remove();
  const tmp=document.createElement("div");
  tmp.innerHTML=_renderThemeGridHTML();
  while(tmp.firstChild)wrap.appendChild(tmp.firstChild);
  oldGrid.remove();
}
function activateSettTab(root, tabId){
  if(!root) return;
  const tabs = root.querySelectorAll("[data-sett-tab-btn]");
  const panes = root.querySelectorAll("[data-sett-pane]");
  tabs.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.settTabBtn===tabId));
  panes.forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.settPane===tabId));
  const m = document.querySelector(".modal");
  if(m) m.scrollTop = 0;
}
