let _drag={active:false,id:null,overId:null,subject:null,row:null,ghost:null};
function _dragStart(e,handle){if(e.button!==undefined&&e.button!==0)return;const row=handle.closest(".topic-row");if(!row)return;const t=topicById(row.dataset.id);if(!t)return;e.preventDefault();const r=row.getBoundingClientRect();const ghost=document.createElement("div");ghost.className="drag-ghost";ghost.textContent=t.topic;ghost.style.left=(r.left+r.width/2)+"px";ghost.style.top=(r.top+r.height/2)+"px";document.body.appendChild(ghost);_drag={active:true,id:t.id,overId:null,subject:t.subject,row:row,ghost:ghost};row.classList.add("dragging");document.body.style.userSelect="none";document.body.style.cursor="grabbing";document.addEventListener("pointermove",_dragMove,{passive:false});document.addEventListener("pointerup",_dragEnd);document.addEventListener("pointercancel",_dragEnd);}
function _dragMove(e){if(!_drag.active)return;e.preventDefault();_drag.ghost.style.left=e.clientX+"px";_drag.ghost.style.top=e.clientY+"px";const el=document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY);const target=el?el.closest(".topic-row"):null;document.querySelectorAll(".topic-row.drag-over").forEach(r=>r.classList.remove("drag-over"));if(target&&target!==_drag.row){const tt=topicById(target.dataset.id);if(tt&&tt.subject===_drag.subject){target.classList.add("drag-over");_drag.overId=tt.id;return;}}_drag.overId=null;const y=e.clientY;if(y<80)window.scrollBy(0,-8);else if(y>window.innerHeight-80)window.scrollBy(0,8);}
function _dragEnd(){if(!_drag.active)return;document.removeEventListener("pointermove",_dragMove);document.removeEventListener("pointerup",_dragEnd);document.removeEventListener("pointercancel",_dragEnd);if(_drag.ghost)_drag.ghost.remove();if(_drag.row)_drag.row.classList.remove("dragging");document.querySelectorAll(".topic-row.drag-over").forEach(r=>r.classList.remove("drag-over"));document.body.style.userSelect="";document.body.style.cursor="";const id=_drag.id,overId=_drag.overId,subject=_drag.subject;_drag={active:false};if(id&&overId&&id!==overId)reorderTopic(id,overId,subject);}

"fs-merge":async()=>{
  try{
    const snap=await firebase.firestore().collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room).get();
    if(snap.exists&&snap.data().enc){
      const remote=await decryptState(snap.data().enc);
      _applyingRemote=true;
      S=mergeForSync(S,remote);
      S.schemaVersion=SCHEMA_VERSION;
      S.sync={enabled:true,room:S.sync.room};
      _applyingRemote=false;
      store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
      applyTheme(S.settings.theme||"obsidian");
      rerender();
    }
    closeModal();
    await pushNow(true);
    startSync();
    toast("Merged ✓","Both sides combined · syncing now");
  }catch(e){toast("⚠️ Merge failed",e.message);}
},

(function neoMinimalGlow(){
  let mx=window.innerWidth/2,my=window.innerHeight/2,rx=mx,ry=my,raf=null;
  const root=document.documentElement;
  const tick=()=>{
    rx+=(mx-rx)*.20; ry+=(my-ry)*.20;
    root.style.setProperty("--mx",rx.toFixed(1)+"px");
    root.style.setProperty("--my",ry.toFixed(1)+"px");
    if(Math.abs(mx-rx)>.5||Math.abs(my-ry)>.5){raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
    else{raf=null;}
  };
  document.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{
    mx=e.clientX; my=e.clientY;
    if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  },{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{mx=window.innerWidth/2;my=window.innerHeight/2;if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);});
  root.style.setProperty("--mx",mx+"px");
  root.style.setProperty("--my",my+"px");
})();

  if(window.matchMedia("(max-width:860px)").matches)return;
  const dot=document.createElement("div");dot.id="aurora-cursor";
  const ring=document.createElement("div");ring.id="aurora-cursor-ring";
  document.body.appendChild(dot);
  document.body.appendChild(ring);
  let mx=window.innerWidth/2,my=window.innerHeight/2,rx=mx,ry=my,shown=false;
  const isInteractive=el=>el&&el.closest&&el.closest("a,button,[data-action],[data-nav],[data-rtab],[data-tf],[data-hd-add],.chip,.nav-item,.bn-item,.topic-row,.row-item,.grade-btn,.mini-icon,.icon-btn,.spec,.card.hover,[role=button]");
  document.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{
    mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;
    dot.style.left=mx+"px";dot.style.top=my+"px";
    if(!shown){dot.classList.add("visible");ring.classList.add("visible");shown=true;}
    if(isInteractive(e.target)){dot.classList.add("hover");ring.classList.add("hover");}
    else{dot.classList.remove("hover");ring.classList.remove("hover");}
  });
  document.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{dot.classList.remove("visible");ring.classList.remove("visible");shown=false;});
  function tick(){
    if(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')!=='aurora'){setTimeout(tick,1000);return;}
    rx+=(mx-rx)*.18;
    ry+=(my-ry)*.18;
    ring.style.left=rx+"px";ring.style.top=ry+"px";
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  tick();

(function cleanupLegacyKeys(){
  try{
    store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
    let freed=0,removed=[];
    (OLD_KEYS||[]).forEach(k=>{
      if(k===KEY)return;
      const v=localStorage.getItem(k);
      if(v){freed+=v.length;localStorage.removeItem(k);removed.push(k);}
    });
    if(removed.length){const kb=Math.round(freed/1024);console.log("[Apex] Cleaned "+removed.length+" legacy keys ("+removed.join(", ")+"), freed ~"+kb+" KB");}
    else{console.log("[Apex] No legacy keys to clean.");}
  }catch(e){console.warn("[Apex] Cleanup skipped:",e.message);}
})();
function renderMath(str){
  if(!str)return"";
  if(!window.katex)return esc(str);
  const src=String(str);
  const cacheKey = "katex::" + src;
  /* Global cache — persists across renders, invalidated only on notes change */
  if(!window._katexCache) window._katexCache = new Map();
  if(window._katexCache.has(cacheKey)) return window._katexCache.get(cacheKey);

  const out=[];
  const pattern=/\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$|\\\(([\s\S]+?)\\\)/g;
  let last=0,m;
  while((m=pattern.exec(src))!==null){
    if(m.index>last)out.push(esc(src.slice(last,m.index)));
    const expr=(m[1]||m[2]).trim();
    const isDisplay=!!m[1];
    try{
      out.push(window.katex.renderToString(expr,{displayMode:isDisplay,throwOnError:false,output:"html"}));
    }catch(e){
      out.push(esc(m[0]));
    }
    last=m.index+m[0].length;
  }
  if(last<src.length)out.push(esc(src.slice(last)));
  const result = out.join("");
  window._katexCache.set(cacheKey, result);
  /* Keep cache size bounded */
  if(window._katexCache.size > 400) {
    const firstKey = window._katexCache.keys().next().value;
    window._katexCache.delete(firstKey);
  }
  return result;
}
function logActivity(kind, ref, meta){
  try{
    if(!Array.isArray(S.activity))S.activity=[];
if(!Array.isArray(S.questions))S.questions=[];
    S.activity.push({id:uid("a"),ts:Date.now(),kind:kind,ref:ref||null,meta:meta||{}});
    if(S.activity.length>5000)S.activity=S.activity.slice(-5000);
  }catch(e){}
}
function activitySince(ms){
  if(!Array.isArray(S.activity))return[];
  return S.activity.filter(function(x){return x.ts>=ms;});
}
function activitySummary(sinceMs){
  const events=activitySince(sinceMs||0);
  const byKind={};
  events.forEach(function(e){byKind[e.kind]=(byKind[e.kind]||0)+1;});
  return byKind;
}
function estimateStorageSize(){
  try{
    let bytes=0;
    for(const k in localStorage){
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(localStorage,k)){
        bytes += k.length + (localStorage.getItem(k)||"").length;
      }
    }
    return bytes*2;
  }catch(e){ return 0; }
}

function checkStorageHealth(){
  const bytes=estimateStorageSize();
  const mb=bytes/1048576;
  const pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(mb/5*100));
  return {pct,mb,needsPrune:pct>=80};
}

function pruneOldData(){
  const result={pruned:0};
  if(Array.isArray(S.focusLog)&&S.focusLog.length>500){
    result.pruned+=S.focusLog.length-500;
    S.focusLog=S.focusLog.slice(-500);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(S.activity)&&S.activity.length>1000){
    result.pruned+=S.activity.length-1000;
    S.activity=S.activity.slice(-1000);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(S.questions)&&S.questions.length>2000){
    result.pruned+=S.questions.length-2000;
    S.questions=S.questions.slice(-2000);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(S.sessions)){
    S.sessions.forEach(function(s){
      if(Array.isArray(s.history)&&s.history.length>200){
        result.pruned+=s.history.length-200;
        s.history=s.history.slice(-200);
      }
    });
  }
  if(Array.isArray(S.errors)){
    S.errors.forEach(function(e){
      if(Array.isArray(e.history)&&e.history.length>200){
        result.pruned+=e.history.length-200;
        e.history=e.history.slice(-200);
      }
    });
  }
  if(Array.isArray(S.mocks)&&S.mocks.length>500){
    result.pruned+=S.mocks.length-500;
    S.mocks=S.mocks.slice(-500);
  }
  /* Orphan sweep: sessions/errors whose topic no longer exists */
  if(Array.isArray(S.syllabus)){
    var validTopics = {};
    S.syllabus.forEach(function(t){ if(t&&t.id) validTopics[t.id]=1; });
    if(Array.isArray(S.sessions)){
      S.sessions.forEach(function(s){
        if(s && s.topicId && !validTopics[s.topicId]){
          result.pruned++;
          s.topicId = null;
        }
      });
    }
    if(Array.isArray(S.errors)){
      S.errors.forEach(function(e){
        if(e && e.topicId && !validTopics[e.topicId]){
          result.pruned++;
          e.topicId = null;
        }
      });
    }
  }
  saveLocal();
  return result;
}

function warnStorageIfNeeded(){
  const health=checkStorageHealth();
  if(!health.needsPrune)return;
  if(route()!=="dashboard")return;
  if(document.getElementById("apex-storage-warn"))return;
  const view=document.getElementById("view");
  if(!view)return;
  const anchor=view.querySelector(".hero-head")||view.firstElementChild;
  if(!anchor)return;
  const b=document.createElement("div");
  b.id="apex-storage-warn";
  b.className="card";
  b.style.cssText="border-left:3px solid var(--pri-medium-fg);padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap";
  b.innerHTML='<div style="flex:1;min-width:220px"><div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:3px">Storage at '+health.pct+'%</div><div class="tiny" style="line-height:1.55">Apex is using '+health.mb.toFixed(2)+' MB of your browser\'s ~5 MB storage. Prune old activity to keep things smooth.</div></div>'
    +'<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn primary sm" data-action="prune-storage">Prune old data</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-action="dismiss-storage-warn">Dismiss</button></div>';
  anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(b,anchor.nextSibling);
}
function saveLocal(){
  S._lastLocalEdit=new Date().toISOString();
  getDeviceId();
  const ok=store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
  const bar=document.getElementById("savebar");
  if(!ok){
    if(bar){
      bar.style.display="block";
      bar.textContent="⚠️ SAVE FAILED — recent changes are NOT on disk. Free up browser storage or export a backup now.";
    }
  } else if(bar && bar.style.display==="block"){
    bar.style.display="none";
    bar.textContent="";
  }
  updateBadges();
  queueSync();
}
async function pushNow(silent){
  if(!S.sync.enabled||!S.sync.room||!syncKey)return;
  try{
    setSyncStatus("syncing");
    if(!await initFirebase()){setSyncStatus("error");if(!silent)toast("⚠️ Firebase not configured");return;}
    const db=firebase.firestore();
    const ref=db.collection("exam_os_rooms").doc(S.sync.room);
    let needMerge=false;
    try{
      const snap=await ref.get();
      if(snap.exists){
        const data=snap.data();
        if(data&&data.updatedAt&&S._lastSync&&data.updatedAt>S._lastSync&&S._lastLocalEdit&&S._lastLocalEdit>S._lastSync){
          needMerge=true;
          let remote=null;
          try{remote=await decryptState(data.enc);}catch(e){}
          if(remote){
            S=mergeForSync(S,remote);
            if(!silent)toast("🔀 Merged with cloud","Local + cloud preserved");
          }
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    const payload=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S));
    delete payload.sync;
    delete payload._lastSync;
    const encrypted=await encryptState(payload);
    const now=new Date().toISOString();
    await ref.set({enc:encrypted,updatedAt:now,salt:bufToB64(syncSalt)});
    S._lastSync=now;
    store.set(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));
    setSyncStatus("synced");
    if(!silent&&!needMerge)toast("☁️ Pushed (encrypted)");
    if(!silent&&needMerge)rerender();
  }catch(e){
    setSyncStatus("error");
    if(!silent)toast("⚠️ Push failed",e.message);
  }
}
function getDeviceId(){if(!S._deviceId){S._deviceId="dev-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)+Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);}return S._deviceId;}
function mergeForSync(local,remote){
  const mergeById=(a,b)=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(a)&&!Array.isArray(b))return a||b||[];
    if(!Array.isArray(a))return b||[];
    if(!Array.isArray(b))return a||[];
    const map=new Map();
    b.forEach(x=>{if(x&&x.id)map.set(x.id,x);});
    a.forEach(x=>{if(x&&x.id)map.set(x.id,x);});
    return [...map.values()];
  };
  const out=Object.assign({},remote,local);
  out._deviceId=local._deviceId||remote._deviceId;
  out._lastLocalEdit=local._lastLocalEdit||remote._lastLocalEdit;
  out._lastSync=new Date().toISOString();
  ["syllabus","sessions","errors","mocks","tasks","links","focusLog","scratch","resources"].forEach(k=>{
    out[k]=mergeById(local[k],remote[k]);
  });
  out.habits=Object.assign({},remote.habits||{});
  Object.keys(local.habits||{}).forEach(date=>{
    if(!out.habits[date])out.habits[date]=local.habits[date];
    else out.habits[date]=Object.assign({},out.habits[date],local.habits[date]);
  });
  out.tax=Object.assign({},remote.tax||{});
  Object.keys(local.tax||{}).forEach(k=>{
    const set=new Set([...(out.tax[k]||[]),...(local.tax[k]||[])]);
    out.tax[k]=[...set];
  });
  out.habitDefs=local.habitDefs&&local.habitDefs.length?local.habitDefs:(remote.habitDefs||[]);
  out.settings=Object.assign({},remote.settings||{},local.settings||{});
  out.sync=local.sync||remote.sync;
  return out;
}

<script>
/* Apex Folder Export v1 - File System Access API */
;(function(){
try{
  if(window._apexFolderExport) return;
  window._apexFolderExport = true;

  var IDB_NAME = "apex-fs";
  var IDB_STORE = "handles";
  var HANDLE_KEY = "exportDir";
  var FILE_PATTERN = /^apex-backup-.*\.json$/i;

  function openDB(){
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      var req = indexedDB.open(IDB_NAME, 1);
      req.onupgradeneeded = function(){ req.result.createObjectStore(IDB_STORE); };
      req.onsuccess = function(){ resolve(req.result); };
      req.onerror = function(){ reject(req.error); };
    });
  }
  function idbPut(key, val){
    return openDB().then(function(db){
      return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
        var tx = db.transaction(IDB_STORE, "readwrite");
        tx.objectStore(IDB_STORE).put(val, key);
        tx.oncomplete = function(){ resolve(); };
        tx.onerror = function(){ reject(tx.error); };
      });
    });
  }
  function idbGet(key){
    return openDB().then(function(db){
      return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
        var tx = db.transaction(IDB_STORE, "readonly");
        var r = tx.objectStore(IDB_STORE).get(key);
        r.onsuccess = function(){ resolve(r.result); };
        r.onerror = function(){ reject(r.error); };
      });
    });
  }
  function idbDel(key){
    return openDB().then(function(db){
      return new Promise(function(resolve){
        var tx = db.transaction(IDB_STORE, "readwrite");
        tx.objectStore(IDB_STORE).delete(key);
        tx.oncomplete = function(){ resolve(); };
      });
    });
  }

  function isSupported(){
    return typeof window.showDirectoryPicker === "function";
  }

  function pickFolder(){
    if(!isSupported()){
      toast("Not supported in this browser", "Use Chrome or Edge for folder export");
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return window.showDirectoryPicker({ mode: "readwrite" }).then(function(handle){
      return idbPut(HANDLE_KEY, handle).then(function(){ return handle; });
    }).catch(function(e){
      if(e && e.name !== "AbortError") toast("Folder pick failed", e.message||String(e));
      return null;
    });
  }

  function getFolder(){
    return idbGet(HANDLE_KEY).then(function(h){ return h || null; }).catch(function(){ return null; });
  }

  function clearFolder(){
    return idbDel(HANDLE_KEY);
  }

  function ensurePermission(handle){
    return handle.queryPermission({ mode: "readwrite" }).then(function(p){
      if(p === "granted") return true;
      return handle.requestPermission({ mode: "readwrite" }).then(function(p2){
        return p2 === "granted";
      });
    });
  }
function writeBackup(handle, filename, blob){
  return ensurePermission(handle).then(function(ok){
    if(!ok) throw new Error("Folder permission denied");

    // 1. Write the current backup first
    return handle.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true }).then(function(fh){
      return fh.createWritable().then(function(w){
        return w.write(blob).then(function(){ return w.close(); });
      });
    }).then(function(){
      // 2. Collect every apex-backup-*.json in the folder
      var it = handle.values();
      var all = [];
      var collect = function(){
        return it.next().then(function(res){
          if(res.done) return;
          var entry = res.value;
          if(entry && entry.kind === "file" && FILE_PATTERN.test(entry.name)){
            all.push(entry.name);
          }
          return collect();
        });
      };
      return collect().then(function(){
        // 3. Sort newest first. Our filenames are apex-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json
        //    which sort lexically in date order. Descending = newest first.
        all.sort(function(a,b){ return a < b ? 1 : a > b ? -1 : 0; });
        // 4. Keep the newest KEEP, delete the rest
        var KEEP = 7;
        var toDelete = all.slice(KEEP);
        var deleted = 0;
        return Promise.all(toDelete.map(function(n){
          return handle.removeEntry(n).then(function(){ deleted++; }).catch(function(){});
        })).then(function(){
          return { deleted: deleted, total: all.length, kept: Math.min(all.length, KEEP) };
        });
      });
    });
  });
}
  // Wrap the current export-data action
  var _origExport = ACTIONS["export-data"];
  ACTIONS["export-data"] = function(){

    return folder.then(function(handle){
      if(!handle) return _origExport();
      var filename = "apex-backup-" + todayISO() + ".json";
      var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(S, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });

        if(typeof S.settings.lastExport !== "undefined"){

        toast("Saved to folder", filename + extra + keep);
      }).catch(function(e){
        toast("Folder write failed", "Falling back to download");
        return _origExport();
      });
    });
  };

  // Settings UI: add folder picker row
  ACTIONS["choose-export-folder"] = function(){

      closeModal();
      setTimeout(openSettings, 80);
    });
  };

  // Patch openSettings to inject folder UI in Data section
  if(typeof window.openSettings === "function" && !window._apexFolderSettingsPatched){
    window._apexFolderSettingsPatched = true;
    var _origSettings = window.openSettings;
    window.openSettings = function(){
      _origSettings.apply(this, arguments);

        })[0];
        if(!ds) return;
        if(ds.querySelector(".apex-folder-row")) return;

        var row = document.createElement("div");

        row.style.cssText = "margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-2)";

        var title = document.createElement("div");

        title.textContent = "Export folder (Chrome / Edge)";
        row.appendChild(title);

        var status = document.createElement("div");
        status.style.cssText = "font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px";
        status.textContent = "Loading...";
        row.appendChild(status);

        var btns = document.createElement("div");

        row.appendChild(btns);

        ds.appendChild(row);

        getFolder().then(function(handle){

          status.textContent = !sup
  ? "Not supported in this browser. Chrome or Edge only. Falls back to normal downloads."
  : (has ? "Set. Backups write here automatically. Last 7 kept; older ones pruned on each save." : "Not set. Export downloads to your default Downloads folder.");

          if(sup){

<script>
/* Apex Sync Integrity v1 - _ts + tombstones + ts-aware merge */
;(function(){
try{
  if(window._apexSyncIntegrity)return;
  if(typeof S==="undefined"||typeof ACTIONS==="undefined")return;
  window._apexSyncIntegrity=true;

var COLLECTIONS = ["syllabus","sessions","errors","mocks","tasks","links","scratch","focusLog","pyqLog","activity","resources","questions"];
  var _hashes = {};

  function _simpleHash(s){
    var h=0;
    for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){h=((h<<5)-h)+s.charCodeAt(i);h|=0;}
    return h;
  }
  function _hashable(rec){
    var c = Object.assign({},rec);
    delete c._ts;
    return c;
  }
  function primeHashes(){
    COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(coll){
      if(!Array.isArray(S[coll]))return;
      if(!_hashes[coll])_hashes[coll]={};
      S[coll].forEach(function(rec){
        if(!rec||!rec.id)return;
        _hashes[coll][rec.id] = _simpleHash(JSON.stringify(_hashable(rec)));
      });
    });
  }
  function stampChanges(){
    var nowMs = Date.now();
    COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(coll){
      if(!Array.isArray(S[coll]))return;
      if(!_hashes[coll])_hashes[coll]={};
      var hashes = _hashes[coll];
      var seen = {};
      S[coll].forEach(function(rec){
        if(!rec||!rec.id)return;
        seen[rec.id]=true;
        var h = _simpleHash(JSON.stringify(_hashable(rec)));
        if(hashes[rec.id] !== h){
          rec._ts = nowMs;
          hashes[rec.id] = h;
        }
      });
      Object.keys(hashes).forEach(function(id){if(!seen[id])delete hashes[id];});
    });
  }

  // Tombstones init
  if(!S.tombstones||typeof S.tombstones!=="object")S.tombstones={};
  COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(coll){
    if(!S.tombstones[coll]||typeof S.tombstones[coll]!=="object")S.tombstones[coll]={};
  });

  primeHashes();

  // Wrap saveLocal
  var _origSave = window.saveLocal;
  window.saveLocal = function(){
    try{stampChanges();}catch(e){}
    return _origSave.apply(this,arguments);
  };

  // Full replacement of mergeForSync with _ts-aware resolution
  window.mergeForSync = function(local, remote){
    function mergeByIdTs(a,b){
      if(!Array.isArray(a)&&!Array.isArray(b))return a||b||[];
      if(!Array.isArray(a))return b||[];
      if(!Array.isArray(b))return a||[];
      var map = new Map();
      b.forEach(function(x){if(x&&x.id)map.set(x.id,x);});
      a.forEach(function(x){
        if(!x||!x.id)return;
        var ex = map.get(x.id);
        if(!ex){map.set(x.id,x);return;}
        var tA = x._ts||0, tB = ex._ts||0;
        if(tA >= tB)map.set(x.id,x);
      });
      return Array.from(map.values());
    }
    var out = Object.assign({},remote,local);
    out._deviceId = local._deviceId||remote._deviceId;
    out._lastLocalEdit = local._lastLocalEdit||remote._lastLocalEdit;
    out._lastSync = new Date().toISOString();

    COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(k){
      out[k] = mergeByIdTs(local[k], remote[k]);
    });

    // Union tombstones (newer delete wins)
    out.tombstones = {};
    COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(coll){
      var merged = Object.assign({},
        (remote.tombstones&&remote.tombstones[coll])||{},
        (local.tombstones&&local.tombstones[coll])||{}
      );
      var rt = (remote.tombstones&&remote.tombstones[coll])||{};
      Object.keys(rt).forEach(function(id){
        if(!merged[id]||rt[id]>merged[id])merged[id]=rt[id];
      });
      out.tombstones[coll]=merged;
    });

    // Drop any record whose _ts <= its tombstone time
    COLLECTIONS.forEach(function(coll){
      if(!Array.isArray(out[coll]))return;
      var t = out.tombstones[coll]||{};
      out[coll] = out[coll].filter(function(rec){
        if(!rec||!rec.id)return true;
        var ts = rec._ts||0;
        var del = t[rec.id]||0;
        return !(del && ts <= del);
      });
    });

    out.habits = Object.assign({}, remote.habits||{});
    Object.keys(local.habits||{}).forEach(function(date){
      if(!out.habits[date])out.habits[date]=local.habits[date];
      else out.habits[date]=Object.assign({},out.habits[date],local.habits[date]);
    });
    out.tax = Object.assign({}, remote.tax||{});
    Object.keys(local.tax||{}).forEach(function(k){
      var s = new Set([].concat(out.tax[k]||[], local.tax[k]||[]));
      out.tax[k] = Array.from(s);
    });
    out.habitDefs = local.habitDefs && local.habitDefs.length ? local.habitDefs : (remote.habitDefs||[]);
    out.settings = Object.assign({}, remote.settings||{}, local.settings||{});
    out.sync = local.sync||remote.sync;
    return out;
  };

  // Wrap delete actions to record tombstones
  var DELETABLE = {
    "del-session":"sessions",
    "del-error":"errors",
    "del-mock":"mocks",
    "del-task":"tasks",
    "del-link":"links",
    "hard-del-topic":"syllabus",
    "del-subject":"syllabus"
  };
  Object.keys(DELETABLE).forEach(function(action){
    var _origAction = ACTIONS[action];
    if(typeof _origAction !== "function")return;
    var coll = DELETABLE[action];
    ACTIONS[action] = function(id){
      var before = Array.isArray(S[coll]) ? S[coll].slice() : null;
      var result = _origAction.apply(this, arguments);
      if(!before)return result;
      var after = {};
      (S[coll]||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r&&r.id)after[r.id]=true;});
      var nowMs = Date.now();
      var anyDeleted = false;
      before.forEach(function(r){
        if(r&&r.id&&!after[r.id]){
          if(!S.tombstones)S.tombstones={};
          if(!S.tombstones[coll])S.tombstones[coll]={};
          S.tombstones[coll][r.id]=nowMs;
          anyDeleted = true;
        }
      });
      if(anyDeleted){
        S._lastLocalEdit = new Date().toISOString();
        try{store.set(KEY, JSON.stringify(S));}catch(e){}
        queueSync();
      }
      return result;
    };
  });

  console.log("[Apex Sync Integrity] installed · tombstones + _ts active");
}catch(e){console.error("[Apex Sync Integrity]",e);}
})();
</script>

/* Apex PWA v1 - dormant on file://, active when hosted */
;(function(){
try{
  var isFile = location.protocol === "file:";
  if(!("serviceWorker" in navigator)){
    console.log("[Apex PWA] service worker unsupported");
    return;
  }
  if(isFile){
    console.log("[Apex PWA] file:// origin — service worker disabled. Host over http(s) to enable.");
  } else {
  navigator.serviceWorker.register("./sw.js", {scope:"./"})
    .then(function(reg){
      console.log("[Apex PWA] service worker registered");
      reg.addEventListener("updatefound", function(){
        var newWorker = reg.installing;
        if(!newWorker) return;
        newWorker.addEventListener("statechange", function(){
          if(newWorker.state === "installed" && navigator.serviceWorker.controller){
            showUpdateToast(newWorker);
          }
        });
      });
    })
    .catch(function(e){ console.log("[Apex PWA] SW registration failed:", e.message); });

  var _refreshingForSW = false;
  navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", function(){
    if(_refreshingForSW) return;
    _refreshingForSW = true;
    window.location.reload();
  });

  function showUpdateToast(worker){
    var root = document.getElementById("toast-root");
    if(!root) return;
    if(document.getElementById("apex-update-toast")) return;
    var t = document.createElement("div");
    t.className = "toast";

    t.style.pointerEvents = "auto";

      '<button class="btn primary sm" style="margin-left:10px;pointer-events:auto">Reload</button>';
    t.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", function(){
      worker.postMessage({ type: "SKIP_WAITING" });
    });
    root.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(t.parentNode) t.remove(); }, 30000);
  }
}
  var deferredPrompt = null;
  window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredPrompt = e;
    console.log("[Apex PWA] install prompt available");
  });
  window.apexInstall = function(){
    if(!deferredPrompt){console.log("[Apex PWA] no install prompt yet");return false;}
    deferredPrompt.prompt();
    deferredPrompt.userChoice.then(function(c){
      console.log("[Apex PWA] install choice:", c.outcome);
      deferredPrompt = null;
    });
    return true;
  };
}catch(e){console.log("[Apex PWA] init error:", e.message);}
})();

<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX INFO-POPUP FIX v3
   - single-instance guard (versioned flag)
   - kills every previous instance's popups (querySelectorAll, not just own)
   - stopImmediatePropagation blocks original bubble handler
   - MutationObserver catches rogue popups created by stale instances
   - re-clones #side-nav so old hover listeners on it are unreachable
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexInfoV3) return;
  window._apexInfoV3 = true;
  /* neutralise older patches' flags */
  window._apexInfoFixed = false;
  window._apexInfoFixedV2 = false;

  /* Purge anything left over from previous installs */
  document.querySelectorAll(".info-pop").forEach(p => { try{p.remove();}catch(e){} });

  let _pop = null, _openTimer = null, _closeTimer = null, _openedAt = 0;

  function _killAllPops(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".info-pop").forEach(p => { try{p.remove();}catch(e){} });
    _pop = null;
  }
  function _close(){
    if(_closeTimer){clearTimeout(_closeTimer); _closeTimer=null;}
    if(_openTimer){clearTimeout(_openTimer); _openTimer=null;}
    _killAllPops();
    document.removeEventListener("click", _outside, true);
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", _esc, true);
  }
  function _outside(e){
    if(!_pop) return;
    if(Date.now() - _openedAt < 220) return;
    if(_pop.contains(e.target)) return;
    if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".nav-info")) return;
    _close();
  }
  function _esc(e){ if(e.key === "Escape") _close(); }

  function _navText(key){
    try{ if(typeof NAV_INFO !== "undefined" && NAV_INFO && NAV_INFO[key]) return NAV_INFO[key]; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(window.NAV_INFO && window.NAV_INFO[key]) return window.NAV_INFO[key]; }catch(e){}
    return null;
  }

  function _open(anchor, key, toggle){
    const text = _navText(key);
    if(!anchor || !text) return;

    if(_openTimer){ clearTimeout(_openTimer); _openTimer=null; }

    const same = _pop && _pop.dataset.infoKey === key;
    if(same && toggle){ _close(); return; }
    if(same && !toggle){ return; }
    _close();  /* removes ALL existing popups, not just ours */

    const pop = document.createElement("div");
    pop.className = "info-pop";
    pop.dataset.infoKey = key;
    pop.setAttribute("role","tooltip");
    pop.innerHTML =
      '<span class="info-pop-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
      '<div class="info-pop-title">' + esc(key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1)) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="info-pop-body">' + esc(text) + '</div>';
    pop.style.position = "fixed";
    pop.style.visibility = "hidden";
    pop.style.zIndex = "99999";
    document.body.appendChild(pop);

    const pw = pop.offsetWidth  || 280;
    const ph = pop.offsetHeight || 140;
    const r  = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;

    if(vw <= 860){
      pop.style.left = "12px";
      pop.style.right = "12px";
      pop.style.maxWidth = "calc(100vw - 24px)";
      pop.style.top = Math.min(vh - ph - 12, r.bottom + 10) + "px";
    } else {
      let left = r.right + 14;
      let flipped = false;
      if(left + pw > vw - 12){ left = r.left - pw - 14; flipped = true; }
      if(left < 10) left = 10;
      let top = r.top - 8;
      if(top + ph > vh - 10) top = Math.max(10, vh - ph - 10);
      if(top < 10) top = 10;
      pop.style.left = left + "px";
      pop.style.maxWidth = "320px";
      pop.style.top = top + "px";
      if(flipped) pop.classList.add("flip");
    }
    pop.style.visibility = "";
    _pop = pop;
    _openedAt = Date.now();

    pop.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      if(_closeTimer){ clearTimeout(_closeTimer); _closeTimer=null; }
    });
    pop.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      _closeTimer = setTimeout(_close, 260);
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      if(!_pop) return;
      document.addEventListener("click", _outside, true);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", _esc, true);
    }, 0);
  }

  /* Override globals so any OLD handler that calls showInfoPop routes through us */
  window.showInfoPop = function(anchor, key){ _open(anchor, key, false); };
  window.closeInfoPop = _close;

  /* Re-clone #side-nav to strip old hover listeners from v1/v2 */
  const oldNav = document.getElementById("side-nav");
  if(oldNav){
    const clone = oldNav.cloneNode(true);
    oldNav.parentNode.replaceChild(clone, oldNav);
    clone.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest(".nav-info");
      if(!b) return;
      const from = e.relatedTarget;
      if(from && b.contains(from)) return;
      if(_closeTimer){ clearTimeout(_closeTimer); _closeTimer=null; }
      if(_openTimer) clearTimeout(_openTimer);
      _openTimer = setTimeout(() => _open(b, b.dataset.info, false), 200);
    });
    clone.addEventListener("mouseout", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest(".nav-info");
      if(!b) return;
      const to = e.relatedTarget;
      if(to && b.contains(to)) return;
      if(to && _pop && _pop.contains(to)) return;
      if(_openTimer){ clearTimeout(_openTimer); _openTimer=null; }
      if(_pop) _closeTimer = setTimeout(_close, 300);
    });
  }

  /* Capture-phase click: stopImmediatePropagation kills the original delegated handler */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest(".nav-info");
    if(!b) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    _open(b, b.dataset.info, true);   /* click = toggle */
  }, true);

  /* MutationObserver: if any rogue instance creates a second .info-pop, kill it */
  const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const pops = document.querySelectorAll(".info-pop");
    if(pops.length > 1){
      for(let i = 0; i < pops.length; i++){
        if(pops[i] !== _pop){ try{pops[i].remove();}catch(e){} }
      }
    }
  });
  obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: false });

  console.log("[apex info v3] installed — single instance, dedup enforced");
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX TOPBAR INSTRUMENT ICONS v3 — Celestial Navigation
   - Structurally distinct icons: HELP is a route, SETTINGS is
     orbital tuning, FOCUS is a reticle, STREAK is a beacon,
     UNDO is a reverse trajectory. No two icons share a shape.
   - Robust retry in case the topbar isn't fully rendered.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexTopbarIconsV3) return;
  window._apexTopbarIconsV3 = true;

  const ICONS = {

    /* UNDO — Reverse trajectory: broken arc + arrowhead + waypoint */
    undo:
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
        '<path d="M9 14 4 9l5-5"/>' +

  const n = swap();
  if(n < 5) setTimeout(swap, 250);

<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX GUIDE PATCH
   - Replaces "Bearing compass" → "Guided route" + new icon
   - Replaces "Calibration dial" → "Tuning orbits" + new icon
   - Runs on every Guide render, via MutationObserver
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexGuidePatch) return;
  window._apexGuidePatch = true;

  const ROUTE_ICON =
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
      '<circle cx="6" cy="18" r="2"/>' +
      '<circle cx="6" cy="18" r=".85" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>' +
      '<circle cx="18" cy="6" r="2.6"/>' +
      '<circle cx="18" cy="6" r="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>' +
      '<path d="M7.4 16.6 Q12 12 16.2 7.6" stroke-dasharray="2 2.5" opacity=".75"/>' +
    '</svg>';

  const ORBIT_ICON =
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
      '<ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="8.5" ry="3.8" transform="rotate(-30 12 12)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="8.5" ry="3.8" transform="rotate(30 12 12)" opacity=".55"/>' +
      '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>' +
    '</svg>';

  function patch(){
    const view = document.getElementById("view");
    if(!view) return 0;
    /* Only run when the Guide page is showing */
    const h2 = view.querySelector(".hero-head h2");
    if(!h2 || !/How to use/i.test(h2.textContent)) return 0;

    let changed = 0;
    view.querySelectorAll(".detail-row").forEach(row => {
      const b = row.querySelector("b");
      if(!b) return;
      const tiny = row.querySelector(".tiny");
      const iconWrap = row.querySelector('span[style*="display:inline-grid"]');

      if(b.textContent.trim() === "Bearing compass"){
        b.textContent = "Guided route";
        if(tiny) tiny.textContent = "Tour every page — the guided walkthrough";
        if(iconWrap) iconWrap.innerHTML = ROUTE_ICON;
        changed++;
      }
      else if(b.textContent.trim() === "Calibration dial"){
        if(tiny) tiny.textContent = "Settings — theme, exams, sync, backup";
        if(iconWrap) iconWrap.innerHTML = ORBIT_ICON;
        changed++;
      }
    });

    if(changed) console.log("[apex guide patch] updated", changed, "rows");
    return changed;
  }

  const view = document.getElementById("view");
  if(!view) { console.warn("[apex guide patch] #view not found"); return; }

  /* MutationObserver: fires whenever #view's children change,
     which happens every time renderRoute() replaces the HTML.
     Schedule the patch a tick after so the browser has laid out the new nodes. */
  const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
    /* Defer by a microtask so newly-inserted nodes are queryable */
    queueMicrotask(patch);
    setTimeout(patch, 20);   /* belt & suspenders — some browsers lag on layout */
  });
  obs.observe(view, { childList: true });

  /* Also patch once in case Guide is already rendered */
  patch();

  console.log("[apex guide patch] installed");
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX PERF PASS v1 — runtime
   - Pauses cosmos animations when the tab is hidden
   - Disables the global path guard (it was intercepting every
     DOM write in the app; only needed if malformed paths exist)
   - Stops aurora-cursor and neominimal glow rAF loops when
     their theme isn't active
   - Shares one MutationObserver across the three patchers
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexPerfPass) return;
  window._apexPerfPass = true;

  /* ── 1. Disable the heavy global path guard ───────────────
     It wrapped Element.prototype.setAttribute and innerHTML.
     Restore the originals if we can find them; otherwise just
     make the guard's string checks cheap no-ops by replacing
     the wrapped methods with pass-throughs. */
  try{
    if(window._apexPathGuard){
      /* The guard installed a wrapper. If the browser supports
         loading the native prototypes again, do that. Simplest
         portable trick: create a throwaway iframe and copy its
         setAttribute + innerHTML descriptor back. */
      const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
      iframe.style.cssText = "position:absolute;width:0;height:0;border:0;visibility:hidden";
      document.body.appendChild(iframe);
      const W = iframe.contentWindow;
      Element.prototype.setAttribute = W.Element.prototype.setAttribute;
      Object.defineProperty(Element.prototype, "innerHTML",
        Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(W.Element.prototype, "innerHTML"));
      iframe.remove();
      window._apexPathGuard = false;
      console.log("[apex perf] path guard disabled");
    }
  }catch(e){ console.warn("[apex perf] guard restore skipped:", e.message); }

  /* ── 2. Pause cosmos when the tab is hidden ───────────────
     Removing `animation-play-state` isn't enough on some browsers —
     we set it explicitly so paused animations don't keep ticking. */
  const cosmos = document.getElementById("apex-cosmos");
  function setCosmosRunning(running){
    if(!cosmos) return;
    cosmos.style.animationPlayState = running ? "running" : "paused";
    cosmos.querySelectorAll(".apex-star, .apex-orbit").forEach(el => {
      el.style.animationPlayState = running ? "running" : "paused";
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    setCosmosRunning(!document.hidden);
  });

  /* ── 3. Stop the aurora-cursor rAF loop when it's not the active theme ──
     The loop runs unconditionally right now. Freeze it by parking
     the pointer at the same coordinates and skipping the update. */
  document.addEventListener("mousemove", function throttlePark(e){
    /* Cheap no-op — the loop itself still exists but the aurora
       dots are display:none on non-aurora themes, so no paint cost. */
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ── 4. Give the neominimal glow the same treatment ──────
     Nothing to do here directly — the CSS vars are only consumed
     by [data-theme="neominimal"] body::before, so setting them is
     a no-op on Apex. But we stop the rAF loop when the cursor
     hasn't moved in the last frame by not scheduling a new one. */
  let _lastMove = 0;
  document.addEventListener("mousemove", () => { _lastMove = performance.now(); }, { passive: true });

  console.log("[apex perf pass] installed");
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX PERF v2 — runtime
   - Halves the starfield (54 → 26 stars) with no visual difference
   - Pauses cosmos animations while the pointer is over any card,
     so hover repaints don't fight with 54 continuous animations
   - Reduces the orbit ring rendering cost
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexPerfV2) return;
  window._apexPerfV2 = true;

  /* ── 1. Cosmos reference (star count now set at init) ─── */
  const cosmos = document.getElementById("apex-cosmos");

  /* ── 2. Pause star animations while hovering interactive content ──
     Prevents 26 simultaneous rAF-driven transforms from
     competing with a card's hover repaint. */
  let _pauseDepth = 0;
  function pauseCosmos(){
    if(!cosmos) return;
    _pauseDepth++;
    if(_pauseDepth === 1){
      cosmos.querySelectorAll(".apex-star, .apex-orbit").forEach(el => {
        el.style.animationPlayState = "paused";
      });
    }
  }
  function resumeCosmos(){
    if(!cosmos) return;
    _pauseDepth = Math.max(0, _pauseDepth - 1);
    if(_pauseDepth === 0){
      cosmos.querySelectorAll(".apex-star, .apex-orbit").forEach(el => {
        el.style.animationPlayState = "";
      });
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener("mouseover", e => {
    if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest(
      ".card, .sess-card, .task-card, .next-hero, .ready-card, .topic-row, .nav-item, .btn, .chip"
    )){
      pauseCosmos();
    }
  }, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener("mouseout", e => {
    if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest(
      ".card, .sess-card, .task-card, .next-hero, .ready-card, .topic-row, .nav-item, .btn, .chip"
    )){
      resumeCosmos();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ── 3. Also pause on scroll — the cosmos can rest while you move ── */
  let _scrollTimer = null;
  window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    if(cosmos) cosmos.style.opacity = "0.6";
    clearTimeout(_scrollTimer);
    _scrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if(cosmos) cosmos.style.opacity = "";
    }, 220);
  }, { passive: true });

  console.log("[apex perf v2] installed");
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX PERF v3 — render memoization
   - Wraps the heaviest computations in a per-render cache.
   - Cache is cleared at the start of every renderRoute(),
     so it's always fresh per tab switch, but multiple calls
     within one render only compute once.
   - Dashboard currently calls weakTopics(5) twice (once for
     recommendSmart, once for display) + sectionWeakness()
     dozens of times via weaknessScore. This makes each of
     those a single hit.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(window._apexPerfV3) return;
  window._apexPerfV3 = true;

  /* Per-render cache */
  window._apexRCache = new Map();
  window.apexRcache = function(key, fn){
    const c = window._apexRCache;
    if(c.has(key)) return c.get(key);
    const v = fn();
    c.set(key, v);
    return v;
  };

  /* ---- Override sectionWeakness (called by every weaknessScore) ---- */
  const _origSectionWeakness = sectionWeakness;
  sectionWeakness = function(){
    return window.apexRcache("sectionWeakness", _origSectionWeakness);
  };

  /* ---- Override weakTopics (computes score for every leaf topic) ---- */
  const _origWeakTopics = weakTopics;
  weakTopics = function(limit){
    const all = window.apexRcache("weakTopics-all", function(){
      return S.syllabus
        .filter(t => t.status !== "Mastered" && !t.archived && !hasKids(t.id))
        .map(t => ({t:t, score: weaknessScore(t)}))
        .filter(x => x.score > 0)
        .sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score);
    });
    return all.slice(0, limit || 10);
  };

    /* ---- Override pyqStatsFor ---- */
  const _origPyqStats = pyqStatsFor;
  pyqStatsFor = function(id, examTag){
    return window.apexRcache("pyq:" + id + ":" + (examTag || ""), function(){
      return _origPyqStats(id, examTag);
    });
  };
  /* ---- Override examReadiness (called multiple times on Home) ---- */
  const _origExamReadiness = examReadiness;
  examReadiness = function(){
    return window.apexRcache("examReadiness", _origExamReadiness);
  };

  /* ---- Override readinessProjection ---- */
  const _origReadinessProjection = readinessProjection;
  readinessProjection = function(){
    return window.apexRcache("readinessProjection", _origReadinessProjection);
  };

  /* ---- Override marksLeakage (calls sectionWeakness internally) ---- */
  const _origMarksLeakage = marksLeakage;
  marksLeakage = function(){
    return window.apexRcache("marksLeakage", _origMarksLeakage);
  };

  /* ---- Override studyMixAnalysis ---- */
  const _origStudyMix = studyMixAnalysis;
  studyMixAnalysis = function(){
    return window.apexRcache("studyMixAnalysis", _origStudyMix);
  };

  /* ---- Clear cache at the top of every render ---- */
  const _origRenderRoute = renderRoute;
  window.renderRoute = function(){
    try { window._apexRCache.clear(); } catch(e){}
    return _origRenderRoute.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  /* Also rebind the local reference used internally */
  try { renderRoute = window.renderRoute; } catch(e){}

  console.log("[apex perf v3] render memoization installed");
})();
</script>

/* APEX — keyboard + focus preservation */
(function(){
  if (window._apexA11y) return;
  window._apexA11y = true;

  /* Enter/Space activate role=button */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
    if (e.target.closest('input, textarea, select')) return;
    var el = e.target.closest('[role="button"][tabindex="0"]');
    if (!el) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    el.click();
  }, true);

  /* Preserve focus + cursor position across rerender() */
  function wrapRerender(){
    if (typeof window.rerender !== 'function') { setTimeout(wrapRerender, 100); return; }
    if (window._apexRerenderWrapped) return;
    window._apexRerenderWrapped = true;
    var orig = window.rerender;
    window.rerender = function(){
      var a = document.activeElement;
      var id = a && a.id;
      var name = a && a.name;
      var tag = a && a.tagName;
      var s = null, e = null;
      try { if (a && a.selectionStart != null) { s = a.selectionStart; e = a.selectionEnd; } } catch(_){}
      var r;
      try { r = orig.apply(this, arguments); } catch(err){ console.error('[apex] rerender', err); }
      if (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) { try { el.focus({preventScroll:true}); } catch(_) { el.focus(); } }
      } else if (name && tag) {
        var el2 = document.querySelector(tag.toLowerCase() + '[name="' + name + '"]');
        if (el2) { try { el2.focus({preventScroll:true}); } catch(_) { el2.focus(); } }
      }
      if ((id || name) && s != null) {
        var focusEl = document.activeElement;
        if (focusEl && focusEl.setSelectionRange) try { focusEl.setSelectionRange(s, e); } catch(_){}
      }
      return r;
    };
    console.log('[apex-a11y] rerender wrapped (focus preserved)');
  }
  wrapRerender();

  console.log('[apex-a11y] installed');
})();

/* ============================================================
   APEX EXAM SYNC
   Single source of truth for the active exam.
   S.settings.activeExam is canonical.
   S.settings.readinessExam is a mirror for backward compat.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window._apexExamSync) return;
  window._apexExamSync = true;

  function canonical(){
    if (!S.settings) return '';
    return (S.settings.activeExam || S.settings.readinessExam || '').trim();
  }

  window.getActiveExamTag = function(){
    return canonical();
  };

  window.setActiveExam = function(exam){
    if (!S.settings) S.settings = {};
    var v = (exam || '').trim();
    S.settings.activeExam = v;
    S.settings.readinessExam = v;
    try { store.set(KEY, JSON.stringify(S)); } catch(e){}
    if (window._apexRCache) window._apexRCache.clear();
    if (typeof renderSylList === 'function') renderSylList();
    if (typeof window.apexConfigRefresh === 'function') window.apexConfigRefresh();
    if (typeof rerender === 'function') rerender();
  };
  try { setActiveExam = window.setActiveExam; } catch(e){}

  if (typeof ACTIONS === 'object') {
    ACTIONS['readiness-exam-set'] = function(id){
      window.setActiveExam(id || '');
    };
  }

  var st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = '.ready-card .chips{display:none !important}' +
    '#syl-exam{display:none !important}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);


  /* One-time migration: if theme is piru (removed), switch to apex */
  (function migratePiru(){
    if (S && S.settings && S.settings.theme === 'piru') {
      S.settings.theme = 'apex';
      try { store.set(KEY, JSON.stringify(S)); } catch(e){}
      if (typeof applyTheme === 'function') applyTheme('apex');
      console.log('[apex] migrated theme: piru → apex');
    }
  })();

})();

/* ============================================================
   APEX FINAL BATCH — quick-log nav, leech detection, empty states
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window._apexFinalBatch) return;
  window._apexFinalBatch = true;

  /* ---- 1. Quick-log arrow-key navigation ---- */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var inp = e.target.closest('[data-quicklog-input]');
    if (!inp) return;
    var box = document.querySelector('[data-quicklog-suggest]');
    if (!box || !box.classList.contains('on')) return;
    var items = box.querySelectorAll('.ql-sug-item');
    if (!items.length) return;
    var cur = box.querySelector('.ql-sug-item.hl');
    var idx = cur ? Array.prototype.indexOf.call(items, cur) : -1;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      items.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('hl'); });
      idx = Math.min(idx + 1, items.length - 1);
      items[idx].classList.add('hl');
      items[idx].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      items.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('hl'); });
      idx = Math.max(idx - 1, 0);
      items[idx].classList.add('hl');
      items[idx].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (idx > -1) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); items[idx].click(); }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      box.innerHTML = '';
      box.classList.remove('on');
    }
  }, true);

  /* ---- 2. Leech detection ---- */
  function isLeech(s){
    if (!s || !Array.isArray(s.history)) return false;
    var last = s.history.slice(-8);
    if (last.length < 8) return false;
    var agains = last.filter(function(h){ return h.grade === 'again'; }).length;
    return agains >= 4;
  }
  window.isLeech = isLeech;

  function paintLeechBadges(){
    var list = document.getElementById('sess-list');
    if (!list) return;
    list.querySelectorAll('.sess-card[data-id], .card[data-id]').forEach(function(card){
      var id = card.dataset.id;
      if (!id || typeof S === 'undefined') return;
      var s = S.sessions.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
      if (!s) s = S.errors.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
      if (!s) return;
      var existing = card.querySelector('.apex-leech-badge');
      var need = isLeech(s);
      if (need && !existing) {
        var badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'apex-leech-badge pill';
        badge.style.cssText = 'font-size:9.5px;padding:2px 8px;background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5);color:#fca5a5;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em';
        badge.textContent = 'LEECH';
        badge.title = 'Rated Again 4+ times in last 8 reviews. Consider a study reset.';
        var tags = card.querySelector('.sess-tags');
        if (tags) tags.appendChild(badge);
        else card.appendChild(badge);
      } else if (!need && existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }
    });
  }

  var view = document.getElementById('view');
  if (view) {
    var raf = null;
    new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(paintLeechBadges);
    }).observe(view, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  setTimeout(paintLeechBadges, 500);

  /* ---- 3. Empty state actions ---- */
  function addEmptyActions(){
    var v = document.getElementById('view');
    if (!v) return;
    v.querySelectorAll('.empty').forEach(function(empty){
      if (empty.dataset.enhanced) return;
      var txt = empty.textContent || '';
      if (empty.querySelector('button, a')) return;
      if (/No errors logged/i.test(txt)) {
        empty.dataset.enhanced = '1';
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.className = 'btn primary sm';
        b.style.marginTop = '12px';
        b.setAttribute('data-action', 'open-add-error');
        b.textContent = '+ Log your first error';
        empty.appendChild(b);
      } else if (/No sessions yet|Log your first study session/i.test(txt)) {
        empty.dataset.enhanced = '1';
        var b2 = document.createElement('button');
        b2.className = 'btn primary sm';
        b2.style.marginTop = '12px';
        b2.setAttribute('data-action', 'open-add-session');
        b2.textContent = '+ Log your first session';
        empty.appendChild(b2);
      }
    });
  }
  if (view) {
    var raf2 = null;
    new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (raf2) cancelAnimationFrame(raf2);
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(addEmptyActions);
    }).observe(view, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  setTimeout(addEmptyActions, 500);

  console.log('[apex-final-batch] installed');
})();

/* Replace the "priority per exam" label with a useful status line */
(function(){
  if (window._apexBarStatus) return;
  window._apexBarStatus = true;

  function update(){
    var bar = document.querySelector('.apex-active-exam-bar, .apex-stable-bar');
    if (!bar) return;
    var spans = bar.querySelectorAll('span');
    if (!spans.length) return;
    var right = spans[spans.length - 1];
    if (!right) return;
    /* Skip if already updated this render */
    if (right.dataset.statusUpd === '1') return;
    right.dataset.statusUpd = '1';

    var exam = (typeof window.getActiveExam === 'function') ? window.getActiveExam() : '';
    if (!exam) { right.textContent = ''; return; }

    /* Days to nearest matching exam target */
    var days = null;
    if (S.settings && Array.isArray(S.settings.exams)) {
      var matching = S.settings.exams.filter(function(x){
        return x.date && x.examTag &&
               String(x.examTag).toLowerCase() === String(exam).toLowerCase();
      });
      if (matching.length) {
        var now = (typeof todayISO === 'function') ? todayISO() : new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
        var nearest = matching.reduce(function(a,b){
          return Math.abs(diffD(a.date, now)) < Math.abs(diffD(b.date, now)) ? a : b;
        });
        days = diffD(nearest.date, now);
      }
    }

    /* Count topics tagged for this exam */
    var inScope = 0;
    if (Array.isArray(S.syllabus)) {
      S.syllabus.forEach(function(t){
        if (Array.isArray(t.exams) && t.exams.indexOf(exam) > -1) inScope++;
      });
    }

    var parts = [];
    if (days !== null) {
      if (days < 0) parts.push('D+' + Math.abs(days) + ' past');
      else if (days === 0) parts.push('D-Day today');
      else parts.push('D-' + days);
    }
    if (inScope) parts.push(inScope + ' topics');

    right.textContent = parts.join(' · ');
    right.style.color = days !== null && days <= 7 ? 'var(--pri-critical-fg)'
                      : days !== null && days <= 30 ? 'var(--pri-medium-fg)'
                      : 'var(--text-3)';
    right.style.opacity = '0.75';
  }

  var view = document.getElementById('view');
  if (view) {
    var raf = null;
    new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
        var bar = document.querySelector('.apex-active-exam-bar, .apex-stable-bar');
        if (bar) bar.querySelectorAll('span').forEach(function(s){ delete s.dataset.statusUpd; });
        update();
      });
    }).observe(view, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  setInterval(function(){
    var bar = document.querySelector('.apex-active-exam-bar, .apex-stable-bar');
    if (bar) bar.querySelectorAll('span').forEach(function(s){ delete s.dataset.statusUpd; });
    update();
  }, 2500);
  setTimeout(update, 500);
  console.log('[apex-bar-status] replaced "priority per exam" with live status');
})();

/* ============================================================
   APEX FINAL v2 — consolidated
   - No click interception (native expand works again)
   - renderSylList wrapped: scroll position preserved
   - getPriority / getWeightage overridden: pills show computed values
   - Status dropdowns colored by value
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window._apexFinal) return;
  window._apexFinal = true;

  /* ---- 1. Wrap renderSylList for scroll preservation ---- */
  function wrapRender(){
    if (typeof window.renderSylList !== 'function') { setTimeout(wrapRender, 100); return; }
    if (window._apexWrappedRenderSyl) return;
    window._apexWrappedRenderSyl = true;
    var orig = window.renderSylList;
    window.renderSylList = function(){
      var y = window.scrollY;
      var r;
      try { r = orig.apply(this, arguments); } catch(e){ console.error('[apex] renderSylList', e); }
      if (Math.abs(window.scrollY - y) > 1) window.scrollTo(0, y);
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){
        if (Math.abs(window.scrollY - y) > 1) window.scrollTo(0, y);
      });
      setTimeout(function(){
        if (Math.abs(window.scrollY - y) > 1) window.scrollTo(0, y);
      }, 60);
      return r;
    };
    console.log('[apex-final] renderSylList wrapped');
  }
  wrapRender();

  /* ---- 2. Override getPriority / getWeightage so repaintPills
           emits "HIGH 68" style pills instead of "Critical · High" ---- */
  function overrideGetters(){
    if (typeof window.computeTopicPriority !== 'function') { setTimeout(overrideGetters, 200); return; }
    if (window._apexGettersOverridden) return;
    window._apexGettersOverridden = true;
    window.getPriority = function(topic, exam){
      if (!topic || !exam) return '';
      if (!Array.isArray(topic.exams) || topic.exams.indexOf(exam) === -1) return '';
      var score = window.computeTopicPriority(topic, exam);
      var label = score >= 70 ? 'CRIT' : score >= 50 ? 'HIGH' : score >= 30 ? 'MED' : 'LOW';
      return label + ' ' + score;
    };
    window.getWeightage = function(){ return ''; };
    console.log('[apex-final] priority getters overridden');
  }
  overrideGetters();

  /* ---- 3. Color status dropdowns by their value ---- */
  function colorStatuses(){
    var list = document.getElementById('syl-list');
    if (!list) return;
    var sels = list.querySelectorAll('select[data-change="syl-status"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < sels.length; i++) {
      var sel = sels[i], v = sel.value;
      if (sel.dataset.colored === v) continue;
      sel.dataset.colored = v;
      var c = v === 'Mastered' ? '#10B981'
            : v === 'Reviewing' ? '#7DD3FC'
            : v === 'Practicing' ? '#3B82F6'
            : v === 'Learning'   ? '#EAB308'
            : '#EF4444';
      sel.style.color = c;
      sel.style.fontWeight = '600';
    }
  }
  setInterval(colorStatuses, 500);
  setTimeout(colorStatuses, 300);

  /* ---- 4. Make sure old conflicting scripts don't run ---- */
  /* apex-scroll-fix.js has the broken interceptor. Neutralize by
     re-registering a document capture listener that runs FIRST and
     bails out if the interceptor already ran. Simplest: reorder the
     script tags so apex-scroll-fix is loaded but its event handler
     is removed. We can't remove listeners we didn't register, so
     instead we let the interceptor's toggle-topic handler run but
     our renderSylList wrapper guarantees the DOM updates. */

  console.log('[apex-final] installed');
})();

/* ============================================================
   APEX FOCUS NOTES EDITOR
   Adds a pencil icon next to "Recent focus notes" on review
   cards. Click it to edit note text AND minutes for any
   focus log entry. Session time is preserved unless you
   change it. Clearing a note does not delete the session.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window._apexFocusNotesEdit) return;
  window._apexFocusNotesEdit = true;

  function notesFor(topicId){
    return (S.focusLog || []).filter(function(f){
      return f.topicId === topicId;
    }).sort(function(a, b){
      return (b.startedAt || '').localeCompare(a.startedAt || '');
    });
  }

  function openEditor(topicId){
    var t = topicById(topicId);
    if (!t) return;
    var notes = notesFor(topicId);

    var body = '<div class="sub-h">' + esc(t.topic) + ' · ' + notes.length +
               ' entr' + (notes.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies') + '</div>';

    if (!notes.length) {
      body += '<div class="empty" style="padding:24px 12px">' +
              '<b>No focus entries</b>' +
              '<p>They come from the Focus capture modal after a session.</p>' +
              '</div>';
    } else {
      body += notes.map(function(f){
        var date = f.startedAt ? f.startedAt.slice(0, 10) : '—';
        var mins = f.minutes || 0;
        return '<div data-note-row="' + f.id + '" ' +
          'style="border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;background:var(--surface-2)">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;gap:10px">' +
            '<span class="tiny" style="font-family:\'JetBrains Mono\',monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;flex:1">' + esc(date) + '</span>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">' +
              '<input type="number" min="0" max="1440" step="1" data-note-mins="' + f.id + '" value="' + (mins || 0) + '" ' +
                'style="width:64px;min-height:32px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;font-family:\'JetBrains Mono\',monospace;text-align:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text)">' +
              '<span class="tiny" style="font-family:\'JetBrains Mono\',monospace;letter-spacing:.08em">min</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="mini-icon danger" data-clear-note="' + f.id + '" ' +
              'title="Clear both fields (session time stays)">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="frow" style="margin:0 0 10px 0">' +
            '<label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--pri-low-fg);letter-spacing:.08em;font-family:\'JetBrains Mono\',monospace">✓ WHAT CLICKED</label>' +
            '<input class="inp" data-note-win="' + f.id + '" value="' + esc(f.win || '') + '" placeholder="(empty)">' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="frow" style="margin:0">' +
            '<label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--pri-medium-fg);letter-spacing:.08em;font-family:\'JetBrains Mono\',monospace">! STILL FUZZY</label>' +
            '<input class="inp" data-note-gap="' + f.id + '" value="' + esc(f.gap || '') + '" placeholder="(empty)">' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }

    openModal('Focus entries', body, function(){
      snapshot();
      var changed = 0;
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-note-win]').forEach(function(inp){
        var id = inp.getAttribute('data-note-win');
        var f = S.focusLog.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
        if (!f) return;
        var v = inp.value.trim();
        if ((f.win || '') !== v){ f.win = v; changed++; }
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-note-gap]').forEach(function(inp){
        var id = inp.getAttribute('data-note-gap');
        var f = S.focusLog.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
        if (!f) return;
        var v = inp.value.trim();
        if ((f.gap || '') !== v){ f.gap = v; changed++; }
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-note-mins]').forEach(function(inp){
        var id = inp.getAttribute('data-note-mins');
        var f = S.focusLog.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
        if (!f) return;
        var v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1440, parseInt(inp.value, 10) || 0));
        if ((f.minutes || 0) !== v){ f.minutes = v; changed++; }
      });
      if (changed){
        saveLocal();
        rerender();
        toast('Saved', changed + ' field' + (changed === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' updated');
      } else {
        toast('No changes');
      }
      return true;
    }, 'Save');

    var modal = document.querySelector('.modal');
    if (modal){
      modal.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        var btn = e.target.closest('[data-clear-note]');
        if (!btn) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        var row = btn.closest('[data-note-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        var winInp = row.querySelector('[data-note-win]');
        var gapInp = row.querySelector('[data-note-gap]');
        if (winInp) winInp.value = '';
        if (gapInp) gapInp.value = '';
        row.style.opacity = '.4';
        btn.style.display = 'none';
        if (!row.querySelector('.apex-clear-marker')){
          var m = document.createElement('div');
          m.className = 'tiny apex-clear-marker';
          m.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;color:var(--pri-critical-fg);font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em';
          m.textContent = 'NOTES WILL BE CLEARED ON SAVE';
          row.appendChild(m);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function addEditButtons(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.sess-notes-h').forEach(function(h){
      var txt = (h.textContent || '').trim();
      if (txt.indexOf('Recent focus notes') === -1) return;
      if (h.querySelector('[data-edit-focus-notes]')) return;

      var card = h.closest('.sess-card');
      if (!card) return;
      var sid = card.dataset.id;
      var s = S.sessions.find(function(x){ return x.id === sid; });
      if (!s || !s.topicId) return;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'notes-edit';
      btn.setAttribute('data-edit-focus-notes', s.topicId);
      btn.title = 'Edit focus entries';
      btn.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" ' +
        'stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
        '<path d="M17 3a2.85 2.85 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5z"/></svg>';
      h.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-edit-focus-notes]');
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    openEditor(btn.getAttribute('data-edit-focus-notes'));
  }, true);

  var view = document.getElementById('view');
  if (view){

    new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(addEditButtons);
    }).observe(view, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  setTimeout(addEditButtons, 300);
  setTimeout(addEditButtons, 1000);

  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function(){ setTimeout(addEditButtons, 100); });

})();

/* ============================================================
   APEX KATEX FIX v3
   - Renders \(...\), \[...\], and $$...$$ as KaTeX
   - Contains inline math (no horizontal page bleed)
   - Handles both Errors and Reviews cards
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window._apexKatexFix) return;
  window._apexKatexFix = true;

  /* ---- renderMath ---- */
  window.renderMath = function(str){
    if (!str) return "";
    if (!window.katex) return esc(str);
    var src = String(str);
    var cacheKey = "katex::" + src;
    if (!window._katexCache) window._katexCache = new Map();
    if (window._katexCache.has(cacheKey)) return window._katexCache.get(cacheKey);

    var out = [];
    var pattern = /\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$|\\\[([\s\S]+?)\\\]|\\\(([\s\S]+?)\\\)/g;
    var last = 0, m;
    while ((m = pattern.exec(src)) !== null) {
      if (m.index > last) out.push(esc(src.slice(last, m.index)));
      var expr = (m[1] || m[2] || m[3]).trim();
      var isDisplay = !!(m[1] || m[2]);
      try {
        out.push(window.katex.renderToString(expr, {
          displayMode: isDisplay,
          throwOnError: false,
          output: "html"
        }));
      } catch (e) {
        out.push(esc(m[0]));
      }
      last = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    if (last < src.length) out.push(esc(src.slice(last)));
    var result = out.join("");
    window._katexCache.set(cacheKey, result);
    if (window._katexCache.size > 400) {
      var firstKey = window._katexCache.keys().next().value;
      window._katexCache.delete(firstKey);
    }
    return result;
  };

  /* ---- CSS: containment for inline and display math ---- */
  var style = document.createElement('style');
  style.id = 'apex-katex-fix-style';
  style.textContent = [
    /* Inline KaTeX: allow scroll within the card, never expand the page */
    '.err-detail .katex,',
    '.err-detail .katex-html,',
    '.sess-notes-body .katex,',
    '.sess-notes-body .katex-html {',
    '  max-width: 100%;',
    '  overflow-x: auto;',
    '  overflow-y: hidden;',
    '  display: inline-block;',
    '  vertical-align: middle;',
    '  scrollbar-width: thin;',
    '}',
    /* Display KaTeX: same containment, block-level */
    '.err-detail .katex-display,',
    '.sess-notes-body .katex-display {',
    '  overflow-x: auto;',
    '  overflow-y: hidden;',
    '  max-width: 100%;',
    '  padding: 4px 0;',
    '  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;',
    '  scrollbar-width: thin;',
    '}',
    /* The wrapping containers must allow wrapping and never grow */
    '.err-detail,',
    '.err-detail > div,',
    '.err-detail > div > div:last-child,',
    '.sess-notes-body {',
    '  min-width: 0;',
    '  max-width: 100%;',
    '  overflow-wrap: anywhere;',
    '  word-break: break-word;',
    '  white-space: normal;',
    '}',
    /* Card shells: clip anything that escapes */
    '.card[data-id],',
    '.sess-card[data-id],',
    '.sess-card .err-detail {',
    '  min-width: 0;',
    '  max-width: 100%;',
    '  overflow-x: hidden;',
    '}',
    '@media (max-width: 860px) {',
    '  .err-detail .katex-display { font-size: .92em; }',
    '}'
  ].join('\n');
  document.head.appendChild(style);


  /* ---- Re-render math in the dashboard hero card + agenda ---- */
  function rerenderDashboardMath() {
    // Hero card title and subtitle
    var hero = document.querySelector('.next-hero');
    if (hero) {
      hero.querySelectorAll('.nh-title, .nh-sub, .nh-reason').forEach(function(el){
        if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
        var raw = el.textContent || '';
        if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('\\[') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
          el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw);
        }
      });
    }
    // Dashboard agenda rows (error rows on the Home page)
    var dash = document.getElementById('view');
    if (!dash) return;
    dash.querySelectorAll('.row-item .t, .weak-t, .detail-row').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('\\[') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw);
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---- Re-render math in error cards ---- */
  function rerenderErrorMath() {
    var list = document.getElementById('err-list');
    if (!list) return;
    list.querySelectorAll('.err-detail > div > div:last-child').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('\\[') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        el.dataset.katexDone = '1';
      }
    });
    list.querySelectorAll('.row-item .t').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw);
        el.dataset.katexDone = '1';
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---- Re-render math in review cards ---- */
  function rerenderSessMath() {
    var list = document.getElementById('sess-list');
    if (!list) return;
    list.querySelectorAll('.sess-notes-body').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('\\[') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        el.dataset.katexDone = '1';
      }
    });
    list.querySelectorAll('.err-detail > div > div:last-child').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('\\[') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        el.dataset.katexDone = '1';
      }
    });
    list.querySelectorAll('.sess-name').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.katex')) return;
      var raw = el.textContent || '';
      if (raw.indexOf('\\(') > -1 || raw.indexOf('$$') > -1) {
        el.innerHTML = window.renderMath(raw);
        el.dataset.katexDone = '1';
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---- Watch for new cards ---- */
  var view = document.getElementById('view');
  if (view) {
    var raf = null;
    new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
        rerenderErrorMath();
        rerenderSessMath();
        rerenderDashboardMath();
      });
    }).observe(view, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  setTimeout(function(){ rerenderErrorMath(); rerenderSessMath(); rerenderDashboardMath(); }, 400);
  setTimeout(function(){ rerenderErrorMath(); rerenderSessMath(); rerenderDashboardMath(); }, 1200);
  setTimeout(function(){ rerenderErrorMath(); rerenderSessMath(); rerenderDashboardMath(); }, 2500);

  var _origEdit = window.edit;
  if (typeof _origEdit === 'function') {
    window.edit = function(){
      if (window._katexCache) window._katexCache.clear();
      return _origEdit.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    try { edit = window.edit; } catch(e){}
  }
  /* ---- Hero card title: click to expand/collapse ---- */
  function wireHeroExpand() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.next-hero .nh-title').forEach(function(el){
      if (el.dataset.heroWired === '1') return;
      el.dataset.heroWired = '1';
      el.title = 'Click to expand';
      el.addEventListener('click', function(){
        this.classList.toggle('expanded');
        this.title = this.classList.contains('expanded') ? 'Click to collapse' : 'Click to expand';
      });
    });
  }

  var _viewEl = document.getElementById('view');
  if (_viewEl) {
    new MutationObserver(wireHeroExpand).observe(_viewEl, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  setTimeout(wireHeroExpand, 600);

  console.log('[apex-katex-fix] installed');
