<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX LANDING · v2.0
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var isTouch = window.matchMedia('(max-width:900px)').matches;
var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---------- CURSOR ---------- */
  var dot = document.querySelector('.cursor-dot');
  var ring = document.querySelector('.cursor-ring');
  var mx = window.innerWidth/2, my = window.innerHeight/2;
  var rx = mx, ry = my, shown = false;

  if (!isTouch && dot && ring) {
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
      mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mx + 'px'; dot.style.top = my + 'px';
      if (!shown) { dot.classList.add('visible'); ring.classList.add('visible'); shown = true; }
      var t = e.target.closest('a,button,.log-row,.plan-chip,.trail-node,.oneday-item,.trust-item');
      dot.classList.toggle('hover', !!t);
      ring.classList.toggle('hover', !!t);
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){
      dot.classList.remove('visible'); ring.classList.remove('visible'); shown = false;
    });
    (function tick(){
      rx += (mx - rx) * .18;
      ry += (my - ry) * .18;
      ring.style.left = rx + 'px';
      ring.style.top = ry + 'px';
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     STAR CHART
     Three depth layers + constellation lines + coordinate rings
     ============================================================ */
  var W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;
  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

  var farSvg = document.getElementById('chart-far');
  var nearSvg = document.getElementById('chart-near');
  var constSvg = document.getElementById('chart-constellations');
  var coordSvg = document.getElementById('chart-coords');

  function setVB(svg){ svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); }

  /* ---- Layer A: coordinate rings — faint, at page center ---- */
  if (coordSvg) {
    setVB(coordSvg);
    var cx = W * 0.62, cy = H * 0.5;
    var ringRadii = [180, 320, 480, 660, 900, 1180];
    var ringGroup = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    ringGroup.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    ringRadii.forEach(function(r, i){
      var c = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
      c.setAttribute('cx', cx); c.setAttribute('cy', cy); c.setAttribute('r', r);
      c.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      c.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(245,245,247,' + (0.032 - i*0.003) + ')');
      c.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1');
      if (i === 2) c.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '2 6');
      if (i === 4) c.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '1 8');
      ringGroup.appendChild(c);
    });
    /* Faint cardinal spokes */
    for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      var ang = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
      var x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * 180;
      var y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * 180;
      var x2 = cx + Math.cos(ang) * 1180;
      var y2 = cy + Math.sin(ang) * 1180;
      var line = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line');
      line.setAttribute('x1', x1); line.setAttribute('y1', y1);
      line.setAttribute('x2', x2); line.setAttribute('y2', y2);
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(245,245,247,0.018)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1');
      ringGroup.appendChild(line);
    }
    coordSvg.appendChild(ringGroup);
  }

  /* ---- Layer B: far stars — tiny, dim, dense ---- */
  var farStars = [];
var FAR_COUNT = 220;
for (var i = 0; i < FAR_COUNT; i++) {
  farStars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    s: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
    a: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.28,
    t: Math.random() < 0.06 ? 'warm' : 'cool',
    twinkle: Math.random() < 0.15,        /* ~15% of far stars */
    tdur: Math.random(),
    tdelay: Math.random()
  });
}

  /* ---- Layer C: mid stars + constellation candidates ---- */
  var midStars = [];
  var MID_COUNT = 90;
  for (var i = 0; i < MID_COUNT; i++) {
    midStars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      s: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8,
      a: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.35,
      t: Math.random() < 0.1 ? 'warm' : 'cool'
    });
  }

  /* ---- Layer D: near stars — bright, sparse ---- */
  var nearStars = [];
  var NEAR_COUNT = 18;
  for (var i = 0; i < NEAR_COUNT; i++) {
    nearStars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      s: 1.4 + Math.random() * 1.2,
      a: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.4,
      t: Math.random() < 0.15 ? 'warm' : 'cool'
    });
  }

  /* ---- Navigation star — a single bright reference point ---- */
  var navStar = {
    x: W * 0.78,
    y: H * 0.22,
    s: 2.6,
    a: 1
  };

  /* ---- Render helper ---- */
 function starEl(s){
  var c = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
  c.setAttribute('cx', s.x); c.setAttribute('cy', s.y); c.setAttribute('r', s.s);
  var col = s.t === 'warm' ? '255,240,220' : '220,225,255';
  c.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + col + ',' + s.a + ')');

  if (Math.random() < 0.20) {
  var dur = (6 + Math.random() * 8).toFixed(2);
  var dur2 = (dur * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.4)).toFixed(2); // slightly different for organic feel
  var del = (-Math.random() * 14).toFixed(2);
  c.style.animation = 'twinkle ' + dur + 's ease-in-out ' + del + 's infinite, breathe ' + dur2 + 's ease-in-out ' + del + 's infinite';
}
  return c;
}
  function beaconEl(s){
    var g = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    var halo = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    halo.setAttribute('cx', s.x); halo.setAttribute('cy', s.y);
    halo.setAttribute('r', s.s * 6);
    halo.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(200,210,255,0.06)');
    g.appendChild(halo);
    var c = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    c.setAttribute('cx', s.x); c.setAttribute('cy', s.y); c.setAttribute('r', s.s);
    c.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');
    g.appendChild(c);
    return g;
  }

  if (farSvg) {
    setVB(farSvg);
    var farG = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    farG.setAttribute('id', 'far-group');
    farStars.forEach(function(s){ farG.appendChild(starEl(s)); });
    farSvg.appendChild(farG);
  }
  if (nearSvg) {
    setVB(nearSvg);
    var nearG = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    nearG.setAttribute('id', 'near-group');
    nearStars.forEach(function(s){ nearG.appendChild(starEl(s)); });
    nearG.appendChild(beaconEl(navStar));
    nearSvg.appendChild(nearG);
  }

  /* ---- Constellations: connect mid stars that are close ---- */
  if (constSvg) {
    setVB(constSvg);
    var constG = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    constG.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    var connected = [];
    var MAX_DIST = Math.min(W, H) * 0.24;
    for (var i = 0; i < midStars.length; i++) {
      for (var j = i + 1; j < midStars.length; j++) {
        var dx = midStars[i].x - midStars[j].x;
        var dy = midStars[i].y - midStars[j].y;
        var d = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
        if (d < MAX_DIST && Math.random() < 0.35) {
          connected.push([i, j]);
        }
      }
    }
    connected.forEach(function(pair){
      var a = midStars[pair[0]], b = midStars[pair[1]];
      var line = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line');
      line.setAttribute('x1', a.x); line.setAttribute('y1', a.y);
      line.setAttribute('x2', b.x); line.setAttribute('y2', b.y);
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(167,139,250,0.09)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '0.7');
      constG.appendChild(line);
    });
    /* mid stars rendered on top of constellation lines */
    midStars.forEach(function(s){ constG.appendChild(starEl(s)); });
    constSvg.appendChild(constG);
  }

  /* ---- Very slow drift animation on the whole chart ---- */
  if (!reduced) {
    var chartStart = performance.now();
    var amplitude = 12;
    var period = 90000;
    function driftChart(t){
      var p = ((t - chartStart) % period) / period;
      var a = p * Math.PI * 2;
      var dx = Math.sin(a) * amplitude;
      var dy = Math.cos(a) * amplitude * 0.6;
      var dxi = dx.toFixed(2);
      var dyi = dy.toFixed(2);
      if (farSvg) farSvg.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + dxi + 'px,' + dyi + 'px,0)';
      if (constSvg) constSvg.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + dxi + 'px,' + dyi + 'px,0)';
      if (nearSvg) nearSvg.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (dx*1.3) + 'px,' + (dy*1.3) + 'px,0)';
      requestAnimationFrame(driftChart);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(driftChart);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     LOOP STEPS
     ============================================================ */
  var loopSteps = document.getElementById('loopSteps');
  if (loopSteps) {
    var steps = ['Study','Remember','Practice','Miss','Diagnose','Correct','Review','Move'];
    var lh = '';
    steps.forEach(function(s, i){
      lh += '<div class="loop-step"><span class="dot"></span><span class="lbl">' + s + '</span><span class="idx">0' + (i+1) + '</span></div>';
      if (i < steps.length - 1) lh += '<div class="loop-arrow"></div>';
    });
    loopSteps.innerHTML = lh;
  }
/* ============================================================
   COMPASS TICKS
   ============================================================ */
var NS2 = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
var ticksG = document.querySelector('.compass-ticks');
var innerTicksG = document.querySelector('.compass-ticks-inner');

if (ticksG) {
  var h = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    var a = i * 6;
    var isCard = i % 15 === 0;
    var isMaj = i % 5 === 0;
    var r2 = isCard ? 200 : (isMaj ? 208 : 213);
    var op = isCard ? 0.5 : (isMaj ? 0.22 : 0.08);
    var sw = isCard ? 1.1 : (isMaj ? 0.75 : 0.5);
    h += '<line x1="0" y1="-220" x2="0" y2="-' + r2 + '" stroke="rgba(245,245,247,' + op + ')" stroke-width="' + sw + '" transform="rotate(' + a + ')" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
  }
  ticksG.innerHTML = h;
}
if (innerTicksG) {
  var h2 = '';
  for (var j = 0; j < 24; j++) {
    h2 += '<line x1="0" y1="-140" x2="0" y2="-132" stroke="rgba(167,139,250,0.14)" stroke-width="0.6" transform="rotate(' + (j*15) + ')"/>';
  }
  innerTicksG.innerHTML = h2;
}

/* ============================================================
   ORBITING SIGNALS
   ============================================================ */
var compass = document.getElementById('compass');
if (compass && !isTouch && !reduced) {
  var signals = [
    { label: 'RECALL', variant: '' },
    { label: 'PYQ',    variant: 's-good' },
    { label: 'ERROR',  variant: 's-weak' },
    { label: 'MOCK',   variant: '' },
    { label: 'TOPIC',  variant: '' },
    { label: 'DUE',    variant: 's-weak' },
    { label: 'WEAK',   variant: 's-weak' }
  ];

  signals.forEach(function(sig, idx){
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'signal ' + sig.variant;
    el.textContent = sig.label;
    el.style.animationDelay = (idx * 0.45) + 's';
    compass.appendChild(el);

    /* Each signal gets its own baseline angle + orbital speed.
       Speed is deliberately slow so the motion reads as ambient,
       not as a carousel. */
    var baseAngle = (idx / signals.length) * Math.PI * 2;
    var baseRadius = 0.42 + (idx % 3) * 0.02; // 0.42 / 0.44 / 0.46
    var speed = 0.00008 + (idx % 2) * 0.00004; // very slow
    var t0 = performance.now() + Math.random() * 5000;

    (function animate(){
      var t = performance.now() - t0;
      /* Radius breathes in and out slightly */
      var r = baseRadius + Math.sin(t * 0.00035 + idx) * 0.025;
      var a = baseAngle + t * speed;
      var x = 50 + Math.cos(a) * r * 100;
      var y = 50 + Math.sin(a) * r * 100;
      el.style.left = x + '%';
      el.style.top = y + '%';
      el.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })();
  });
}
  /* ============================================================
     REVEAL ON SCROLL
     ============================================================ */
  var revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduced) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          e.target.classList.add('in');
          io.unobserve(e.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     COUNTERS
     ============================================================ */
  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var cio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
        var el = e.target;
        var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
        var start = performance.now();
        var dur = 1400;
        function step(t){
          var p = Math.min(1, (t - start) / dur);
          var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
          el.textContent = Math.round(target * eased);
          if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
        cio.unobserve(el);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    counters.forEach(function(el){ cio.observe(el); });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     BARS
     ============================================================ */
  var bars = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bar]');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var bio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
        e.target.style.width = e.target.getAttribute('data-bar') + '%';
        bio.unobserve(e.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });
    bars.forEach(function(el){ bio.observe(el); });
  } else {
    bars.forEach(function(el){ el.style.width = el.getAttribute('data-bar') + '%'; });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     TRAIL — celestial map of topics
     ============================================================ */
  var trailSvg = document.getElementById('trailSvg');
  if (trailSvg) {
    /* Deterministic pseudo-random from seed */
    function seeded(seed){
      var x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000;
      return x - Math.floor(x);
    }

    /* The subjects cluster around these anchor points */
    var clusters = [
      { name: 'History',    x: 130, y: 90,  color: '180,165,140', count: 42 },
      { name: 'Polity',     x: 260, y: 60,  color: '230,180,180', count: 28 },
      { name: 'Geography',  x: 160, y: 210, color: '230,200,150', count: 38 },
      { name: 'Economics',  x: 330, y: 150, color: '200,180,240', count: 34 },
      { name: 'Maths',      x: 480, y: 90,  color: '170,220,180', count: 30 },
      { name: 'Reasoning',  x: 530, y: 220, color: '200,200,170', count: 36 },
      { name: 'English',    x: 660, y: 90,  color: '180,200,240', count: 26 },
      { name: 'Science',    x: 660, y: 240, color: '200,220,240', count: 24 },
      { name: 'GK',         x: 400, y: 260, color: '210,210,210', count: 22 },
      { name: 'Current',    x: 570, y: 155, color: '220,200,220', count: 18 }
    ];

    var svgG = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
    trailSvg.appendChild(svgG);

    /* Draw cluster halos — very faint */
    clusters.forEach(function(c){
      var halo = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
      halo.setAttribute('cx', c.x); halo.setAttribute('cy', c.y);
      halo.setAttribute('r', 38 + c.count * 0.7);
      halo.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + c.color + ',0.02)');
      halo.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(' + c.color + ',0.06)');
      halo.setAttribute('stroke-width', '0.6');
      halo.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '1 4');
      svgG.appendChild(halo);
    });

    /* Subject labels */
    clusters.forEach(function(c, ci){
      var label = document.createElementNS(NS, 'text');
      label.setAttribute('x', c.x); label.setAttribute('y', c.y - 48 - c.count * 0.5);
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      label.setAttribute('font-family', 'JetBrains Mono, monospace');
      label.setAttribute('font-size', '9');
      label.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(245,245,247,0.28)');
      label.setAttribute('letter-spacing', '2');
      label.textContent = c.name.toUpperCase();
      svgG.appendChild(label);
    });

    /* Topic stars per cluster */
    clusters.forEach(function(c, ci){
      var topicCount = Math.max(8, Math.round(c.count / 3.5));
      var topics = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < topicCount; i++) {
        var seed = ci * 100 + i;
        var r = 15 + seeded(seed) * 55;
        var a = seeded(seed * 1.7) * Math.PI * 2;
        var tx = c.x + Math.cos(a) * r;
        var ty = c.y + Math.sin(a) * r;
        /* Friction 0-100 */
        var friction = Math.round(seeded(seed * 3.1) * 100);
        var isCritical = friction > 70;
        var isWarn = friction > 40 && friction <= 70;
        var size = 1.4 + (friction / 100) * 2.4;
        var coreColor = isCritical ? '252,165,165' : (isWarn ? '253,224,71' : ('rgba(' + c.color + ',1)'));
        var topicName = c.name + ' · ' + (['Dynasties','Constitution','Rivers','Inflation','Algebra','Puzzles','Grammar','Cells','Awards','Schemes','Trade','Currency','Percentages','Clocks','Reading','Hormones','Books','Reforms','Climate','Forests'][Math.floor(seeded(seed*5.2)*20)]);

        var g = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
        g.setAttribute('class', 'trail-node');
        g.setAttribute('data-topic', topicName);
        g.setAttribute('data-friction', friction);
        g.setAttribute('data-subject', c.name);

        /* Invisible larger hit area */
        var hit = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
        hit.setAttribute('cx', tx); hit.setAttribute('cy', ty); hit.setAttribute('r', 12);
        hit.setAttribute('fill', 'transparent');
        g.appendChild(hit);

        /* Halo on hover */
        var halo = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
        halo.setAttribute('class', 'node-halo');
        halo.setAttribute('cx', tx); halo.setAttribute('cy', ty); halo.setAttribute('r', size * 4);
        halo.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + coreColor + ',0.14)');
        g.appendChild(halo);

        /* Core */
        var core = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
        core.setAttribute('class', 'node-core');
        core.setAttribute('cx', tx); core.setAttribute('cy', ty); core.setAttribute('r', size);
        core.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + coreColor + ',0.9)');
        g.appendChild(core);

        /* Faint glow for critical */
        if (isCritical) {
          var glow = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
          glow.setAttribute('cx', tx); glow.setAttribute('cy', ty);
          glow.setAttribute('r', size * 3.5);
          glow.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + coreColor + ',0.08)');
          g.insertBefore(glow, hit);
        }

        svgG.appendChild(g);
        topics.push({ x: tx, y: ty, friction: friction });
      }

      /* Connect a few within-cluster lines */
      topics.sort(function(a,b){ return b.friction - a.friction; });
      var top = topics.slice(0, 4);
      for (var k = 0; k < top.length; k++) {
        for (var l = k + 1; l < top.length; l++) {
          var dx = top[k].x - top[l].x;
          var dy = top[k].y - top[l].y;
          if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < 70) {
            var conn = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line');
            conn.setAttribute('class', 'trail-conn');
            conn.setAttribute('x1', top[k].x); conn.setAttribute('y1', top[k].y);
            conn.setAttribute('x2', top[l].x); conn.setAttribute('y2', top[l].y);
            svgG.insertBefore(conn, svgG.firstChild);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    /* Current position marker — a small violet ring */
    var currentX = 400, currentY = 170;
    var curRing = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    curRing.setAttribute('cx', currentX); curRing.setAttribute('cy', currentY);
    curRing.setAttribute('r', 5);
    curRing.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
    curRing.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(167,139,250,0.85)');
    curRing.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.4');
    svgG.appendChild(curRing);
    var curDot = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    curDot.setAttribute('cx', currentX); curDot.setAttribute('cy', currentY);
    curDot.setAttribute('r', 2);
    curDot.setAttribute('fill', '#A78BFA');
    svgG.appendChild(curDot);
    var curLabel = document.createElementNS(NS, 'text');
    curLabel.setAttribute('x', currentX + 12); curLabel.setAttribute('y', currentY + 3);
    curLabel.setAttribute('font-family', 'JetBrains Mono, monospace');
    curLabel.setAttribute('font-size', '8.5');
    curLabel.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(167,139,250,0.85)');
    curLabel.setAttribute('letter-spacing', '2');
    curLabel.textContent = 'NOW';
    svgG.appendChild(curLabel);

    /* Tooltip */
    var tip = document.createElement('div');
    tip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:600;background:rgba(15,15,19,.96);border:1px solid rgba(245,245,247,.14);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#A1A1AA;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s ease;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);max-width:260px;line-height:1.5';
    document.body.appendChild(tip);

    document.querySelectorAll('.trail-node').forEach(function(node){
      node.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
        var name = node.getAttribute('data-topic');
        var friction = node.getAttribute('data-friction');
        var subject = node.getAttribute('data-subject');
        tip.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#F5F5F7;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px">' + name + '</div>' +
                        '<div style="color:#5A5A62">' + subject + ' · friction ' + friction + '</div>';
        tip.style.left = (e.clientX + 14) + 'px';
        tip.style.top = (e.clientY + 14) + 'px';
        tip.style.opacity = '1';
      });
      node.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){
        tip.style.opacity = '0';
      });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     PLANNER
     ============================================================ */
  var planOut = document.getElementById('planOut');
  var planTotal = document.getElementById('planTotal');
  var planPicker = document.getElementById('planPicker');

  var planData = {
    30: [
      { min: '10m', label: 'Fix one overdue error', kind: 'Error' },

  function renderPlan(mins){
    if (!planOut) return;
    var blocks = planData[mins] || planData[90];
    planOut.innerHTML = blocks.map(function(b){
      return '<div class="plan-row"><span class="plan-time">' + b.min + '</span><span class="plan-lbl">' + b.label + '</span><span class="plan-kind">' + b.kind + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    if (planTotal) {
      planTotal.innerHTML = 'That\'s <b>' + (mins >= 60 ? (mins/60) + (mins === 60 ? ' hour' : ' hours') : mins + ' minutes') + '</b> — assembled from your data.';
    }
    var rows = planOut.querySelectorAll('.plan-row');
    rows.forEach(function(r, i){
      setTimeout(function(){ r.classList.add('shown'); }, 80 + i * 110);
    });
  }

  if (planPicker) {
    planPicker.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var btn = e.target.closest('.plan-chip');
      if (!btn) return;
      planPicker.querySelectorAll('.plan-chip').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('on'); });
      btn.classList.add('on');
      renderPlan(parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-min'), 10));
    });
  }
  setTimeout(function(){ renderPlan(90); }, 400);

  /* ============================================================
     VERTICAL NAVIGATOR
     ============================================================ */
  var vnavButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.vnav-item');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
    var vio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      var visible = null;
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting) visible = e.target.id;
      });
      if (visible) {
        vnavButtons.forEach(function(b){
          b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-target') === visible);
        });
      }
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    sections.forEach(function(s){ vio.observe(s); });
  }

  vnavButtons.forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var target = b.getAttribute('data-target');
      var el = document.getElementById(target);
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     RESIZE
     ============================================================ */
  var resizeT;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    clearTimeout(resizeT);
    resizeT = setTimeout(function(){
      W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
      /* Note: full re-render on resize would be nice but we keep current chart */
    }, 200);
  });

})();
</script>

/* ============================================================
   APEX LANDING v2 — star retint + compass parallax + demo
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if (window._apexLandingV2) return;
  window._apexLandingV2 = true;

  /* ── 1. Retint existing star field to app palette ──────── */
  function retintStars(){
    document.querySelectorAll(
      '#chart-far circle, #chart-near circle, #chart-constellations circle'
    ).forEach(function(c){
      const fill = c.getAttribute('fill') || '';
      if (fill.indexOf('255,240,220') > -1) {
        /* warm → violet tint */
        c.setAttribute('fill', fill.replace('255,240,220', '217,206,255'));
      } else if (fill.indexOf('220,225,255') > -1) {
        /* cool → cyan tint */
        c.setAttribute('fill', fill.replace('220,225,255', '189,235,255'));
      }
    });
    /* Navigation beacon halo → cyan */
    document.querySelectorAll('#chart-near g circle[fill*="200,210,255"]').forEach(function(c){
      c.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(125,211,252,.10)');
    });
    /* Constellation lines → violet */
    document.querySelectorAll('#chart-constellations line').forEach(function(l){
      l.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(167,139,250,.11)');
    });
  }
  /* Run after the original chart script has built the stars */
  setTimeout(retintStars, 120);

  /* ── 2. Compass mouse-parallax (desktop only) ──────────── */
  const compass = document.getElementById('compass');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero');
  if (compass && hero && !window.matchMedia('(max-width:900px)').matches
      && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches) {
    let tx = 0, ty = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0, raf = null;
    hero.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
      const r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      const nx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
      const ny = (e.clientY - r.top)  / r.height - 0.5;
      tx = nx * 14;
      ty = ny * 14;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickCompass);
    }, { passive: true });
    hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){
      tx = 0; ty = 0;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickCompass);
    });
    function tickCompass(){
      cx += (tx - cx) * 0.14;
      cy += (ty - cy) * 0.14;
      compass.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + cx.toFixed(2) + 'px,' + cy.toFixed(2) + 'px,0)';
      if (Math.abs(cx - tx) > 0.1 || Math.abs(cy - ty) > 0.1) {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickCompass);
      } else {
        raf = null;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── 3. Interactive demo ──────────────────────────────── */
  const demo = document.getElementById('apexDemo');
  if (!demo) return;

  const queue = [
    {
      kind:'Overdue · start now', kindClass:'warn',
      title:'Post-Gupta Dynasties',
      sub:'History · Review · 3 days overdue',
      recall:'52%', recallClass:'amber',
      errors:'3 · recent', errorsClass:'warn',
      friction:68, frictionClass:'amber',
      reasons:{
        again:'Scheduled +1d · friction ↑ · still critical',
        hard:'Scheduled +3d · retained under pressure',
        good:'Scheduled +14d · mastery progressing',
        easy:'Scheduled +30d · mastered · move on'
      }
    },
    {
      kind:'Weak spot · mock flagged', kindClass:'',
      title:'Percentage',
      sub:'Maths · Practice · 2 mocks flagged',
      recall:'61%', recallClass:'amber',
      errors:'1 · recent', errorsClass:'amber',
      friction:54, frictionClass:'amber',
      reasons:{
        again:'Scheduled +1d · needs another pass',
        hard:'Scheduled +3d · shaky but improving',
        good:'Scheduled +14d · solid recall',
        easy:'Scheduled +30d · confident'
      }
    },
    {
      kind:'Maintenance · on track', kindClass:'good',
      title:'Algebra',
      sub:'Maths · Review · mastered 14 days ago',
      recall:'84%', recallClass:'good',
      errors:'0 · clean', errorsClass:'good',
      friction:22, frictionClass:'good',
      reasons:{
        again:'Reset +1d · friction surge · re-learn',
        hard:'Scheduled +8d · maintenance · keep an eye',
        good:'Scheduled +45d · stable',
        easy:'Scheduled +90d · deep freeze'
      }
    }
  ];

  let idx = 0;
  let readiness = 67;
  const els = {
    action:  document.getElementById('demoAction'),
    kind:    document.getElementById('demoKind'),
    title:   document.getElementById('demoTitle'),
    sub:     document.getElementById('demoSub'),
    reason:  document.getElementById('demoReason'),
    recall:  document.getElementById('dmRecall'),
    errors:  document.getElementById('dmErrors'),
    friction:document.getElementById('dmFriction'),
    bar:     document.getElementById('dmBar'),
    pct:     document.getElementById('dmPct')
  };

  function renderQueueItem(){
    const q = queue[idx];
    els.action.classList.add('swap');
    setTimeout(function(){
      els.kind.className = 'demo-kind ' + (q.kindClass || '');
      els.kind.textContent = q.kind;
      els.title.textContent = q.title;
      els.sub.textContent = q.sub;
      els.recall.className = 'v ' + (q.recallClass || '');
      els.recall.textContent = q.recall;
      els.errors.className = 'v ' + (q.errorsClass || '');
      els.errors.textContent = q.errors;
      els.friction.className = 'v ' + (q.frictionClass || '');
      els.friction.textContent = q.friction;
      els.action.classList.remove('swap');
    }, 280);
  }

  function tick(el){
    el.classList.remove('tick');
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add('tick');
    setTimeout(function(){ el.classList.remove('tick'); }, 400);
  }

  function updateReadiness(delta){
    readiness = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, readiness + delta));
    els.bar.style.width = readiness + '%';
    /* Animate the pct number */
    const from = parseInt(els.pct.textContent, 10) || readiness;
    const start = performance.now();
    const dur = 550;
    function step(t){
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - start) / dur);
      const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      els.pct.textContent = Math.round(from + (readiness - from) * e) + '%';
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
    tick(els.pct);
  }

  demo.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const btn = e.target.closest('.demo-grade');
    if (!btn) return;
    const grade = btn.getAttribute('data-grade');
    const q = queue[idx];

    /* 1. Show the algorithm reason */
    els.reason.classList.remove('on');
    setTimeout(function(){
      els.reason.innerHTML = '<b>→</b><span>' + (q.reasons[grade] || 'Scheduled.') + '</span>';
      els.reason.classList.add('on');
    }, 120);

    /* 2. Tick the metric that changed */
    if (grade === 'again') { tick(els.friction); tick(els.recall); }
    if (grade === 'hard')  { tick(els.friction); }
    if (grade === 'good')  { tick(els.recall); }
    if (grade === 'easy')  { tick(els.recall); tick(els.friction); }

    /* 3. Nudge readiness in a way that feels real */
    const deltas = { again:-2, hard:-1, good:+1, easy:+2 };
    updateReadiness(deltas[grade] || 0);

    /* 4. Move to the next action after a beat */
    setTimeout(function(){
      idx = (idx + 1) % queue.length;
      renderQueueItem();
    }, 1100);
  });

  /* Nudge readiness on idle hover of the card, so it feels alive */
  let hoverTick = null;
  demo.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){
    els.reason.classList.add('on');
    clearInterval(hoverTick);
    hoverTick = setInterval(function(){
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) tick(els.friction);
    }, 3400);
  });
  demo.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){
    clearInterval(hoverTick);
  });

  console.log('[apex landing v2] deep-space theme + interactive demo installed');
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   APEX LANDING v3 — interactive systems
   Palette · Trail review · Readiness math · HUD · Constellations
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if (window._apexLandingV3) return;
  window._apexLandingV3 = true;

  var isTouch = window.matchMedia('(max-width:900px)').matches;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ============================================================
     1. COMMAND PALETTE
     ============================================================ */
  var paletteIndex = [
    { t:'Home',              s:'Learn · top',           ico:'◎', target:'top'   },
    { t:'The Decision',      s:'01 · what matters now', ico:'01', target:'s01'   },
    { t:'The Loop',          s:'02 · cyclic system',    ico:'02', target:'s02'   },
    { t:'The Instrument',    s:'03 · Home screen',      ico:'03', target:'s03'   },

    { t:'The Trust',         s:'08 · local · offline',  ico:'08', target:'s08'   },
    { t:'Enter Apex',        s:'09 · open the app',     ico:'→',  target:'s09'   },
    { t:'Focus 25 min',      s:'Action · timer',        ico:'⚡', target:'s03'   },
    { t:'Command palette',   s:'Feature · ⌘K',          ico:'⌘',  target:'s03'   },
    { t:'Weak radar',        s:'Feature · ranking',     ico:'⌖',  target:'s04'   },
    { t:'Spaced repetition', s:'Feature · SRS',         ico:'↻',  target:'s04'   },
    { t:'Exam readiness',    s:'Feature · composite',   ico:'◐',  target:'s05'   },
    { t:'Marks leakage',     s:'Feature · where lost',  ico:'△',  target:'s05'   },
    { t:'Today planner',     s:'Feature · assemble',    ico:'▤',  target:'s06'   },
    { t:'Cloud sync',        s:'Feature · encrypted',   ico:'☁',  target:'s08'   },
    { t:'Local storage',     s:'Feature · offline',     ico:'◈',  target:'s08'   },
    { t:'Backup export',     s:'Feature · one click',   ico:'⬇',  target:'s08'   }
  ];

  var overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'cmd-overlay';
  overlay.innerHTML =
    '<div class="cmd-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">' +
      '<input class="cmd-input" id="apexCmdInput" placeholder="Search the interface…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">' +
      '<div class="cmd-results" id="apexCmdResults"></div>' +
      '<div class="cmd-foot">' +
        '<span><kbd>↑</kbd><kbd>↓</kbd> navigate</span>' +
        '<span><kbd>↵</kbd> open</span>' +
        '<span><kbd>esc</kbd> close</span>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);

  var cmdInput = overlay.querySelector('#apexCmdInput');
  var cmdResults = overlay.querySelector('#apexCmdResults');
  var cmdIdx = 0;
  var cmdItems = [];

  function cmdRender(q){
    var query = String(q || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    cmdItems = !query ? paletteIndex.slice() : paletteIndex.filter(function(x){
      return x.t.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) > -1 ||
             x.s.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) > -1;
    });
    if (!cmdItems.length) {
      cmdResults.innerHTML = '<div class="cmd-empty">No matches for "' + q.replace(/[<>&]/g, '') + '"</div>';
      return;
    }
    cmdIdx = Math.min(cmdIdx, cmdItems.length - 1);
    cmdResults.innerHTML = cmdItems.map(function(it, i){
      return '<div class="cmd-row' + (i === cmdIdx ? ' on' : '') + '" data-cmd="' + i + '">' +
               '<span class="ico">' + it.ico + '</span>' +
               '<div class="body">' +
                 '<div class="t">' + it.t + '</div>' +
                 '<div class="s">' + it.s + '</div>' +
               '</div>' +
             '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function cmdOpen(){
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    cmdInput.value = '';
    cmdIdx = 0;
    cmdRender('');
    setTimeout(function(){ cmdInput.focus(); }, 40);
  }
  function cmdClose(){
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    cmdInput.blur();
  }
  function cmdActivate(){
    var it = cmdItems[cmdIdx];
    if (!it) return;
    cmdClose();
    var el = document.getElementById(it.target);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduced ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }

  cmdInput.addEventListener('input', function(){ cmdRender(cmdInput.value); });
  cmdInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); cmdIdx = Math.min(cmdIdx + 1, cmdItems.length - 1); cmdRender(cmdInput.value); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); cmdIdx = Math.max(cmdIdx - 1, 0); cmdRender(cmdInput.value); }
    else if (e.key === 'Enter')  { e.preventDefault(); cmdActivate(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); cmdClose(); }
  });
  cmdResults.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var row = e.target.closest('[data-cmd]');
    if (!row) return;
    cmdIdx = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-cmd'), 10);
    cmdActivate();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (e.target === overlay) cmdClose();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var mod = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (overlay.classList.contains('open')) cmdClose();
      else cmdOpen();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && overlay.classList.contains('open')) cmdClose();
  });

  /* HUD hint chip */
  var hudR = document.querySelector('.hud-r');
  if (hudR) {
    var hint = document.createElement('button');
    hint.className = 'hud-hint';
    hint.type = 'button';
    hint.innerHTML = '<i></i>Search <kbd>⌘K</kbd>';
    hint.addEventListener('click', cmdOpen);
    hudR.appendChild(hint);
  }

  /* Add cmd rows to the custom cursor interactive selector */
  var origClosest = Element.prototype.closest;
  /* no-op — the existing cursor code uses a hardcoded selector string.
     We extend it by adding our class names to the same list at runtime
     via a MutationObserver is overkill; instead we hook the cursor
     update function by re-running it. Simpler approach: expose our
     interactive elements to the existing handler by adding them to the
     same class list the handler checks. */
  document.querySelectorAll('.cmd-row').forEach(function(){});
  /* We handle cursor hover for the palette separately: */
  overlay.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
    var dot  = document.querySelector('.cursor-dot');
    var ring = document.querySelector('.cursor-ring');
    if (!dot || !ring) return;
    var hot = e.target.closest('.cmd-row, .hud-hint, .cmd-input');
    dot.classList.toggle('hover', !!hot);
    ring.classList.toggle('hover', !!hot);
  });

  /* ============================================================
     2. TRAIL — interactive review
     ============================================================ */
  var trailSvg = document.getElementById('trailSvg');
  if (trailSvg) {
    var reviewedCount = 0;
    var caption = document.querySelector('.trail-caption');

    /* Inject the review counter + reset button into the caption */
    if (caption && !caption.querySelector('.review-counter')) {
      caption.innerHTML =
        caption.innerHTML +
        '<span class="review-counter" id="trailCount"><i style="width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#86efac;box-shadow:0 0 6px #86efac;display:inline-block"></i>0 reviewed</span>' +
        '<button class="reset-btn" id="trailReset" type="button">Reset</button>';
    }

    var counterEl = document.getElementById('trailCount');
    var resetBtn  = document.getElementById('trailReset');

    function updateCounter(){
      if (!counterEl) return;
      counterEl.innerHTML =
        '<i style="width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#86efac;box-shadow:0 0 6px #86efac;display:inline-block"></i>' +
        reviewedCount + ' reviewed';
    }

    function reviewNode(node){
      if (node.getAttribute('data-reviewed') === '1') return;
      node.setAttribute('data-reviewing', '1');
      node.setAttribute('data-reviewed', '1');
      setTimeout(function(){ node.removeAttribute('data-reviewing'); }, 600);

      /* Find connected nodes and recolor their friction slightly */
      var cx = parseFloat(node.querySelector('.node-core').getAttribute('cx'));
      var cy = parseFloat(node.querySelector('.node-core').getAttribute('cy'));

      trailSvg.querySelectorAll('.trail-node').forEach(function(other){
        if (other === node) return;
        if (other.getAttribute('data-reviewed') === '1') return;
        var oc = other.querySelector('.node-core');
        var ox = parseFloat(oc.getAttribute('cx'));
        var oy = parseFloat(oc.getAttribute('cy'));
        var d = Math.sqrt((ox-cx)*(ox-cx) + (oy-cy)*(oy-cy));
        if (d < 60) {
          var currentF = parseInt(other.getAttribute('data-friction'), 10) || 0;
          var newF = Math.max(0, currentF - Math.round(Math.random() * 8 + 4));
          other.setAttribute('data-friction', newF);
          /* Recolor: red → amber → violet */
          var color = newF > 70 ? '252,165,165' : newF > 40 ? '253,224,71' : '167,139,250';
          oc.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + color + ',0.9)');
          var halo = other.querySelector('.node-halo');
          if (halo) halo.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + color + ',0.14)');
        }
      });

      reviewedCount++;
      updateCounter();
      if (counterEl) {
        counterEl.classList.add('bump');
        setTimeout(function(){ counterEl.classList.remove('bump'); }, 320);
      }
    }

    /* Trail nodes were created by the earlier script; we add click handlers */
    trailSvg.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var g = e.target.closest('.trail-node');
      if (!g) return;
      reviewNode(g);
    });

    if (resetBtn) {
      resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        reviewedCount = 0;
        updateCounter();
        trailSvg.querySelectorAll('.trail-node').forEach(function(n){
          n.removeAttribute('data-reviewed');
          n.removeAttribute('data-reviewing');
          /* Restore original colors from data-friction */
          var f = parseInt(n.getAttribute('data-friction'), 10) || 0;
          var color = f > 70 ? '252,165,165' : f > 40 ? '253,224,71' : '167,139,250';
          var oc = n.querySelector('.node-core');
          if (oc) oc.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + color + ',0.9)');
          var halo = n.querySelector('.node-halo');
          if (halo) halo.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(' + color + ',0.14)');
        });
      });
    }

    /* ============================================================
       5. CONSTELLATION DRAW-IN — animate lines when the trail enters
       ============================================================ */
    trailSvg.querySelectorAll('.trail-conn').forEach(function(l){
      l.classList.add('draw');
    });

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduced) {
      var cio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        entries.forEach(function(entry){
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          trailSvg.querySelectorAll('.trail-conn.draw').forEach(function(l, i){
            setTimeout(function(){ l.classList.add('ready'); }, i * 45);
          });
          cio.disconnect();
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.25 });
      cio.observe(trailSvg);
    } else {
      trailSvg.querySelectorAll('.trail-conn.draw').forEach(function(l){
        l.classList.add('ready');
      });
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     3. READINESS MATH EXPLOSION
     ============================================================ */
  var activeCard = document.querySelector('.pos-card.active');
  if (activeCard) {

    hint.className = 'expand-hint';
    hint.textContent = '↓ show math';
    activeCard.appendChild(hint);

    var breakdown = document.createElement('div');
    breakdown.className = 'pos-breakdown';
    breakdown.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pos-breakdown-title">How 67% is computed</div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Coverage</span><span class="val">84%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.15</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Mastery</span><span class="val">41%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.30</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Recall · 60d</span><span class="val">72%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.20</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Mock accuracy</span><span class="val">63%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.20</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Weakest section</span><span class="val">55%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.10</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-row"><span class="lbl">Error trend</span><span class="val">30%</span><span class="op">×</span><span class="wt">0.05</span></div>' +
      '<div class="pos-total">Composite <b>67%</b></div>';
    activeCard.parentNode.insertBefore(breakdown, activeCard.nextSibling);

    activeCard.addEventListener('click', function(){
      breakdown.classList.toggle('open');
      hint.textContent = breakdown.classList.contains('open') ? '↑ hide math' : '↓ show math';
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     4. PERSISTENT POSITION HUD
     ============================================================ */
  var hud = document.createElement('div');
  hud.className = 'pos-hud';
  hud.innerHTML =
    '<div class="line"><span class="lbl">SECTOR</span><span class="val hi" id="posSector">01</span></div>' +
    '<div class="line"><span class="lbl">POS</span><span class="val" id="posPercent">0%</span><span class="bar"><i id="posBar"></i></span></div>' +
    '<div class="line"><span class="lbl">BEARING</span><span class="val" id="posBearing">—</span></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(hud);

  var posSector = document.getElementById('posSector');
  var posPercent = document.getElementById('posPercent');
  var posBar = document.getElementById('posBar');
  var posBearing = document.getElementById('posBearing');

  var bearings = ['N','NNE','NE','ENE','E','ESE','SE','SSE','S','SSW','SW','WSW','W','WNW','NW','NNW'];

  function updateHUD(){
    var max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    var pct = max > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.scrollY / max)) : 0;
    if (pct > 0.02) hud.classList.add('on');
    else hud.classList.remove('on');
    posPercent.textContent = Math.round(pct * 100) + '%';
    posBar.style.width = (pct * 100) + '%';

    /* Current section number from the same observer that drives the vnav */
    var activeSec = null;
    document.querySelectorAll('section[id]').forEach(function(s){
      var r = s.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.top <= window.innerHeight * 0.4 && r.bottom >= window.innerHeight * 0.4) {
        activeSec = s.id;
      }
    });
    if (activeSec) {
      var num = activeSec.replace(/^s/, '');
      if (/^\d+$/.test(num)) posSector.textContent = String(num).padStart(2, '0');
      else posSector.textContent = '—';
    } else if (pct < 0.08) {
      posSector.textContent = '00';
    }

    var idx = Math.round(pct * 15) % 16;
    posBearing.textContent = bearings[idx];
  }

  var hudRaf = null;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
    if (hudRaf) return;
    hudRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      hudRaf = null;
      updateHUD();
    });
  }, { passive: true });
  updateHUD();

  console.log('[apex landing v3] interactive systems installed');
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

--- END landing.html ---

-- Apex sync backend — D1 schema
-- One row per room. Room IDs are 22 chars from a 32-char alphabet
-- (no O, I, 0, 1 to avoid confusion). ~110 bits of entropy.
-- Blob is AES-GCM ciphertext — server never sees plaintext.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rooms (
  room_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  salt       TEXT NOT NULL,
  blob       TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_updated_at ON rooms(updated_at);


--- END schema.sql ---
